paragraphs.en: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency , leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成器可作为用于探索与仿真的交互式世界，然而逼真且视觉上有吸引力的帧并不一定描绘一个一致的 3D 世界。 现有基准要么评估选定的几何属性，要么使用视觉-语言模型来判断记忆与一致性，系统性 3D 评估仍待深入探索。 我们提出了 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia，这是首个专门针对交互式世界模型中 3D 一致性进行系统而全面评估的基准。 通过受控的探索与重访，我们将评估组织为三个维度：输入保持性、生成内容持久性和 3D 自一致性。 对于输入保持性，配准的 RGB-D 参考和标注的锚点支持对外观、几何和空间稳定性的测量。 对于生成内容持久性，我们将对输入图像中不存在的区域的重访与其首次生成的观测进行比较，以检验模型是否保留其生成的内容。 对于 3D 自一致性，跨视角的深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性以及留出高斯渲染，检验生成的视角是否描述同一个 3D 场景。 长达数分钟的探索与重访进一步检验长期一致性。 我们构建与标注流程汇集了公开数据集、自行采集的场景以及仿真，生成了涵盖室内与室外环境以及六种探索-重访协议的 720 个实例。 评估通过原生接口适配器涵盖 27 个以文本、动作和相机为条件的模型。 我们的 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 基准为诊断 3D 不一致性并开发更具持久性的视频世界模型提供了系统性的基础。

paragraphs.en: Video generation is expanding from visual synthesis toward world simulation [ Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ] , supporting interactive games [ Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ] , open-domain exploration [ Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ] , generative rendering [ Yu et al., 2025a ; Shen et al., 2026 ] , and embodied simulation [ Yang et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ] . This shift is contextualized by [ Kong et al., 2025b ] , which organizes world modeling around video, occupancy, and LiDAR representations. These applications require observations across time and viewpoints to remain compatible with a persistent 3D world. A player should return to the same environment, a renderer should reveal mutually consistent surfaces, and an embodied agent should reuse previously observed spatial relationships. Visually convincing frames alone cannot establish this structural reliability across viewpoints and repeated visits. As generated videos become environments for exploration and interaction, a fundamental question arises: Do generated videos form a consistent 3D world?
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成正从视觉合成扩展到世界模拟 [ Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ] ，以支持交互式游戏 [ Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ] 、开放域探索 [ Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ] 、生成式渲染 [ Yu et al., 2025a ; Shen et al., 2026 ] 以及具身模拟 [ Yang et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ] 。 [ Kong et al., 2025b ] 对这一转变进行了梳理，其围绕视频、占据和激光雷达表征来组织世界建模。 这些应用要求跨时间和跨视点的观测与一个持久存在的三维世界保持兼容。 玩家应能回到同一环境，渲染器应能呈现出相互一致的表面，具身智能体应能复用先前观测到的空间关系。 仅有视觉上令人信服的帧，无法在跨视点和重复访问的情况下建立这种结构可靠性。 随着生成的视频成为探索与交互的环境，一个根本性的问题随之而来：生成的视频是否构成一个一致的三维世界？

sents.en: Video generation is expanding from visual synthesis toward world simulation [ Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ] , supporting interactive games [ Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ] , open-domain exploration [ Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ] , generative rendering [ Yu et al., 2025a ; Shen et al., 2026 ] , and embodied simulation [ Yang et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ] .

sents.en: This shift is contextualized by [ Kong et al., 2025b ] , which organizes world modeling around video, occupancy, and LiDAR representations.
sents.zh: [ Kong et al., 2025b ] 对这一转变进行了梳理，其围绕视频、占据和激光雷达表征来组织世界建模。

sents.en: These applications require observations across time and viewpoints to remain compatible with a persistent 3D world.
sents.zh: 这些应用要求跨时间和跨视点的观测与一个持久存在的三维世界保持兼容。

sents.en: A player should return to the same environment, a renderer should reveal mutually consistent surfaces, and an embodied agent should reuse previously observed spatial relationships.
sents.zh: 玩家应能回到同一环境，渲染器应能呈现出相互一致的表面，具身智能体应能复用先前观测到的空间关系。

sents.zh: 仅有视觉上令人信服的帧，无法在跨视点和重复访问的情况下建立这种结构可靠性。

sents.en: As generated videos become environments for exploration and interaction, a fundamental question arises: Do generated videos form a consistent 3D world?
sents.zh: 随着生成的视频成为探索与交互的环境，一个根本性的问题随之而来：生成的视频是否构成一个一致的三维世界？

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks address different aspects of this question. These protocols assess perceptual quality [ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ] , local or scene-level geometric self-coherence [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Zhao et al., 2026 ] , or memory and state retention upon revisit using same-view appearance comparisons, point-cloud comparisons, and vision-language judgments [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2026a ] . WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] broadens driving-world evaluation to reconstruction, action following, downstream tasks, and human preference. Yet systematic, quantitative evaluation of 3D consistency remains underexplored. Geometric agreement does not guarantee content preservation, nor does a successful return establish consistency throughout exploration. A dedicated benchmark must jointly evaluate 3D structure and the preservation of input and generated content across viewpoints and over time during exploration and repeated revisits.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试解决了这一问题的不同方面。 这些协议通过同视角外观比较、点云比较以及视觉-语言判断，评估感知质量 [ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ]、局部或场景级的几何自一致性 [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Zhao et al., 2026 ]，以及重访时的记忆与状态保持 [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2026a ]。 WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 将驾驶世界评估扩展到重建、动作遵循、下游任务和人类偏好。 然而，针对三维一致性的系统性、定量评估仍未得到充分探索。 几何上的一致并不能保证内容的保留，成功返回也不能确立整个探索过程中的一致性。 一个专门的基准必须联合评估三维结构，以及在探索和重复重访过程中，输入内容与生成内容在不同视点和不同时间上的保持情况。

sents.en: Existing benchmarks address different aspects of this question.
sents.zh: 现有的基准测试解决了这一问题的不同方面。

sents.en: These protocols assess perceptual quality [ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ] , local or scene-level geometric self-coherence [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Zhao et al., 2026 ] , or memory and state retention upon revisit using same-view appearance comparisons, point-cloud comparisons, and vision-language judgments [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2026a ] .

sents.en: WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] broadens driving-world evaluation to reconstruction, action following, downstream tasks, and human preference.
sents.zh: WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 将驾驶世界评估扩展到重建、动作遵循、下游任务和人类偏好。

sents.zh: 然而，针对三维一致性的系统性、定量评估仍未得到充分探索。

sents.en: Geometric agreement does not guarantee content preservation, nor does a successful return establish consistency throughout exploration.
sents.zh: 几何上的一致并不能保证内容的保留，成功返回也不能确立整个探索过程中的一致性。

sents.en: A dedicated benchmark must jointly evaluate 3D structure and the preservation of input and generated content across viewpoints and over time during exploration and repeated revisits.

paragraphs.en: (1) Input preservation assesses whether the model preserves the environment shown in the input as the viewpoint changes. Registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors measure the appearance, geometry, and spatial relationships of observed content. Exploration also reveals regions outside the input, whose appearance the model must generate.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 输入保持性评估模型在视点变化时是否保持了输入中呈现的环境。 配准的 RGB-D 参考与标注的锚点用于衡量所观测内容的外观、几何与空间关系。 探索还会揭示输入之外的区域，其外观必须由模型生成。

sents.en: (1) Input preservation assesses whether the model preserves the environment shown in the input as the viewpoint changes.
sents.zh: (1) 输入保持性评估模型在视点变化时是否保持了输入中呈现的环境。

sents.en: Registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors measure the appearance, geometry, and spatial relationships of observed content.
sents.zh: 配准的 RGB-D 参考与标注的锚点用于衡量所观测内容的外观、几何与空间关系。

sents.en: Exploration also reveals regions outside the input, whose appearance the model must generate.
sents.zh: 探索还会揭示输入之外的区域，其外观必须由模型生成。

paragraphs.en: (2) Generated-content persistence compares newly revealed content across visits, using its first generated appearance as the reference. The model is free to create unseen content, but should preserve what it has created. Beyond content retention, generated views must agree in their underlying 3D structure.
paragraphs.zh: （2）生成内容持久性会跨访问比较新揭示的内容，以其首次生成出现的内容作为参考。 模型可以自由创建未见过的内容，但应当保留它已创建的内容。 除了内容保持之外，生成的视角在其底层三维结构上必须保持一致。

sents.en: (2) Generated-content persistence compares newly revealed content across visits, using its first generated appearance as the reference.
sents.zh: （2）生成内容持久性会跨访问比较新揭示的内容，以其首次生成出现的内容作为参考。

sents.en: The model is free to create unseen content, but should preserve what it has created.
sents.zh: 模型可以自由创建未见过的内容，但应当保留它已创建的内容。

sents.en: Beyond content retention, generated views must agree in their underlying 3D structure.
sents.zh: 除了内容保持之外，生成的视角在其底层三维结构上必须保持一致。

paragraphs.en: (3) 3D self-consistency tests whether generated views describe the same 3D scene through cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering. These measurements examine both local surface compatibility and scene-level coherence. To assess resistance to temporal drift under longer exploration and more frequent revisits, we extend sequences to one minute and repeatedly return to previously visited regions. This tests whether models maintain scene geometry and content as the exploration history grows. We also examine how control accuracy and visual quality relate to the three consistency dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 三维自洽性通过跨视角深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性，以及留出高斯渲染，检验生成的视角是否描述同一个三维场景。 这些度量同时考察局部表面兼容性与场景级一致性。 为评估在更长探索和更频繁重访下的抗时序漂移能力，我们将序列延长至一分钟，并反复返回先前访问过的区域。 这检验了模型在探索历史增长时能否保持场景几何与内容。 我们还考察控制精度与视觉质量如何与这三个一致性维度相关联。

sents.en: (3) 3D self-consistency tests whether generated views describe the same 3D scene through cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering.
sents.zh: (3) 三维自洽性通过跨视角深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性，以及留出高斯渲染，检验生成的视角是否描述同一个三维场景。

sents.zh: 这检验了模型在探索历史增长时能否保持场景几何与内容。

sents.zh: 我们还考察控制精度与视觉质量如何与这三个一致性维度相关联。

paragraphs.en: Joint evaluation requires cross-view references and controlled revisits. Our construction pipeline prepares registered RGB-D pairs, verifies anchor correspondence and surface support, and synthesizes trajectories connecting the reference poses. We select revisits to newly revealed regions and manually review anchors, reference views, and trajectories. To cover diverse scene distributions, we draw on 1 real-world datasets , 2 self-captured scenes , and 3 simulated environments , spanning indoor and outdoor settings in both real and virtual worlds. Processing over 110k source samples and investing over 300 hours in annotation and curation yields 720 evaluation instances , comprising 480 480 short cases and 240 240 paired minute-long extensions. Six exploration-and-revisit protocols cover trajectories with distinct spatial demands. Model-specific adapters translate the trajectories into text instructions, action sequences, or camera conditions for evaluation across control interfaces for the same exploration and revisit tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 联合评估需要跨视角的参照和受控的二次访问。 我们的数据构建流程准备配准的 RGB-D 图像对，验证锚点的对应关系与表面支持，并合成连接参考位姿的轨迹。 我们选择通往新显现区域的二次访问，并人工审核锚点、参考视角和轨迹。 为了覆盖多样的场景分布，我们采用了 1 个真实世界数据集、2 个自采场景和 3 个仿真环境，涵盖真实与虚拟世界中的室内和室外环境。 处理超过 110k 个源样本，并投入超过 300 小时进行标注和整理，最终得到 720 个评估实例，包括 480 个 480 个短案例和 240 个 240 个成对的分钟级扩展。 六种探索与二次访问协议涵盖了具有不同空间需求的轨迹。 模型专属的适配器将这些轨迹转换为文本指令、动作序列或相机条件，以便在相同的探索与二次访问任务上跨控制接口进行评估。

paragraphs.en: To summarize, our contributions are fourfold:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有四点：

paragraphs.en: [itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=3pt,partopsep=0pt]
paragraphs.zh: [itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=3pt,partopsep=0pt]

paragraphs.en: We introduce \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia, the first benchmark dedicated to systematic, quantitative evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models across viewpoints and exploration horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia，这是首个专门用于对交互式世界模型在不同视角与探索范围下的 3D 一致性进行系统性、定量评估的基准。

paragraphs.en: We decompose 3D consistency into input preservation , generated-content persistence , and 3D self-consistency to systematically assess content and geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 3D 一致性分解为输入保持、生成内容持久性和 3D 自一致性，以系统地评估内容与几何。

paragraphs.en: We build a unified annotation pipeline yielding 720 instances with registered evidence and controlled revisits across real and simulated environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个统一的标注流程，产出了720个带有已注册证据的实例，并在真实与模拟环境中进行了受控回访。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models, examining how 3D consistency relates to control execution, visual quality, and exploration duration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了27个以文本、动作和相机为条件的模型，考察3D一致性如何与控制执行、视觉质量以及探索时长相关联。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video generators [ Brooks et al., 2024 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ] establish visual and temporal priors for generative simulation by synthesizing scene appearance and motion from text or visual inputs. Interactive video world models build on these capabilities by conditioning future observations on user-controlled inputs. Action-conditioned systems [ Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ] support movement and interaction, while language-directed methods [ Mao et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ] provide semantic control over unfolding events. Explicit camera-control approaches [ Wang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ] further expose viewpoint trajectories as a generation interface. Together, these interfaces support exploring a generated environment through successive choices, introducing dependencies between current outputs, earlier observations, and the user’s interaction history.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成器 [ Brooks et al., 2024 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ] 通过从文本或视觉输入合成场景外观与运动，为生成式模拟建立了视觉与时间先验。 交互式视频世界模型在这些能力的基础上，通过以用户控制的输入为条件来生成未来观测。 动作条件化系统 [ Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ] 支持移动与交互，而语言导向的方法 [ Mao et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ] 则对正在展开的事件提供语义控制。 显式相机控制方法 [ Wang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ] 进一步将视点轨迹作为生成接口加以开放。 这些接口共同支持用户通过 successive 的连续选择来探索生成的环境，在当前输出、较早观测与用户交互历史之间引入依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Streaming and open-domain systems [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ] pursue sustained, responsive exploration across diverse environments. Beyond generating locally coherent transitions, maintaining a world through exploration requires relating new observations to previously visited regions. History-conditioned generation and context memory [ Li et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2025 ] seek to preserve information from past observations when extending a rollout. These developments also connect to the view of world models as interactive proxies providing feedback for agents [ Yang et al., 2026a ] . They motivate evaluating the stability of a generated environment alongside visual quality and control adherence, particularly when users leave a region and later return.
paragraphs.zh: 流式与开放域系统 [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ] 致力于在多样化环境中实现持续、响应式的探索。 除了生成局部连贯的过渡之外，通过探索来维持一个世界还需要将新的观测与先前访问过的区域建立联系。 以历史为条件的生成与上下文记忆 [ Li et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2025 ] 力求在延展推演时保留来自过去观测的信息。 这些进展还与将世界模型视为为智能体提供反馈的交互式代理的观点相关联 [ Yang et al., 2026a ] 。 这促使人们在评估生成环境时，除视觉质量与控制遵循度之外，还要评估其稳定性，尤其是在用户离开某个区域并随后返回的情形下。

paragraphs.en: Agentic world modeling connects predictive simulation to decision-making across environments [ Chu et al., 2026 ] . Visual navigation approaches couple language-conditioned future observation prediction with policy learning [ Dong et al., 2026b ] , or integrate visual foresight, planning, and memory within a unified model [ Dong et al., 2026a ] . For autonomous driving, vision-language-action systems bring together perception, linguistic reasoning, and actionable outputs [ Hu et al., 2025a ] ; OneVL uses future visual prediction and language explanations to supervise compact latent reasoning for planning [ Lu et al., 2026b ] . These applications make the persistence of spatial evidence relevant to both generation and downstream decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式世界建模将预测性模拟与跨环境的决策制定相连接 [ Chu et al., 2026 ] 。 视觉导航方法将语言条件化的未来观测预测与策略学习相结合 [ Dong et al., 2026b ] ，或在统一模型中整合视觉预见、规划与记忆 [ Dong et al., 2026a ] 。 在自动驾驶领域，视觉-语言-动作系统将感知、语言推理与可执行的输出结合在一起 [ Hu et al., 2025a ] ；OneVL 利用未来视觉预测和语言解释来监督用于规划的紧凑潜在推理 [ Lu et al., 2026b ] 。 这些应用使得空间证据的持续性同时与生成和下游决策相关。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line examines how generative capabilities are learned and aligned. DanceOPD composes generative capability fields on student-induced states [ Zhou et al., 2026b ] , while on-policy diffusion self-distillation converts reward guidance into intermediate prediction targets [ Zhou et al., 2026a ] . These image-generation studies provide a training perspective on capability alignment that complements evaluation of consistency during interactive rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的研究路线考察生成能力是如何被学习和对齐的。 DanceOPD 在学生诱导的状态上组合生成能力场 [ Zhou et al., 2026b ]，而策略内扩散自蒸馏则将奖励引导转化为中间预测目标 [ Zhou et al., 2026a ]。 这些图像生成研究从训练视角为能力对齐提供了洞见，与交互式 rollout 过程中一致性评估互为补充。

sents.en: A complementary line examines how generative capabilities are learned and aligned.
sents.zh: 一条互补的研究路线考察生成能力是如何被学习和对齐的。

paragraphs.en: Explicit scene representations enable navigable world generation and editing [ Yu et al., 2025a ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2025 ; World Labs, 2025 ; World Labs, 2026 ] . These systems associate generated content with a scene that can be queried from different viewpoints. Complementary methods couple generative priors with reconstructed geometry or spatial conditioning [ Yu et al., 2025b ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; InSpatio Team et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ] . Point clouds, Gaussian representations, and warped observations provide camera-aligned evidence for synthesizing unseen regions, while allowing learned priors to complete missing appearance. Geometry may directly determine a rendered output or instead guide a generator that retains freedom to revise appearance and complete occluded regions. This combination connects the flexibility of image and video generation with structured constraints on viewpoint changes. Geometry-grounded weather video synthesis offers a related editing perspective, combining semantic appearance conditioning, simulated particle dynamics, and scene geometry to control weather effects [ Qian et al., 2026a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 显式场景表示支持可导航世界的生成与编辑 [ Yu et al., 2025a ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2025 ; World Labs, 2025 ; World Labs, 2026 ] 。 这些系统将生成的内容与一个可以从不同视点查询的场景相关联。 互补的方法将生成先验与重建的几何或空间条件相结合 [ Yu et al., 2025b ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; InSpatio Team et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ] 。 点云、高斯表示和经过扭曲的观测为合成未见区域提供了与相机对齐的证据，同时允许学习到的先验来补全缺失的外观。 几何可以直接决定渲染输出，也可以改为引导一个生成器，使其保留修改外观和补全被遮挡区域的自由。 这种组合将图像和视频生成的灵活性与视点变化上的结构化约束联系起来。 基于几何的天气视频合成提供了一种相关的编辑视角，它结合语义外观条件、模拟的粒子动力学和场景几何来控制天气效果 [ Qian et al., 2026a ] 。

paragraphs.en: The representation taxonomy of Kong et al. [2025b] places video, occupancy, and LiDAR generation within a common 3D/4D world-modeling landscape. Sensor-based world modeling provides complementary representations of dynamic scenes. DynamicCity models semantic 4D occupancy [ Bian et al., 2025 ] , while LiDARCrafter generates and edits temporally coherent LiDAR sequences [ Liang et al., 2026a ] and U4D introduces uncertainty-conditioned generation [ Xu et al., 2026b ] . Cross-sensor pretraining [ Kong et al., 2026 ] and multimodal scene-consistency learning [ Kong et al., 2025a ] address representation learning in these sensor-rich settings. Together, these works motivate assessing scene structure and dynamics through evidence appropriate to each representation.
paragraphs.zh: Kong 等人的表示分类法 [2025b] 将视频、占据和激光雷达生成置于一个统一的 3D/4D 世界建模图景之中。 基于传感器的世界建模为动态场景提供了互补的表示。 DynamicCity 对语义 4D 占据进行建模 [ Bian et al., 2025 ]，LiDARCrafter 生成并编辑时间上连贯的激光雷达序列 [ Liang et al., 2026a ]，U4D 则引入了不确定性条件下的生成 [ Xu et al., 2026b ]。 跨传感器预训练 [ Kong et al., 2026 ] 和多模态场景一致性学习 [ Kong et al., 2025a ] 解决了这些传感器丰富场景中的表示学习问题。 总体而言，这些工作促使我们通过适合每种表示的证据来评估场景的结构与动态。

paragraphs.en: Spatial memory extends these mechanisms beyond short temporal contexts. Surfel-indexed view retrieval [ Li et al., 2025c ] , geometry-guided correspondences [ Shen et al., 2026 ] , and geometry-aligned or external memory [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026b ] reconnect current viewpoints with previously observed content. These advances address spatial forgetting and drift, and existing studies include reconstruction, revisit, or geometric-consistency diagnostics. Nevertheless, using 3D information does not by itself establish whether original input content is faithfully retained, newly generated regions persist after leaving view, and repeated observations agree as one 3D world. \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia evaluates these complementary requirements jointly under controlled exploration, enabling comparisons across explicit 3D, geometry-guided, and memory-augmented approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 空间记忆将这些机制扩展到短期时间上下文之外。 基于 surfel 索引的视图检索 [ Li et al., 2025c ]、几何引导的对应关系 [ Shen et al., 2026 ]，以及几何对齐或外部记忆 [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026b ] 将当前视角与先前观察到的内容重新连接起来。 这些进展解决了空间遗忘和漂移问题，现有研究包括重建、重访或几何一致性诊断。 然而，使用三维信息本身并不能确定原始输入内容是否被忠实保留、新生成区域在离开视野后是否持续存在，以及重复观测是否作为同一个三维世界保持一致。 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 在受控探索下联合评估这些互补需求，使显式三维、几何引导和记忆增强方法之间能够进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Video benchmarks characterize visual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt alignment [ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ] , while faithfulness-oriented evaluations probe physical plausibility and commonsense [ Zheng et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ] . Embodied benchmarks connect generated dynamics to action-level behavior and functional utility [ Qin et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025b ; Shang et al., 2026 ] . WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] evaluates driving world models across generation, reconstruction, action following, downstream tasks, and human preference. Complementing this benchmark, 3D and 4D World Modeling: A Survey [ Kong et al., 2025b ] organizes evaluation perspectives spanning generation, forecasting, planning, reconstruction, and downstream utility. Together, perceptual and functional criteria answer related but distinct questions about whether generated videos are visually convincing and useful for interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 视频基准评测刻画视觉质量、时序一致性与提示词对齐 [ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ]，而面向忠实度的评估则考察物理合理性与常识 [ Zheng et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ]。 具身基准评测将生成的动态与动作层面的行为及功能效用联系起来 [ Qin et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025b ; Shang et al., 2026 ]。 WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 从生成、重建、动作遵循、下游任务以及人类偏好等方面评估驾驶世界模型。 作为对该基准的补充，《3D 与 4D 世界建模综述》[ Kong et al., 2025b ] 梳理了涵盖生成、预测、规划、重建与下游效用的多种评估视角。 总体而言，感知性标准与功能性标准回答的是相关但不同的问题：生成的视频是否在视觉上令人信服，以及是否有助于交互。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation reliability also depends on evidence grounding. DriveBench shows that plausible VLM answers can reflect linguistic priors rather than visual input [ Xie et al., 2025 ] , while Open-o3-Video makes video reasoning traceable through timestamps, objects, and bounding boxes [ Meng et al., 2026 ] . These findings support pairing language-based assessments with explicit visual and geometric evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 评估的可靠性还取决于证据的可溯源性。 DriveBench 表明，看似合理的视觉语言模型答案可能反映的是语言先验而非视觉输入 [ Xie et al., 2025 ]，而 Open-o3-Video 通过时间戳、物体和边界框使视频推理可追溯 [ Meng et al., 2026 ]。 这些发现支持将基于语言的评估与显式的视觉和几何证据相结合。

sents.en: Evaluation reliability also depends on evidence grounding.

paragraphs.en: Interactive suites examine control responsiveness, trajectory adherence, and geometric consistency [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ] , while multi-turn protocols assess interaction adherence and resulting state changes [ Ying et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026a ] . Complementary diagnostics isolate deformation and occlusion inconsistency [ Gu et al., 2025 ] , static-scene reconstructability [ Fan and Favaro, 2026 ] , and reconstruction-grounded manipulation [ Wang et al., 2026b ] . Geometric evaluation therefore already addresses several failure modes, with different protocols emphasizing different aspects of spatial coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式测试套件考察控制响应性、轨迹遵循度与几何一致性 [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ] ，而多轮协议评估交互遵循度及由此产生的状态变化 [ Ying et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026a ] 。 互补的诊断方法则分别隔离形变与遮挡不一致性 [ Gu et al., 2025 ] 、静态场景可重建性 [ Fan and Favaro, 2026 ] 以及基于重建的操作 [ Wang et al., 2026b ] 。 因此，几何评估已经涵盖了若干失效模式，不同的协议侧重于空间一致性的不同方面。

sents.en: Geometric evaluation therefore already addresses several failure modes, with different protocols emphasizing different aspects of spatial coherence.

paragraphs.en: Memory-oriented tests examine returns to previously observed scenes and recovery of persistent or dynamically updated states [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026d ] , revisit geometry [ Xu et al., 2026a ] , and calibrated revisit similarity [ Gu et al., 2026b ] . Long-horizon tests track drift and state-returning behavior [ Wu et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026a ] , while agent-based evaluators provide transition and persistence judgments [ Chen et al., 2026c ] . Building on these complementary perspectives, \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia jointly measures preservation of the input scene, persistence of newly generated regions, and 3D self-consistency across repeated exploration. This organization separates fidelity to observed evidence from retention of generated content and compatibility of generated views. Table 1 summarizes the coverage of representative benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 面向记忆的测试考察对先前观察到的场景的回访、对持久或动态更新状态的恢复 [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026d ] 、回访几何 [ Xu et al., 2026a ] 以及校准的回访相似性 [ Gu et al., 2026b ] 。 长时程测试追踪漂移和状态回访行为 [ Wu et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026a ] ，而基于智能体的评估器则提供转移和持久性判断 [ Chen et al., 2026c ] 。 基于这些互补的视角，\texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 联合度量输入场景的保持、新生成区域的持久性，以及在重复探索过程中的 3D 自一致性。 这种组织方式将对观察证据的保真度与对生成内容的留存以及生成视图的相容性区分开来。 表 1 总结了代表性基准测试的覆盖范围。

sents.en: Memory-oriented tests examine returns to previously observed scenes and recovery of persistent or dynamically updated states [ Ye et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026d ] , revisit geometry [ Xu et al., 2026a ] , and calibrated revisit similarity [ Gu et al., 2026b ] .

sents.en: Long-horizon tests track drift and state-returning behavior [ Wu et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026a ] , while agent-based evaluators provide transition and persistence judgments [ Chen et al., 2026c ] .
sents.zh: 长时程测试追踪漂移和状态回访行为 [ Wu et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026a ] ，而基于智能体的评估器则提供转移和持久性判断 [ Chen et al., 2026c ] 。

sents.en: Building on these complementary perspectives, \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia jointly measures preservation of the input scene, persistence of newly generated regions, and 3D self-consistency across repeated exploration.

paragraphs.en: AOrbia systematically evaluates the 3D consistency of interactive video world models. In this section, we introduce the evaluation principles and protocols (Section 3.1 ), the data construction and annotation pipeline (Section 3.2 ), and the dataset scale and coverage across scene sources and exploration horizons (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: AOrbia 系统性地评估交互式视频世界模型的三维一致性。 在本节中，我们介绍评估原则与协议（第 3.1 节）、数据构建与标注流程（第 3.2 节），以及数据集在场景来源和探索时间跨度上的规模与覆盖范围（第 3.3 节）。

sents.en: AOrbia systematically evaluates the 3D consistency of interactive video world models.
sents.zh: AOrbia 系统性地评估交互式视频世界模型的三维一致性。

sents.en: In this section, we introduce the evaluation principles and protocols (Section 3.1 ), the data construction and annotation pipeline (Section 3.2 ), and the dataset scale and coverage across scene sources and exploration horizons (Section 3.3 ).
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍评估原则与协议（第 3.1 节）、数据构建与标注流程（第 3.2 节），以及数据集在场景来源和探索时间跨度上的规模与覆盖范围（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Interactive World Generation. An interactive video world model generates observations from an initial image I 0 I_{0} , a scene description s s , and user inputs 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , yielding V ^ = ℳ ⁡ ( I 0 , s , 𝒰 ) \hat{V}=\mathcal{M}(I_{0},s,\mathcal{U}) . Depending on the model’s interface, 𝒰 \mathcal{U} comprises requested text instructions T T , discrete actions A A , or camera poses P P .
paragraphs.zh: 交互式世界生成。 交互式视频世界模型根据初始图像 I 0 I_{0}、场景描述 s s 和用户输入 𝒰 \mathcal{U} 生成观测，得到 V ^ = ℳ ⁡ ( I 0 , s , 𝒰 ) \hat{V}=\mathcal{M}(I_{0},s,\mathcal{U})。 根据模型的接口不同，𝒰 \mathcal{U} 可以包括文本指令 T T、离散动作 A A 或相机位姿 P P。

sents.en: Interactive World Generation.
sents.zh: 交互式世界生成。

sents.zh: 交互式视频世界模型根据初始图像 I 0 I_{0}、场景描述 s s 和用户输入 𝒰 \mathcal{U} 生成观测，得到 V ^ = ℳ ⁡ ( I 0 , s , 𝒰 ) \hat{V}=\mathcal{M}(I_{0},s,\mathcal{U})。

sents.en: Depending on the model’s interface, 𝒰 \mathcal{U} comprises requested text instructions T T , discrete actions A A , or camera poses P P .

paragraphs.en: Consistency Decomposition. Existing works examine aspects of consistency, including local geometric agreement or content recovery upon return [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ] . A systematic evaluation should account for what the inputs constrain, what the model is free to generate, and whether the generated content forms a coherent 3D scene. We evaluate three dimensions covering input content, newly generated regions, and 3D structure.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性分解。 现有工作考察了一致性的多个方面，包括局部几何一致性或内容回传后的恢复情况 [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ] 。 系统性评估应当考虑输入约束了什么、模型可以自由生成什么，以及生成的内容是否构成一个连贯的三维场景。 我们评估涵盖输入内容、新生成区域和三维结构的三个维度。

sents.en: Consistency Decomposition.
sents.zh: 一致性分解。

sents.en: Existing works examine aspects of consistency, including local geometric agreement or content recovery upon return [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 现有工作考察了一致性的多个方面，包括局部几何一致性或内容回传后的恢复情况 [ Duan et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2026 ] 。

sents.en: A systematic evaluation should account for what the inputs constrain, what the model is free to generate, and whether the generated content forms a coherent 3D scene.
sents.zh: 系统性评估应当考虑输入约束了什么、模型可以自由生成什么，以及生成的内容是否构成一个连贯的三维场景。

sents.en: We evaluate three dimensions covering input content, newly generated regions, and 3D structure.
sents.zh: 我们评估涵盖输入内容、新生成区域和三维结构的三个维度。

paragraphs.en: Input preservation We test whether the model preserves the scene shown in the initial image . Distinctive static objects and structures are annotated as anchors , providing landmarks that should remain in place across viewpoint changes and reappear when the camera returns. Evaluating anchors individually prevents a missing landmark from being overlooked in a scene-wide average dominated by other visible objects and scene content.
paragraphs.zh: 输入保持性 我们测试模型是否保留了初始图像中呈现的场景。 独特的静态物体和结构被标注为锚点，作为地标，它们在视角变化时应保持原位，并在相机返回时重新出现。 逐个评估锚点可以防止某个地标的缺失被整体场景平均值掩盖——因为该平均值主要受其他可见物体和场景内容主导。

sents.en: Input preservation We test whether the model preserves the scene shown in the initial image .
sents.zh: 输入保持性 我们测试模型是否保留了初始图像中呈现的场景。

sents.en: Distinctive static objects and structures are annotated as anchors , providing landmarks that should remain in place across viewpoint changes and reappear when the camera returns.
sents.zh: 独特的静态物体和结构被标注为锚点，作为地标，它们在视角变化时应保持原位，并在相机返回时重新出现。

sents.en: Evaluating anchors individually prevents a missing landmark from being overlooked in a scene-wide average dominated by other visible objects and scene content.
sents.zh: 逐个评估锚点可以防止某个地标的缺失被整体场景平均值掩盖——因为该平均值主要受其他可见物体和场景内容主导。

paragraphs.en: Generated-content persistence We evaluate regions absent from the input image . Their appearance is not prescribed, but the controls specify when the model should revisit them. We compare these revisits with the first generated observations to test whether the same content remains at corresponding locations when the camera revisits the region.
paragraphs.zh: 生成内容的持久性：我们评估输入图像中不存在的区域。 它们的外观并未预先规定，但控制项指定了模型何时应重新访问这些区域。 我们将这些重新访问与首次生成的观测进行比较，以检验当相机重新访问该区域时，对应位置的内容是否保持不变。

sents.en: Generated-content persistence We evaluate regions absent from the input image .
sents.zh: 生成内容的持久性：我们评估输入图像中不存在的区域。

sents.en: Their appearance is not prescribed, but the controls specify when the model should revisit them.
sents.zh: 它们的外观并未预先规定，但控制项指定了模型何时应重新访问这些区域。

sents.en: We compare these revisits with the first generated observations to test whether the same content remains at corresponding locations when the camera revisits the region.
sents.zh: 我们将这些重新访问与首次生成的观测进行比较，以检验当相机重新访问该区域时，对应位置的内容是否保持不变。

paragraphs.en: 3D self-consistency We examine the generated video itself, using recovered cameras to test cross-view agreement and whether a shared 3D reconstruction explains observations beyond those used to build it. These tests assess internal coherence independently of the requested camera trajectory used to produce the video.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 自洽性 我们直接检验生成的视频本身，利用恢复出的相机来测试跨视角一致性，以及一个共享的 3D 重建能否解释超出构建该重建所用内容的观测。 这些测试独立于生成视频时所请求的相机轨迹来评估内部一致性。

sents.en: 3D self-consistency We examine the generated video itself, using recovered cameras to test cross-view agreement and whether a shared 3D reconstruction explains observations beyond those used to build it.
sents.zh: 3D 自洽性 我们直接检验生成的视频本身，利用恢复出的相机来测试跨视角一致性，以及一个共享的 3D 重建能否解释超出构建该重建所用内容的观测。

sents.en: These tests assess internal coherence independently of the requested camera trajectory used to produce the video.
sents.zh: 这些测试独立于生成视频时所请求的相机轨迹来评估内部一致性。

paragraphs.en: Exploration-and-Revisit Protocols. Exploration-and-revisit trajectories test input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency within one rollout. Six templates challenge preservation under changes in parallax and viewing direction: 1 forward and backward , 2 lateral return , 3 yaw return , 4 arc return , 5 orbit around an anchor , and 6 peek and return . In peek-and-return, the camera moves past an anchor into an unseen region, returns, and revisits that region on a second excursion. Each trajectory starts at P 0 P_{0} and returns to the same camera pose at P r P_{r} . For input preservation , we compare the return view against the initial RGB image and reference depth. A cross-view query at P q P_{q} uses registered RGB-D and annotated anchors to evaluate input-visible surfaces from another viewpoint. For generated-content persistence , we pair a first visit at P first P_{\mathrm{first}} to a region outside the input view with a revisit at P revisit P_{\mathrm{revisit}} after exploring elsewhere. The first generated observation provides the reference for comparing appearance and geometry across visits. For 3D self-consistency , views sampled along the trajectory support comparisons of corresponding surfaces across views and reconstruction tests using held-out generated views.
paragraphs.zh: 探索-重访协议。 探索-重访轨迹在单次 rollout 中测试输入保持、生成内容持久性和 3D 自一致性。 六种模板在视差和观察方向变化下挑战保持能力：1 前进与后退，2 侧向返回，3 偏航返回，4 弧线返回，5 绕锚点环绕，以及 6 探看与返回。 在探看与返回中，相机越过锚点进入一个未见区域，然后返回，并在第二次行进中重访该区域。 每条轨迹从 P 0 P_{0} 出发，并返回到 P r P_{r} 处相同的相机位姿。 对于输入保持，我们将返回视图与初始 RGB 图像和参考深度进行比较。 在 P q P_{q} 处的跨视图查询使用配准的 RGB-D 和标注的锚点，从另一视点评估输入可见表面。 对于生成内容持久性，我们将对输入视图之外某区域在 P first P_{\mathrm{first}} 处的首次访问，与在探索其他地方之后在 P revisit P_{\mathrm{revisit}} 处的重访进行配对。 首次生成的观测为跨访问比较外观和几何提供了参考。 对于 3D 自一致性，沿轨迹采样的视图支持跨视图对应表面的比较，以及使用留出的生成视图进行的重建测试。

paragraphs.en: We combine 1 public datasets , 2 self-captured scenes , and 3 UE simulation to cover diverse indoor and outdoor environments. Each case pairs registered RGB-D observations from different viewpoints with a synthesized revisit trajectory that follows one of six templates and passes through both reference poses. This enables controlled exploration from existing observations without frame-by-frame RGB-D references. Figure 1 summarizes the four-stage construction and annotation pipeline, from selecting reference views to reviewing the completed cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们结合了1公开数据集、2自采集场景以及3 UE 仿真，以覆盖多样的室内外环境。 每个案例将来自不同视角的配准 RGB-D 观测与一条合成的重访轨迹配对，该轨迹遵循六个模板之一，并经过两个参考位姿。 这使得能够在没有逐帧 RGB-D 参考的情况下，基于已有观测进行受控的探索。 图 1 总结了从选择参考视图到审阅已完成案例的四阶段构建与标注流程。

sents.zh: 我们结合了1公开数据集、2自采集场景以及3 UE 仿真，以覆盖多样的室内外环境。

sents.zh: 图 1 总结了从选择参考视图到审阅已完成案例的四阶段构建与标注流程。

paragraphs.en: Geometry-Guided View Selection. We retain existing geometry and recover missing annotations with ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] . We select input–query pairs ( P 0 , P q ) (P_{0},P_{q}) from registered poses using each template’s rotation and translation requirements. Ranking favors sufficient viewpoint change while balancing coverage across templates and scene content.
paragraphs.zh: 几何引导的视角选择。 我们保留已有的几何信息，并使用 ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] 恢复缺失的标注。 我们依据每个模板的旋转和平移要求，从已配准的位姿中选取输入—查询对 ( P 0 , P q ) (P_{0},P_{q})。 排序偏向充分的视角变化，同时在各模板与场景内容之间平衡覆盖度。

sents.en: Geometry-Guided View Selection.
sents.zh: 几何引导的视角选择。

sents.en: We retain existing geometry and recover missing annotations with ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] .
sents.zh: 我们保留已有的几何信息，并使用 ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] 恢复缺失的标注。

sents.en: We select input–query pairs ( P 0 , P q ) (P_{0},P_{q}) from registered poses using each template’s rotation and translation requirements.
sents.zh: 我们依据每个模板的旋转和平移要求，从已配准的位姿中选取输入—查询对 ( P 0 , P q ) (P_{0},P_{q})。

paragraphs.en: Anchor Discovery and Verification. A VLM [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] proposes bounded, distinctive static landmarks visible at both endpoints. SAM3 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] segments them independently at both endpoints. We filter masks by area, connectivity, and completeness, then track shortlisted objects to verify cross-view identity . Back-projecting input anchors with depth tests their visibility and depth agreement in the query view, verifying cross-view surface support for landmarks visible in both the input and query observations.
paragraphs.zh: 锚点发现与验证。 一个 VLM [Qwen Team, 2026] 提出有界的、具有辨识度的静态地标，这些地标在两个端点处均可见。 SAM3 [Carion et al., 2026] 在两个端点处分别对它们进行分割。 我们按面积、连通性和完整性过滤掩码，然后跟踪入围目标以验证跨视角同一性。 通过带深度检验的反投影输入锚点，在查询视角中检验其可见性与深度一致性，从而验证地标在输入观测与查询观测中均可见的跨视角表面支撑。

sents.en: Anchor Discovery and Verification.
sents.zh: 锚点发现与验证。

sents.en: A VLM [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] proposes bounded, distinctive static landmarks visible at both endpoints.
sents.zh: 一个 VLM [Qwen Team, 2026] 提出有界的、具有辨识度的静态地标，这些地标在两个端点处均可见。

sents.zh: 我们按面积、连通性和完整性过滤掩码，然后跟踪入围目标以验证跨视角同一性。

sents.en: Back-projecting input anchors with depth tests their visibility and depth agreement in the query view, verifying cross-view surface support for landmarks visible in both the input and query observations.
sents.zh: 通过带深度检验的反投影输入锚点，在查询视角中检验其可见性与深度一致性，从而验证地标在输入观测与查询观测中均可见的跨视角表面支撑。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory Synthesis and Revisit Design. We fit template parameters to synthesize trajectories through P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} that return to the initial pose. Paths are checked against scene geometry and revised for clearance. We select temporally separated visits to newly revealed regions based on pose proximity, novelty relative to the input, and shared visible surfaces. Minute-long extensions increase travel distance while retaining the short case’s input, anchors, and reference poses . Additional revisit pairs test whether appearance and geometry persist in these regions after further exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹合成与重访设计。 我们拟合模板参数来合成经过 P 0 P_{0} 和 P q P_{q} 并返回初始位姿的轨迹。 路径会根据场景几何进行检查，并为获得净空而修订。 我们基于位姿邻近性、相对于输入的新颖性以及共享的可见表面，选择在时间上分离的对新显现区域的访问。 长达一分钟的扩展在保留短情形的输入、锚点和参考位姿的同时增加了行进距离。 额外的重访对用于测试在进一步探索后这些区域中的外观和几何是否保持不变。

sents.zh: 轨迹合成与重访设计。

paragraphs.en: Quality Assessment and Human Curation. We rank cases by image sharpness, anchor visibility, mask integrity, camera motion, and shared surface support across revisits. Reviewers inspect references, anchor overlays, projected support, and trajectories to correct or reject cases. A VLM produces factual scene captions from source frames to provide scene descriptions alongside the initial images as model inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 质量评估与人工筛选。 我们根据图像清晰度、锚点可见性、掩码完整性、相机运动以及重访间的共享表面支持度对案例进行排序。 审核员检查参考图像、锚点叠加图、投影支持度与轨迹，以修正或否决案例。 VLM 从源帧生成客观的场景描述字幕，作为场景说明与初始图像一起提供给模型作为输入。

paragraphs.en: We curate 240 240 cases from approximately 110,000 110{,}000 source samples across four public datasets, ScanNet++ [ Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ] , SpatialVID [ Wang et al., 2026a ] , Sekai [ Li et al., 2025d ] , and MiraData [ Ju et al., 2024 ] . For simulation, we collect 48 48 UE environments and render 365 365 candidate videos, retaining 180 180 cases after curation. We also record 85 85 videos ourselves and retain 60 60 . Together, data annotation and manual curation required over 300 hours .

paragraphs.en: AOrbia contains 720 cases and 859 anchor evaluation targets , with 480 short cases and 240 paired minute-long extensions , standardized at 720 720 p and 16 16 FPS. The short cases cover 120 120 indoor and 360 360 outdoor settings, including 300 300 cases from real-world observations and 180 180 from simulation. Short trajectories last approximately 22 22 seconds with one revisit; their minute-long extensions include three revisits to test preservation through longer exploration and repeated returns. Source-specific construction procedures and dataset composition are detailed in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Given a generated video, we estimate depth and poses with DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] and evaluate the designated observations against registered RGB-D references or earlier generated views. Cross-view agreement and held-out rendering assess internal 3D consistency. The three dimensions differ in their reference: the input scene for input preservation, the model’s own first observation for generated-content persistence, and the generated video itself for 3D self-consistency. The survey by Kong et al. [2025b] distinguishes generation, reconstruction, and task-oriented evaluation; here, we focus on complementary content and geometry tests during interactive exploration. We describe the core consistency metrics and long-horizon evaluation below. Detailed metric definitions and computation procedures are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个生成的视频，我们使用 DA3 [Lin et al., 2026] 估计深度和位姿，并将指定的观测与已注册的 RGB-D 参考或较早生成的视图进行对比评估。 跨视图一致性法和留出渲染用于评估内部 3D 一致性。 这三个维度在参考对象上有所不同：输入保持以输入场景为参考，生成内容持续性以模型自身的首次观测为参考，而 3D 自一致性则以生成的视频本身为参考。 Kong 等人的综述 [2025b] 区分了生成、重建和面向任务的评估；在此，我们聚焦于交互式探索过程中的互补性内容与几何测试。 我们在下面描述核心一致性指标和长时程评估。 详细的指标定义和计算流程见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Input Preservation. To assess input preservation at two checkpoints, we compare the return at P r P_{r} with the input at P 0 P_{0} and the query at P q P_{q} with registered RGB-D references on input-visible surfaces . Surfaces revealed for the first time at P q P_{q} have no reference and are excluded from the query comparison. 1 Scene Appearance Fidelity quantifies appearance fidelity at return and query views, while 2 Anchor Appearance Fidelity assesses the preservation of distinctive landmarks across viewpoints and on return. Both use DINO similarity [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] , PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on input-visible scene or anchor regions, with equal weight per anchor . A missing or altered landmark is one of the most visible failures of a generated world, yet it often occupies a small part of the frame, so a scene-wide average can hide it. Scoring each anchor separately makes such failures directly measurable. 3 Scene Geometry Fidelity quantifies geometric fidelity to the observed scene, while 4 Anchor Geometry Fidelity assesses anchor geometry relative to the surrounding scene. Both measure depth AbsRel against the registered reference using a shared scene-level scale. 5 Anchor Identity Consistency tests anchor identity retention during exploration. SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] tracks input masks toward P q P_{q} . We average masked DINO cosine similarity to the input over four times and equally across anchors.
paragraphs.zh: 输入保持性。 为了在两个检查点评估输入保持性，我们将 P r P_{r} 处的返回结果与 P 0 P_{0} 处的输入进行比较，并将 P q P_{q} 处的查询与输入可见表面上已配准的 RGB-D 参考进行比较。 在 P q P_{q} 处首次显露的表面没有参考数据，因此被排除在查询比较之外。1 场景外观保真度量化返回视角和查询视角的外观保真度，而 2 锚点外观保真度评估独特地标跨视角及返回时的保持情况。 两者都在输入可见的场景或锚点区域上使用 DINO 相似度 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] 、PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，每个锚点权重相等。 地标的缺失或改变是生成世界最明显的失败之一，但它通常只占据画面的一小部分，因此全局场景平均可能将其掩盖。 对每个锚点分别评分使此类失败可以直接被度量。3 场景几何保真度量化对观测场景的几何保真度，而 4 锚点几何保真度评估锚点几何相对于周围场景的情况。 两者都使用共享的场景级尺度，针对已配准的参考测量深度 AbsRel。5 锚点身份一致性测试探索过程中锚点身份的保持情况。 SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] 将输入掩码追踪至 P q P_{q} 。 我们在四个时间点对相对于输入的掩码 DINO 余弦相似度取平均，并在各锚点间等权平均。

paragraphs.en: Generated-Content Persistence. For each annotated pair ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) , the first generated observation serves as the reference for a revisit at the same pose or an overlapping viewpoint. Regions outside the input view have no ground truth, and many different contents would be plausible. What must hold is that the model shows the same content when it returns, so the model’s own earlier output serves as the reference. 1 Revisit Appearance Consistency measures appearance retention across revisits, while 2 Revisit Depth Consistency measures geometric consistency across visits. Both use surfaces visible in both observations , matched by projecting first-visit depth into the revisit view with estimated cameras; we compare DINO features for appearance and compute AbsRel for depth. Matching through 3D aligns the same surfaces across visits, so the test also holds when the revisit viewpoint differs. At identical requested poses, we also compare images directly with DINO, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, and depth maps at the shared estimator scale. 3 Revisit Surface Agreement measures whether both visits reconstruct the same 3D surfaces. We compute a bidirectional nearest-point F-score between aligned point clouds, with matching distance relative to scene depth.
paragraphs.zh: 生成内容持久性。 对每个标注对 ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}})，首次生成的观测作为在同一位姿或重叠视点下重访的参考。 输入视点之外的区域没有真值，且许多不同内容都可能是合理的。 必须成立的是：模型在返回时应显示相同的内容，因此模型自身先前的输出可作为参考。1 重访外观一致性衡量跨重访的外观保持程度，而 2 重访深度一致性衡量跨访问的几何一致性。 两者都使用在两次观测中均可见的表面，通过利用估计的相机将首次访问的深度投影到重访视图进行匹配；我们比较 DINO 特征来评估外观，并计算 AbsRel 来评估深度。 通过 3D 匹配可对齐跨访问的相同表面，因此即使重访视点不同，该测试依然成立。 在完全相同的请求位姿下，我们还直接用 DINO、PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 比较图像，并在共享的估计尺度下比较深度图。3 重访表面一致性衡量两次访问是否重建出相同的 3D 表面。 我们在对齐的点云之间计算双向最近点 F 分数，匹配距离相对于场景深度而定。

paragraphs.en: 3D Self-Consistency. We assess whether generated views form a coherent 3D scene using cross-view correspondences from recovered cameras. These tests do not use the requested trajectory. A model can follow the requested camera motion and still produce views that disagree in 3D, or produce a coherent scene along the wrong trajectory; control alignment and 3D self-consistency are therefore scored separately. 1 Cross-View Depth Consistency tests whether views agree on the depth of shared surfaces, while 2 Cross-View Feature Consistency tests whether matched surfaces retain consistent visual features across views. Both use valid, unoccluded correspondences established by bidirectional depth reprojection for frame pairs at short and medium temporal intervals, measuring depth AbsRel and DINO cosine similarity, respectively. 3 Regional Scale Agreement tests relative scale consistency across scene regions. We measure dispersion in observed-to-reprojected depth ratios across a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid. 4 Reconstruction tests reconstruction accuracy on unseen views . DA3 predicts a Gaussian scene [ Kerbl et al., 2023 ] from 64 context frames ; we render 16 held-out views and compare them with the corresponding generated frames using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS for pixel-level and perceptual agreement. WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] likewise uses reconstructed scenes and re-rendering to assess driving-world fidelity. Pairwise tests check nearby frames, whereas held-out rendering tests whether one scene explains views outside its context, revealing inconsistency that accumulates along the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 3D自洽性。 我们利用从恢复相机中获得的跨视角对应关系，评估生成的视图是否构成一个连贯的3D场景。 这些测试不使用所请求的轨迹。 一个模型可以遵循所请求的相机运动，但仍生成在3D上不一致的视图，或者沿错误轨迹生成连贯的场景；因此控制对齐与3D自洽性被分别评分。1 跨视角深度一致性测试视图在共享表面的深度上是否一致，而2 跨视角特征一致性测试匹配表面在跨视图时是否保持一致的视觉特征。 两者均使用由双向深度重投影在短时间和中等时间间隔的帧对上建立的有效、无遮挡的对应关系，分别测量深度AbsRel和DINO余弦相似度。3 区域尺度一致性测试场景各区域之间相对尺度的一致性。 我们在 4 × 4 4\times 4 网格上测量观测深度与重投影深度之比的离散度。4 重建测试在未见视图上评估重建精度。 DA3从64个上下文帧预测一个高斯场景 [ Kerbl et al., 2023 ]；我们渲染16个保留视图，并使用PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS将它们与相应的生成帧进行比较，以衡量像素级和感知上的一致性。 WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 同样使用重建场景和重渲染来评估驾驶世界的保真度。 成对测试检查邻近的帧，而保留视图渲染则测试一个场景能否解释其上下文之外的视图，从而揭示沿轨迹累积的不一致性。

paragraphs.en: Consistency over Longer Exploration. We track 1 visual quality , 2 control , and 3 local geometry in five-second windows for both short and minute-long videos. Temporal stability combines the average performance with its retention relative to the initial window to assess whether a model sustains its capabilities during continued exploration. The final score weights short- and long-video means by 30% and 70% , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 更长探索过程中的一致性。 我们在五秒窗口内对短视频和长达一分钟的视频分别追踪 1 视觉质量、2 控制和 3 局部几何。 时序稳定性将平均性能与其相对于初始窗口的保持率相结合，以评估模型在持续探索过程中能否保持其能力。 最终评分分别以 30% 和 70% 的权重加权短视频与长视频的均值。

paragraphs.en: SolarWM-H3 leads overall. SolarWM-H3 ranks first overall at 76.32 76.32 , with the strongest generated-content persistence and temporal stability among world models. Lyra2 and EVOKE rank second and third, leading control and visual quality, respectively. Gen3C leads input preservation, while HY-WorldPlay leads 3D self-consistency. Seedance2.5 leads the TI2V group overall, whereas Cosmos3-Super leads its visual quality, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. No model leads all six tiers.
paragraphs.zh: SolarWM-H3 总体领先。 SolarWM-H3 以 76.32 76.32 的分数总体排名第一，在世界模型中拥有最强的生成内容持久性与时间稳定性。 Lyra2 和 EVOKE 分列第二、第三，分别领先于控制能力和视觉质量。 Gen3C 在输入保持方面领先，而 HY-WorldPlay 在 3D 自洽性方面领先。 Seedance2.5 在 TI2V 组中总体领先，而 Cosmos3-Super 则在该组的视觉质量、生成内容持久性和 3D 自洽性方面领先。 没有任何模型在全部六个层级上均处于领先地位。

paragraphs.en: Several leading world models use explicit 3D memory. The 3D Repr. column in Table 2 shows that three of the top five world models use explicit geometry: Lyra2, EVOKE, and Gen3C. Lyra2 uses per-frame geometry to retrieve relevant past frames and establish correspondences with target views [ Shen et al., 2026 ] . EVOKE stores observed geometry in an external world state bank and renders it from the current camera pose [ Yin et al., 2026 ] . Gen3C maintains a 3D cache whose renderings guide generation along the requested camera trajectory [ Ren et al., 2025 ] . By linking past observations to 3D locations, these mechanisms let models reuse scene content at a requested viewpoint even after it leaves the recent video context. This may help explain their strong control and content-preservation results.
paragraphs.zh: 多个领先的世界模型使用显式3D记忆。 表2中的3D表示列显示，前五名世界模型中有三个使用显式几何：Lyra2、EVOKE和Gen3C。 Lyra2使用逐帧几何来检索相关的过去帧，并与目标视角建立对应关系 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] 。 EVOKE将观测到的几何存储在外部世界状态库中，并从当前相机位姿对其进行渲染 [ Yin et al., 2026 ] 。 Gen3C维护一个3D缓存，其渲染结果沿着请求的相机轨迹引导生成 [ Ren et al., 2025 ] 。 通过将过去的观测与3D位置关联，这些机制使模型即使在场景内容离开近期视频上下文之后，仍能在请求的视角处复用该内容。 这可能有助于解释它们在可控性和内容保留方面的出色结果。

paragraphs.en: Camera control is the largest gap between the two model groups. World models average 57.29 57.29 in control, compared with 32.48 32.48 for TI2V models, a gap of 24.80 24.80 points. Even the best TI2V model, Seedance2.5 ( 43.23 43.23 ), falls well below Lyra2 ( 81.64 81.64 ). Control also has the largest standard deviation across world models, indicating substantial differences even among models with native camera or action interfaces. These results identify accurate execution of requested camera motion as a major obstacle to using current video generators as interactive worlds.
paragraphs.zh: 相机控制是两组模型之间最大的差距。 世界模型在控制方面的平均分为 57.29 57.29，而 TI2V 模型为 32.48 32.48，差距为 24.80 24.80 分。 即使是最好的 TI2V 模型 Seedance2.5（43.23 43.23），也远低于 Lyra2（81.64 81.64）。 控制在世界模型之间的标准差也最大，这表明即使在使用原生相机或动作接口的模型之间也存在显著差异。 这些结果表明，准确执行所请求的相机运动是当前视频生成器用作交互式世界的主要障碍。

paragraphs.en: Leading world models approach TI2V visual quality. TI2V models have higher mean visual quality ( 77.53 77.53 versus 71.80 71.80 ), but EVOKE reaches 76.48 76.48 , only 1.05 1.05 points below the TI2V mean. The best models in the two groups differ by 2.56 2.56 points. Within the TI2V group, the standard deviation is just 0.75 0.75 , the smallest of its six tiers. Under the current metrics, quality distinguishes TI2V models less clearly than control and consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 领先的世界模型在视觉质量上接近 TI2V 模型。 TI2V 模型的平均视觉质量更高（77.53 对 71.80），但 EVOKE 达到了 76.48，仅比 TI2V 的均值低 1.05 分。 两组中最优模型之间的差距为 2.56 分。 在 TI2V 组内部，标准差仅为 0.75，是其六个层级中最小的。 在当前指标下，质量对 TI2V 模型的区分度不如可控性和一致性那样清晰。

paragraphs.en: TI2V models generate strong 3D self-consistency despite weak control. TI2V models average 69.88 69.88 in 3D self-consistency, exceeding world models by 10.14 10.14 points. Cosmos3-Super ( 74.55 74.55 ) also surpasses the best world model, HY-WorldPlay ( 70.34 70.34 ). Its strong depth, cross-view feature, and regional-scale scores show that this advantage extends beyond reconstruction fidelity (Table 11 ). Thus, the TI2V control gap does not stem simply from an inability to generate internally consistent scenes. The challenge is to make those scenes unfold along the requested camera trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: TI2V 模型尽管控制能力较弱，却能生成很强的 3D 自一致性。 TI2V 模型在 3D 自一致性上平均得分为 69.88 69.88，超过世界模型 10.14 10.14 分。 Cosmos3-Super（74.55 74.55）也超过了最佳的世界模型 HY-WorldPlay（70.34 70.34）。 其在深度、跨视角特征和区域尺度上的高分表明，这一优势超越了重建保真度（表 11）。 因此，TI2V 的控制差距并非仅仅源于无法生成内部一致的场景。 挑战在于让这些场景沿所请求的相机轨迹展开。

paragraphs.en: Models differ substantially in generated-content persistence. The group means are close for both input preservation ( 64.30 64.30 for world models and 65.52 65.52 for TI2V) and generated-content persistence ( 57.29 57.29 and 59.55 59.55 ). Gen3C leads input preservation at 75.23 75.23 , while SolarWM-H3, Lyra2, and HY-WorldPlay match or exceed the best TI2V persistence score. Within each group, however, generated-content persistence varies more than input preservation: their standard deviations are 9.22 9.22 versus 4.79 4.79 for world models and 6.80 6.80 versus 3.91 3.91 for TI2V. Models differ more in their ability to maintain newly generated content than to preserve the input scene.
paragraphs.zh: 各模型在生成内容持久性方面差异显著。 两组在输入保持（世界模型为 64.30，TI2V 为 65.52）和生成内容持久性（分别为 57.29 和 59.55）上的组均值都很接近。 Gen3C 以 75.23 领先输入保持，而 SolarWM-H3、Lyra2 和 HY-WorldPlay 达到或超过了 TI2V 最好的持久性分数。 然而在每组内部，生成内容持久性的变化幅度大于输入保持：世界模型的标准差分别为 9.22 与 4.79，TI2V 为 6.80 与 3.91。 各模型在维持新生成内容方面的差异，大于其在保持输入场景方面的差异。

sents.en: Models differ substantially in generated-content persistence.
sents.zh: 各模型在生成内容持久性方面差异显著。

sents.en: The group means are close for both input preservation ( 64.30 64.30 for world models and 65.52 65.52 for TI2V) and generated-content persistence ( 57.29 57.29 and 59.55 59.55 ).
sents.zh: 两组在输入保持（世界模型为 64.30，TI2V 为 65.52）和生成内容持久性（分别为 57.29 和 59.55）上的组均值都很接近。

paragraphs.en: Leading world models match or exceed TI2V temporal stability. SolarWM-H3, EVOKE, and Echo-WM score 84.05 84.05 , 83.18 83.18 , and 82.69 82.69 in temporal stability, respectively, all above the best TI2V score of 80.39 80.39 from Seedance2.5. These world models generate autoregressively in causal chunks [ Huang et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ] , whereas TI2V generators such as LTX2.5 use bidirectional temporal attention within each clip [ Lightricks, 2026 ] . These causal models already match or exceed the temporal stability of bidirectional TI2V generators.
paragraphs.zh: 领先的世界模型在时间稳定性上达到或超过TI2V。 SolarWM-H3、EVOKE和Echo-WM在时间稳定性上分别得分84.05 84.05、83.18 83.18和82.69 82.69，均高于来自Seedance2.5的最佳TI2V得分80.39 80.39。 这些世界模型以因果块的方式进行自回归生成 [ Huang et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ] ，而诸如LTX2.5之类的TI2V生成器则在每个片段内使用双向时间注意力 [ Lightricks, 2026 ] 。 这些因果模型已经达到或超过双向TI2V生成器的时间稳定性。

sents.en: Leading world models match or exceed TI2V temporal stability.
sents.zh: 领先的世界模型在时间稳定性上达到或超过TI2V。

paragraphs.en: Input preservation measures fidelity to the input scene. Gen3C leads input preservation and Return. Figure 2 shows its advantage in both return and query views. In the first row, Gen3C’s return view most closely matches the input reference, while SolarWM-H3 and LingBot-World v2 show substantial forgetting. In the second row, Gen3C preserves both the appearance and spatial placement of key anchors, including the cabinet and lamp, closely matching the query reference, while other models place these anchors in incorrect relative positions.
paragraphs.zh: 输入保持衡量对输入场景的保真度。 Gen3C 在输入保持和 Return 上领先。 图 2 展示了其在 return 和 query 视图上的优势。 在第一行中，Gen3C 的 return 视图与输入参考最接近，而 SolarWM-H3 和 LingBot-World v2 出现明显遗忘。 在第二行中，Gen3C 保留了关键锚点的外观和空间位置，包括柜子和灯，与 query 参考高度吻合，而其他模型将这些锚点放置在错误的相对位置上。

sents.en: Input preservation measures fidelity to the input scene.
sents.zh: 输入保持衡量对输入场景的保真度。

sents.en: Gen3C leads input preservation and Return.
sents.zh: Gen3C 在输入保持和 Return 上领先。

sents.en: Figure 2 shows its advantage in both return and query views.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了其在 return 和 query 视图上的优势。

sents.en: In the first row, Gen3C’s return view most closely matches the input reference, while SolarWM-H3 and LingBot-World v2 show substantial forgetting.
sents.zh: 在第一行中，Gen3C 的 return 视图与输入参考最接近，而 SolarWM-H3 和 LingBot-World v2 出现明显遗忘。

sents.en: In the second row, Gen3C preserves both the appearance and spatial placement of key anchors, including the cabinet and lamp, closely matching the query reference, while other models place these anchors in incorrect relative positions.
sents.zh: 在第二行中，Gen3C 保留了关键锚点的外观和空间位置，包括柜子和灯，与 query 参考高度吻合，而其他模型将这些锚点放置在错误的相对位置上。

paragraphs.en: Input preservation requires complementary checks. SolarWM-H3 leads Query, while Cosmos3-Nano leads Identity (Table 3 ). Gen3C instead leads Return, showing that the three components favor different models. Query checks appearance and geometry at a new viewpoint, Identity tracks anchors during the input-to-query interval, and Return tests recovery of the initial scene after the full exploration trajectory. The three checks jointly assess input preservation during exploration and after return, covering failures that any one component alone would miss.
paragraphs.zh: 输入保持需要互补的检查。 SolarWM-H3 在 Query 上领先，而 Cosmos3-Nano 在 Identity 上领先（表 3）。 Gen3C 则在 Return 上领先，说明这三个组成部分偏好不同的模型。 Query 在新视点检查外观与几何，Identity 在输入到查询期间跟踪锚点，Return 则测试完整探索轨迹之后对初始场景的恢复。 这三项检查共同评估探索期间及返回之后的输入保持，覆盖了任何单一组成部分都会遗漏的失败情况。

sents.en: Input preservation requires complementary checks.
sents.zh: 输入保持需要互补的检查。

sents.en: SolarWM-H3 leads Query, while Cosmos3-Nano leads Identity (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: SolarWM-H3 在 Query 上领先，而 Cosmos3-Nano 在 Identity 上领先（表 3）。

sents.en: Gen3C instead leads Return, showing that the three components favor different models.
sents.zh: Gen3C 则在 Return 上领先，说明这三个组成部分偏好不同的模型。

sents.en: Query checks appearance and geometry at a new viewpoint, Identity tracks anchors during the input-to-query interval, and Return tests recovery of the initial scene after the full exploration trajectory.
sents.zh: Query 在新视点检查外观与几何，Identity 在输入到查询期间跟踪锚点，Return 则测试完整探索轨迹之后对初始场景的恢复。

sents.en: The three checks jointly assess input preservation during exploration and after return, covering failures that any one component alone would miss.
sents.zh: 这三项检查共同评估探索期间及返回之后的输入保持，覆盖了任何单一组成部分都会遗漏的失败情况。

paragraphs.en: Semantic similarity alone does not ensure visual fidelity. High semantic similarity between a first visit and revisit can coexist with poor perceptual fidelity (Figure 2 , bottom two rows). MiniMax-H3, for example, scores 77.27 77.27 on different-view DINO but only 17.32 17.32 on normalized same-view LPIPS (Table 4 ). A revisit can match the scene’s general content while changing textures and object appearance. Our tests therefore combine semantic, perceptual, and pixel-level comparisons to check both whether the same content reappears and whether its visual details are preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠语义相似度并不能保证视觉保真度。 首次访问与重访之间的高语义相似度，可能与较差的感知保真度并存（图2，最下面两行）。 例如，MiniMax-H3 在不同视角 DINO 上得分为 77.27 77.27，但在归一化同视角 LPIPS 上仅得 17.32 17.32（表4）。 重访可以在匹配场景整体内容的同时改变纹理和物体外观。 因此，我们的测试结合了语义、感知和像素级的比较，以同时检验相同内容是否重现，以及其视觉细节是否得到保留。

sents.en: Semantic similarity alone does not ensure visual fidelity.
sents.zh: 仅靠语义相似度并不能保证视觉保真度。

sents.en: High semantic similarity between a first visit and revisit can coexist with poor perceptual fidelity (Figure 2 , bottom two rows).
sents.zh: 首次访问与重访之间的高语义相似度，可能与较差的感知保真度并存（图2，最下面两行）。

sents.en: MiniMax-H3, for example, scores 77.27 77.27 on different-view DINO but only 17.32 17.32 on normalized same-view LPIPS (Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 例如，MiniMax-H3 在不同视角 DINO 上得分为 77.27 77.27，但在归一化同视角 LPIPS 上仅得 17.32 17.32（表4）。

sents.zh: 重访可以在匹配场景整体内容的同时改变纹理和物体外观。

sents.en: Our tests therefore combine semantic, perceptual, and pixel-level comparisons to check both whether the same content reappears and whether its visual details are preserved.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的测试结合了语义、感知和像素级的比较，以同时检验相同内容是否重现，以及其视觉细节是否得到保留。

paragraphs.en: Appearance consistency does not establish spatial agreement. Lyra2 leads several revisit-appearance measures, whereas HY-WorldPlay leads reprojected depth consistency and SolarWM-H3 leads surface agreement (Table 4 ). The appearance tests compare how the revisited content looks; the depth and surface tests check whether it occupies the same 3D locations. Preserving visual details and preserving the 3D layout therefore require separate checks.
paragraphs.zh: 外观一致性并不能确立空间一致性。 Lyra2 在多项重访外观指标上领先，而 HY-WorldPlay 在重投影深度一致性上领先，SolarWM-H3 在表面一致性上领先（表 4 ）。 外观测试比较重访内容的外观表现；深度和表面测试则检查其是否占据相同的三维位置。 因此，保留视觉细节与保留三维布局需要分开检验。

sents.en: Appearance consistency does not establish spatial agreement.
sents.zh: 外观一致性并不能确立空间一致性。

sents.en: Lyra2 leads several revisit-appearance measures, whereas HY-WorldPlay leads reprojected depth consistency and SolarWM-H3 leads surface agreement (Table 4 ).
sents.zh: Lyra2 在多项重访外观指标上领先，而 HY-WorldPlay 在重投影深度一致性上领先，SolarWM-H3 在表面一致性上领先（表 4 ）。

sents.en: The appearance tests compare how the revisited content looks; the depth and surface tests check whether it occupies the same 3D locations.
sents.zh: 外观测试比较重访内容的外观表现；深度和表面测试则检查其是否占据相同的三维位置。

sents.en: Preserving visual details and preserving the 3D layout therefore require separate checks.
sents.zh: 因此，保留视觉细节与保留三维布局需要分开检验。

paragraphs.en: Local cross-view agreement does not ensure coherent scene reconstruction. FantasyWorld ranks second among world models in cross-view feature consistency at both temporal intervals, but second to last in reconstruction PSNR (Appendix E.1.5 ). HY-WorldPlay likewise leads depth consistency and regional scale agreement without achieving the best reconstruction score. These ranking differences show that strong agreement between pairs of views does not necessarily mean that the generated views can be reconstructed into a coherent 3D scene. Reconstruction consequently provides a separate test of whether the video depicts one coherent scene throughout exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 局部的跨视角一致性并不能保证连贯的场景重建。 FantasyWorld 在两个时间区间的跨视角特征一致性上均位居世界模型第二名，但重建 PSNR 却接近垫底（附录 E.1.5）。 HY-WorldPlay 同样在深度一致性和区域尺度一致性上领先，但并未取得最佳的重建分数。 这些排名差异表明，成对视角之间的强一致性并不一定意味着生成的视角可以被重建为一个连贯的 3D 场景。 因此，重建为检验视频在整段探索过程中是否描绘同一个连贯场景提供了另一种测试手段。

sents.en: Local cross-view agreement does not ensure coherent scene reconstruction.
sents.zh: 局部的跨视角一致性并不能保证连贯的场景重建。

sents.en: FantasyWorld ranks second among world models in cross-view feature consistency at both temporal intervals, but second to last in reconstruction PSNR (Appendix E.1.5 ).
sents.zh: FantasyWorld 在两个时间区间的跨视角特征一致性上均位居世界模型第二名，但重建 PSNR 却接近垫底（附录 E.1.5）。

sents.en: HY-WorldPlay likewise leads depth consistency and regional scale agreement without achieving the best reconstruction score.
sents.zh: HY-WorldPlay 同样在深度一致性和区域尺度一致性上领先，但并未取得最佳的重建分数。

sents.en: These ranking differences show that strong agreement between pairs of views does not necessarily mean that the generated views can be reconstructed into a coherent 3D scene.
sents.zh: 这些排名差异表明，成对视角之间的强一致性并不一定意味着生成的视角可以被重建为一个连贯的 3D 场景。

sents.en: Reconstruction consequently provides a separate test of whether the video depicts one coherent scene throughout exploration.
sents.zh: 因此，重建为检验视频在整段探索过程中是否描绘同一个连贯场景提供了另一种测试手段。

paragraphs.en: We examine Spearman correlations between tier scores. Figure 4 reports model-level correlations separately for short and long videos within each model group.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验各层级得分之间的Spearman相关性。 图4分别针对每个模型组内的短视频和长视频报告了模型层面的相关性。

sents.en: We examine Spearman correlations between tier scores.
sents.zh: 我们检验各层级得分之间的Spearman相关性。

sents.en: Figure 4 reports model-level correlations separately for short and long videos within each model group.
sents.zh: 图4分别针对每个模型组内的短视频和长视频报告了模型层面的相关性。

paragraphs.en: Visual quality does not ensure 3D consistency. LingBot-World v2 ranks second among world models in visual quality, but twelfth in both input preservation and generated-content persistence, and fourteenth in 3D self-consistency. Gen3C shows the reverse: seventeenth in visual quality but first in input preservation. Across all models, visual quality has a rank correlation of only 0.33 0.33 with the mean of the three consistency tiers among world models and 0.21 0.21 among TI2V models. Figure 3 illustrates this discrepancy: LingBot-World v2 generates a detailed view but yields a less faithful reconstruction and weaker depth agreement than HY-WorldPlay. Visual quality alone therefore gives little assurance that a model preserves scene content or maintains a consistent 3D scene. This separation is consistent with WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] , which reports distinct strengths in visual fidelity, geometry, and downstream utility for driving world models.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉质量并不能保证3D一致性。 LingBot-World v2 在视觉质量方面位列世界模型第二，但在输入保留和生成内容持久性两项上均排名第十二，在3D自一致性上排名第十四。 Gen3C 则呈现出相反的情况：其视觉质量排名第十七，但输入保留排名第一。 在所有模型中，视觉质量与世界模型三类一致性指标均值之间的秩相关性仅为 0.33 0.33，在 TI2V 模型中仅为 0.21 0.21。 图3展示了这种差异：LingBot-World v2 生成了细节丰富的视图，但其重建的保真度和深度一致性都不如 HY-WorldPlay。 因此，仅凭视觉质量几乎无法保证模型能够保留场景内容或维持一致的3D场景。 这一分离现象与 WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 的结论一致，该工作指出驾驶世界模型在视觉保真度、几何精度和下游实用性方面各有不同的优势。

sents.en: Visual quality does not ensure 3D consistency.
sents.zh: 视觉质量并不能保证3D一致性。

sents.en: LingBot-World v2 ranks second among world models in visual quality, but twelfth in both input preservation and generated-content persistence, and fourteenth in 3D self-consistency.
sents.zh: LingBot-World v2 在视觉质量方面位列世界模型第二，但在输入保留和生成内容持久性两项上均排名第十二，在3D自一致性上排名第十四。
