sents.zh: Gen3C 则呈现出相反的情况：其视觉质量排名第十七，但输入保留排名第一。

sents.en: Across all models, visual quality has a rank correlation of only 0.33 0.33 with the mean of the three consistency tiers among world models and 0.21 0.21 among TI2V models.
sents.zh: 在所有模型中，视觉质量与世界模型三类一致性指标均值之间的秩相关性仅为 0.33 0.33，在 TI2V 模型中仅为 0.21 0.21。

sents.en: Figure 3 illustrates this discrepancy: LingBot-World v2 generates a detailed view but yields a less faithful reconstruction and weaker depth agreement than HY-WorldPlay.
sents.zh: 图3展示了这种差异：LingBot-World v2 生成了细节丰富的视图，但其重建的保真度和深度一致性都不如 HY-WorldPlay。

sents.en: Visual quality alone therefore gives little assurance that a model preserves scene content or maintains a consistent 3D scene.
sents.zh: 因此，仅凭视觉质量几乎无法保证模型能够保留场景内容或维持一致的3D场景。

sents.en: This separation is consistent with WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] , which reports distinct strengths in visual fidelity, geometry, and downstream utility for driving world models.
sents.zh: 这一分离现象与 WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] 的结论一致，该工作指出驾驶世界模型在视觉保真度、几何精度和下游实用性方面各有不同的优势。

paragraphs.en: Strong visual quality does not guarantee faithful execution of the requested scene and camera motion. Quality and control have weak rank agreement among world models ( 0.08 0.08 for short videos and 0.30 0.30 for long videos), and negative correlations among TI2V models ( − 0.43 -0.43 and − 0.26 -0.26 ). Short-video TI2V quality also correlates negatively with input preservation ( − 0.62 -0.62 ). In Table 2 , Cosmos3-Super leads quality but ranks sixth in control, while Seedance2.5 leads input preservation but ranks seventh in quality. Higher visual quality does not imply more accurate camera motion, and in short TI2V videos it can coincide with poorer input preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 出色的视觉质量并不能保证对所要求的场景和镜头运动的忠实执行。 质量与控制力在各世界模型之间的排名一致性较弱（短视频为 0.08，长视频为 0.30），在 TI2V 模型之间则呈负相关（-0.43 和 -0.26）。 短视频 TI2V 的质量也与输入保留度呈负相关（-0.62）。 在表 2 中，Cosmos3-Super 的质量领先但在控制力上排名第六，而 Seedance2.5 的输入保留度领先但质量排名第七。 更高的视觉质量并不意味着更精确的镜头运动，而且在短视频 TI2V 中，它还可能伴随着更差的输入保留度。

sents.en: Strong visual quality does not guarantee faithful execution of the requested scene and camera motion.
sents.zh: 出色的视觉质量并不能保证对所要求的场景和镜头运动的忠实执行。

sents.en: Quality and control have weak rank agreement among world models ( 0.08 0.08 for short videos and 0.30 0.30 for long videos), and negative correlations among TI2V models ( − 0.43 -0.43 and − 0.26 -0.26 ).
sents.zh: 质量与控制力在各世界模型之间的排名一致性较弱（短视频为 0.08，长视频为 0.30），在 TI2V 模型之间则呈负相关（-0.43 和 -0.26）。

sents.en: Short-video TI2V quality also correlates negatively with input preservation ( − 0.62 -0.62 ).
sents.zh: 短视频 TI2V 的质量也与输入保留度呈负相关（-0.62）。

sents.en: In Table 2 , Cosmos3-Super leads quality but ranks sixth in control, while Seedance2.5 leads input preservation but ranks seventh in quality.
sents.zh: 在表 2 中，Cosmos3-Super 的质量领先但在控制力上排名第六，而 Seedance2.5 的输入保留度领先但质量排名第七。

sents.en: Higher visual quality does not imply more accurate camera motion, and in short TI2V videos it can coincide with poorer input preservation.
sents.zh: 更高的视觉质量并不意味着更精确的镜头运动，而且在短视频 TI2V 中，它还可能伴随着更差的输入保留度。

paragraphs.en: Control and 3D self-consistency measure different capabilities. Lyra2 ranks first in control but seventh in 3D self-consistency, while HY-WorldPlay ranks sixteenth and first, respectively. Across world models, the rank correlation between the two tiers is only 0.09 0.09 in short videos and − 0.04 -0.04 in long videos (Figure 4 ). A model can generate views that agree with one another even when the camera follows the wrong path. Internal geometric agreement and accurate execution of camera commands are thus separate requirements for interactive world generation.
paragraphs.zh: 控制能力与三维自洽性衡量的是不同的能力。 Lyra2 在控制能力上排名第一，但在三维自洽性上排名第七，而 HY-WorldPlay 则分别排名第十六和第一。 在各世界模型中，这两个维度之间的排名相关性在短视频中仅为 0.09 0.09，在长视频中为 − 0.04 -0.04（图 4 ）。 即使相机沿着错误的路径运动，模型也可能生成彼此一致的画面。 因此，内部几何一致性与准确执行相机指令是交互式世界生成的两个独立要求。

sents.en: Control and 3D self-consistency measure different capabilities.
sents.zh: 控制能力与三维自洽性衡量的是不同的能力。

sents.en: Lyra2 ranks first in control but seventh in 3D self-consistency, while HY-WorldPlay ranks sixteenth and first, respectively.
sents.zh: Lyra2 在控制能力上排名第一，但在三维自洽性上排名第七，而 HY-WorldPlay 则分别排名第十六和第一。

sents.en: Across world models, the rank correlation between the two tiers is only 0.09 0.09 in short videos and − 0.04 -0.04 in long videos (Figure 4 ).
sents.zh: 在各世界模型中，这两个维度之间的排名相关性在短视频中仅为 0.09 0.09，在长视频中为 − 0.04 -0.04（图 4 ）。

sents.en: A model can generate views that agree with one another even when the camera follows the wrong path.
sents.zh: 即使相机沿着错误的路径运动，模型也可能生成彼此一致的画面。

sents.en: Internal geometric agreement and accurate execution of camera commands are thus separate requirements for interactive world generation.
sents.zh: 因此，内部几何一致性与准确执行相机指令是交互式世界生成的两个独立要求。

paragraphs.en: Preserving the input does not ensure preserving newly generated content. World-model input preservation and generated-content persistence have strongly aligned model rankings, but much weaker agreement across cases within each model. For short videos, the model-level correlation is 0.87 0.87 , compared with a mean within-model correlation of 0.35 0.35 ; the same pattern holds for long videos. Strong models tend to perform well on both tasks, yet a successful input-preservation case can still lose newly generated content at revisit. A model’s ability to recover the input scene therefore does not reliably predict whether it will preserve the regions it creates during exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 保留输入并不能确保保留新生成的内容。 世界模型输入保留与生成内容持久化在模型层面的排名高度一致，但同一模型在不同案例之间的一致性要弱得多。 对于短视频，模型层面的相关系数为 0.87，而模型内平均相关系数仅为 0.35；长视频也呈现同样的模式。 强模型往往在两项任务上都表现良好，但某个成功保留输入的案例在回访时仍可能丢失新生成的内容。 因此，智能体恢复输入场景的能力并不能可靠地预测它是否会保留其在探索过程中创建的区域。

sents.en: Preserving the input does not ensure preserving newly generated content.
sents.zh: 保留输入并不能确保保留新生成的内容。

sents.en: World-model input preservation and generated-content persistence have strongly aligned model rankings, but much weaker agreement across cases within each model.
sents.zh: 世界模型输入保留与生成内容持久化在模型层面的排名高度一致，但同一模型在不同案例之间的一致性要弱得多。

sents.en: For short videos, the model-level correlation is 0.87 0.87 , compared with a mean within-model correlation of 0.35 0.35 ; the same pattern holds for long videos.
sents.zh: 对于短视频，模型层面的相关系数为 0.87，而模型内平均相关系数仅为 0.35；长视频也呈现同样的模式。

sents.en: Strong models tend to perform well on both tasks, yet a successful input-preservation case can still lose newly generated content at revisit.
sents.zh: 强模型往往在两项任务上都表现良好，但某个成功保留输入的案例在回访时仍可能丢失新生成的内容。

sents.en: A model’s ability to recover the input scene therefore does not reliably predict whether it will preserve the regions it creates during exploration.
sents.zh: 因此，智能体恢复输入场景的能力并不能可靠地预测它是否会保留其在探索过程中创建的区域。

paragraphs.en: Following the camera path is not enough to preserve content during long exploration. Among world models, the correlation between control and input preservation falls from 0.63 0.63 in short videos to 0.32 0.32 in long videos; for generated-content persistence, it falls from 0.53 0.53 to 0.22 0.22 . Longer exploration requires models to preserve scene content across additional movements and revisits, even when they follow the requested camera path.
paragraphs.zh: 仅跟随相机路径不足以在长时间探索过程中保持内容。 在世界模型中，控制与输入保持之间的相关性从短视频中的 0.63 0.63 降至长视频中的 0.32 0.32；对于生成内容的持久性，该相关性从 0.53 0.53 降至 0.22 0.22。 更长的探索要求模型在额外的移动和重访过程中保持场景内容，即使它们遵循所请求的相机路径。

sents.en: Following the camera path is not enough to preserve content during long exploration.
sents.zh: 仅跟随相机路径不足以在长时间探索过程中保持内容。

sents.en: Among world models, the correlation between control and input preservation falls from 0.63 0.63 in short videos to 0.32 0.32 in long videos; for generated-content persistence, it falls from 0.53 0.53 to 0.22 0.22 .
sents.zh: 在世界模型中，控制与输入保持之间的相关性从短视频中的 0.63 0.63 降至长视频中的 0.32 0.32；对于生成内容的持久性，该相关性从 0.53 0.53 降至 0.22 0.22。

sents.en: Longer exploration requires models to preserve scene content across additional movements and revisits, even when they follow the requested camera path.
sents.zh: 更长的探索要求模型在额外的移动和重访过程中保持场景内容，即使它们遵循所请求的相机路径。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares all six trajectory templates using equal model weights within each group. The templates range from reversing a translation to circling an anchor or revealing an occluded region. These comparisons show which camera motions expose failures that are less apparent on a simple forward–backward path.
paragraphs.zh: 图5使用每组内相等的模型权重比较了全部六种轨迹模板。 这些模板的范围从反转平移，到绕锚点环绕，再到揭示被遮挡区域。 这些比较展示了哪些相机运动能暴露那些在简单前后运动路径上不太明显的失败情况。

sents.en: Figure 5 compares all six trajectory templates using equal model weights within each group.
sents.zh: 图5使用每组内相等的模型权重比较了全部六种轨迹模板。

sents.en: The templates range from reversing a translation to circling an anchor or revealing an occluded region.
sents.zh: 这些模板的范围从反转平移，到绕锚点环绕，再到揭示被遮挡区域。

sents.en: These comparisons show which camera motions expose failures that are less apparent on a simple forward–backward path.
sents.zh: 这些比较展示了哪些相机运动能暴露那些在简单前后运动路径上不太明显的失败情况。

paragraphs.en: TI2V models fall behind in camera control on every trajectory template. TI2V models score below world models in control on all six templates, for both short and long videos. On short forward–backward trajectories, their mean control is 44.05 44.05 , compared with 62.41 62.41 for world models. On orbit trajectories, the gap widens to 12.95 12.95 versus 53.15 53.15 . Meanwhile, TI2V visual quality remains within 76.70 76.70 – 77.94 77.94 across the short-video templates. These models can produce good-looking frames across camera motions, but translating a text instruction into the specified trajectory remains difficult, especially when position and viewing direction must change together.
paragraphs.zh: TI2V 模型在每个轨迹模板上的相机控制能力都落后。 在所有六个模板上，无论短视频还是长视频，TI2V 模型的控制得分都低于世界模型。 在短的前后轨迹上，其平均控制得分为 44.05 44.05 ，而世界模型为 62.41 62.41 。 在环绕轨迹上，差距扩大到 12.95 12.95 对 53.15 53.15 。 与此同时，TI2V 在各短视频模板上的视觉质量保持在 76.70 76.70 – 77.94 77.94 之间。 这些模型在各种相机运动下都能生成画面美观的帧，但将文本指令转换为指定的轨迹仍然困难，尤其是当位置和观察方向必须同时改变时。

sents.en: TI2V models fall behind in camera control on every trajectory template.
sents.zh: TI2V 模型在每个轨迹模板上的相机控制能力都落后。

sents.en: TI2V models score below world models in control on all six templates, for both short and long videos.
sents.zh: 在所有六个模板上，无论短视频还是长视频，TI2V 模型的控制得分都低于世界模型。

sents.en: On short forward–backward trajectories, their mean control is 44.05 44.05 , compared with 62.41 62.41 for world models.
sents.zh: 在短的前后轨迹上，其平均控制得分为 44.05 44.05 ，而世界模型为 62.41 62.41 。

sents.en: On orbit trajectories, the gap widens to 12.95 12.95 versus 53.15 53.15 .
Meanwhile, TI2V visual quality remains within 76.70 76.70 – 77.94 77.94 across the short-video templates.
sents.zh: 与此同时，TI2V 在各短视频模板上的视觉质量保持在 76.70 76.70 – 77.94 77.94 之间。

sents.en: These models can produce good-looking frames across camera motions, but translating a text instruction into the specified trajectory remains difficult, especially when position and viewing direction must change together.
sents.zh: 这些模型在各种相机运动下都能生成画面美观的帧，但将文本指令转换为指定的轨迹仍然困难，尤其是当位置和观察方向必须同时改变时。

paragraphs.en: Orbit motion challenges both camera control and scene preservation. For short world-model videos, orbit has the lowest mean control, input-preservation, and generated-content-persistence scores among the six templates. Control falls from 62.41 62.41 on forward–backward motion to 53.15 53.15 on orbit, while input preservation and generated-content persistence reach 61.83 61.83 and 60.97 60.97 . Circling an anchor repeatedly changes visible surfaces and occlusions. Simple reversal tests therefore underestimate the challenge of preserving a scene across different viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 轨道运动同时挑战相机控制与场景保持。 对于短世界模型视频而言，轨道运动在六个模板中具有最低的均值控制分、输入保持分与生成内容持续分。 控制分从前后运动上的 62.41 62.41 降至轨道运动上的 53.15 53.15，而输入保持分与生成内容持续分分别达到 61.83 61.83 和 60.97 60.97。 环绕锚点会反复改变可见表面与遮挡关系。 因此，简单的反转测试低估了在不同视角间保持场景的挑战。

sents.en: Orbit motion challenges both camera control and scene preservation.
sents.zh: 轨道运动同时挑战相机控制与场景保持。

sents.en: For short world-model videos, orbit has the lowest mean control, input-preservation, and generated-content-persistence scores among the six templates.
sents.zh: 对于短世界模型视频而言，轨道运动在六个模板中具有最低的均值控制分、输入保持分与生成内容持续分。

sents.en: Control falls from 62.41 62.41 on forward–backward motion to 53.15 53.15 on orbit, while input preservation and generated-content persistence reach 61.83 61.83 and 60.97 60.97 .
sents.zh: 控制分从前后运动上的 62.41 62.41 降至轨道运动上的 53.15 53.15，而输入保持分与生成内容持续分分别达到 61.83 61.83 和 60.97 60.97。

sents.en: Circling an anchor repeatedly changes visible surfaces and occlusions.
sents.zh: 环绕锚点会反复改变可见表面与遮挡关系。

sents.en: Simple reversal tests therefore underestimate the challenge of preserving a scene across different viewpoints.
sents.zh: 因此，简单的反转测试低估了在不同视角间保持场景的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Complex trajectories can still end in forgetting despite stronger control. For long world-model videos, peek-and-return has the highest control score ( 55.09 55.09 ) but the lowest generated-content persistence ( 37.32 37.32 ). Models can therefore follow this camera motion yet fail to preserve the content revealed during the peek. Preserving newly revealed content through changes in visibility remains difficult even when camera control is comparatively strong.
paragraphs.zh: 即使控制更强，复杂轨迹仍可能以遗忘告终。 对于长世界模型视频，「窥视并返回」的控制得分最高（55.09），但生成内容持久性最低（37.32）。 因此，模型能够跟随这种相机运动，却无法保留窥视期间揭示的内容。 即使相机控制相对较强，在可见性变化过程中保留新揭示的内容仍然困难。

sents.en: Complex trajectories can still end in forgetting despite stronger control.
sents.zh: 即使控制更强，复杂轨迹仍可能以遗忘告终。

sents.en: For long world-model videos, peek-and-return has the highest control score ( 55.09 55.09 ) but the lowest generated-content persistence ( 37.32 37.32 ).
sents.zh: 对于长世界模型视频，「窥视并返回」的控制得分最高（55.09），但生成内容持久性最低（37.32）。

sents.en: Models can therefore follow this camera motion yet fail to preserve the content revealed during the peek.
sents.zh: 因此，模型能够跟随这种相机运动，却无法保留窥视期间揭示的内容。

sents.en: Preserving newly revealed content through changes in visibility remains difficult even when camera control is comparatively strong.
sents.zh: 即使相机控制相对较强，在可见性变化过程中保留新揭示的内容仍然困难。

paragraphs.en: Figures 6 and 7 show temporal performance in visual quality, control, and local geometry for all models in successive five-second windows. Local geometry includes depth, feature, and regional-scale consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 图6和图7以连续的五秒窗口展示了所有模型在视觉质量、控制和局部几何方面的时间性能。 局部几何包括深度、特征以及区域尺度上的一致性。

sents.en: Figures 6 and 7 show temporal performance in visual quality, control, and local geometry for all models in successive five-second windows.
sents.zh: 图6和图7以连续的五秒窗口展示了所有模型在视觉质量、控制和局部几何方面的时间性能。

sents.en: Local geometry includes depth, feature, and regional-scale consistency.
sents.zh: 局部几何包括深度、特征以及区域尺度上的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Control declines most over time in leading models from both groups. Across SolarWM-H3, Lyra2, EVOKE, Echo-WM, and Gen3C, control drops by an average of 26.98 26.98 points from the first to the final five-second window of minute-long videos. For Seedance2.5, Kling3.0, and Cosmos3-Super, the corresponding decline is 23.25 23.25 points. Control declines more than visual quality or local geometry in every one of these eight models. SolarWM-H3 falls from 91.91 91.91 to 64.50 64.50 , and Cosmos3-Super from 60.26 60.26 to 34.94 34.94 . Sustaining accurate camera motion remains difficult for both groups.
paragraphs.zh: 在两组领先模型中，可控性随时间推移下降最多。 在 SolarWM-H3、Lyra2、EVOKE、Echo-WM 和 Gen3C 中，从一分钟视频的第一个五秒窗口到最后一个五秒窗口，可控性平均下降 26.98 26.98 分。 对于 Seedance2.5、Kling3.0 和 Cosmos3-Super，相应的下降幅度为 23.25 23.25 分。 在这八个模型中，可控性的下降幅度都超过视觉质量或局部几何。 SolarWM-H3 从 91.91 91.91 降至 64.50 64.50 ，Cosmos3-Super 从 60.26 60.26 降至 34.94 34.94 。 对两组模型而言，维持准确的相机运动仍然很困难。

sents.en: Control declines most over time in leading models from both groups.
sents.zh: 在两组领先模型中，可控性随时间推移下降最多。

sents.en: Across SolarWM-H3, Lyra2, EVOKE, Echo-WM, and Gen3C, control drops by an average of 26.98 26.98 points from the first to the final five-second window of minute-long videos.
sents.zh: 在 SolarWM-H3、Lyra2、EVOKE、Echo-WM 和 Gen3C 中，从一分钟视频的第一个五秒窗口到最后一个五秒窗口，可控性平均下降 26.98 26.98 分。

sents.en: For Seedance2.5, Kling3.0, and Cosmos3-Super, the corresponding decline is 23.25 23.25 points.
sents.zh: 对于 Seedance2.5、Kling3.0 和 Cosmos3-Super，相应的下降幅度为 23.25 23.25 分。

sents.en: Control declines more than visual quality or local geometry in every one of these eight models.
sents.zh: 在这八个模型中，可控性的下降幅度都超过视觉质量或局部几何。

sents.en: SolarWM-H3 falls from 91.91 91.91 to 64.50 64.50 , and Cosmos3-Super from 60.26 60.26 to 34.94 34.94 .
Sustaining accurate camera motion remains difficult for both groups.
sents.zh: 对两组模型而言，维持准确的相机运动仍然很困难。

paragraphs.en: TI2V visual quality remains stable while local geometry deteriorates. During minute-long generation, local geometry declines more than visual quality in seven of the eight TI2V models. The mean declines are 7.13 7.13 points for local geometry and only 2.08 2.08 for visual quality. Wan2.7, for example, loses 16.26 16.26 points in local geometry but only 3.11 3.11 in quality. Cosmos3-Super’s quality improves slightly while its geometry falls by 5.34 5.34 points. Visually stable frames therefore do not ensure that geometric agreement is maintained during long exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在局部几何劣化的同时，TI2V 的视觉质量保持稳定。 在长达一分钟的视频生成过程中，八个 TI2V 模型中有七个的局部几何下降幅度大于视觉质量。 局部几何的平均下降为 7.13 7.13 分，而视觉质量仅下降 2.08 2.08 分。 例如，Wan2.7 的局部几何下降 16.26 16.26 分，但质量仅下降 3.11 3.11 分。 Cosmos3-Super 的质量略有提升，而其几何下降 5.34 5.34 分。 因此，视觉上稳定的帧并不能保证在长时间探索过程中几何一致性得以保持。

sents.en: TI2V visual quality remains stable while local geometry deteriorates.
sents.zh: 在局部几何劣化的同时，TI2V 的视觉质量保持稳定。

sents.en: During minute-long generation, local geometry declines more than visual quality in seven of the eight TI2V models.
sents.zh: 在长达一分钟的视频生成过程中，八个 TI2V 模型中有七个的局部几何下降幅度大于视觉质量。

sents.en: The mean declines are 7.13 7.13 points for local geometry and only 2.08 2.08 for visual quality.
sents.zh: 局部几何的平均下降为 7.13 7.13 分，而视觉质量仅下降 2.08 2.08 分。

sents.en: Wan2.7, for example, loses 16.26 16.26 points in local geometry but only 3.11 3.11 in quality.
sents.zh: 例如，Wan2.7 的局部几何下降 16.26 16.26 分，但质量仅下降 3.11 3.11 分。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Super’s quality improves slightly while its geometry falls by 5.34 5.34 points.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Super 的质量略有提升，而其几何下降 5.34 5.34 分。

sents.en: Visually stable frames therefore do not ensure that geometric agreement is maintained during long exploration.
sents.zh: 因此，视觉上稳定的帧并不能保证在长时间探索过程中几何一致性得以保持。

paragraphs.en: Long trajectories make newly generated content much harder to preserve. Figure 5 shows lower generated-content persistence (Tier 4) on long videos for every trajectory template in both model groups. On forward–backward trajectories, scores fall from 66.21 66.21 to 40.96 40.96 for world models and from 67.74 67.74 to 44.58 44.58 for TI2V models. On peek-and-return, they fall from 64.29 64.29 to 37.32 37.32 and from 69.52 69.52 to 42.83 42.83 , respectively. The drop spans roughly 15 15 – 27 27 points across the six templates. Long exploration exposes forgetting even on simple forward–backward paths.

paragraphs.en: WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] complements quantitative metrics with human assessments of realism, physical plausibility, consistency, and safety. Here, we assess whether automatic scores reproduce human preferences in the overall ordering of models across the six evaluation tiers. We select 90 cases spanning six models and distribute the annotation tasks among 20 raters. Raters rank the available videos separately for all six tiers. Ties are allowed. The interface provides the input and query references, requested trajectory, generated videos, and revisit clips appropriate to each judgment.
paragraphs.zh: WorldLens [Liang et al., 2026b] 在定量指标之外，通过人类评估来补充对真实性、物理合理性、一致性和安全性的判断。 在此，我们评估自动评分能否在六个评估层级的整体模型排序上复现人类偏好。 我们选取覆盖六个模型的 90 个案例，并将标注任务分配给 20 名评分者。 评分者针对全部六个层级分别对可用视频进行排序，允许并列。 界面提供输入与查询参考、请求的轨迹、生成的视频，以及与各项判断相适应的复查片段。

sents.en: WorldLens [ Liang et al., 2026b ] complements quantitative metrics with human assessments of realism, physical plausibility, consistency, and safety.
sents.zh: WorldLens [Liang et al., 2026b] 在定量指标之外，通过人类评估来补充对真实性、物理合理性、一致性和安全性的判断。

sents.en: Here, we assess whether automatic scores reproduce human preferences in the overall ordering of models across the six evaluation tiers.
sents.zh: 在此，我们评估自动评分能否在六个评估层级的整体模型排序上复现人类偏好。

sents.en: We select 90 cases spanning six models and distribute the annotation tasks among 20 raters.
sents.zh: 我们选取覆盖六个模型的 90 个案例，并将标注任务分配给 20 名评分者。

sents.en: Raters rank the available videos separately for all six tiers. Ties are allowed.
sents.zh: 评分者针对全部六个层级分别对可用视频进行排序，允许并列。

sents.en: The interface provides the input and query references, requested trajectory, generated videos, and revisit clips appropriate to each judgment.
sents.zh: 界面提供输入与查询参考、请求的轨迹、生成的视频，以及与各项判断相适应的复查片段。

paragraphs.en: We convert rankings into relative preference scores, assigning 1 for a win, 0.5 for a tie, and 0 for a loss, and average across raters and cases. Human and automatic scores are compared on the same available cases. Spearman correlations between human and automatic model-level scores range from 0.859 0.859 to 0.921 0.921 across the six tiers, with temporal stability showing the highest agreement. The automatic tiers thus order models in agreement with human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将排名转换为相对偏好分数，胜记为1、平局记为0.5、负记为0，并在评分者和案例上取平均。 人类评分与自动评分在相同的可用案例上进行比较。 在六个层级上，人类评分与自动模型级评分之间的Spearman相关系数范围为0.859 0.859至0.921 0.921，其中时间稳定性的一致性最高。 因此，自动层级对模型的排序与人类判断一致。

sents.en: We convert rankings into relative preference scores, assigning 1 for a win, 0.5 for a tie, and 0 for a loss, and average across raters and cases.
sents.zh: 我们将排名转换为相对偏好分数，胜记为1、平局记为0.5、负记为0，并在评分者和案例上取平均。

sents.en: Human and automatic scores are compared on the same available cases.
sents.zh: 人类评分与自动评分在相同的可用案例上进行比较。

sents.en: Spearman correlations between human and automatic model-level scores range from 0.859 0.859 to 0.921 0.921 across the six tiers, with temporal stability showing the highest agreement.
sents.zh: 在六个层级上，人类评分与自动模型级评分之间的Spearman相关系数范围为0.859 0.859至0.921 0.921，其中时间稳定性的一致性最高。

sents.en: The automatic tiers thus order models in agreement with human judgments.
sents.zh: 因此，自动层级对模型的排序与人类判断一致。

paragraphs.en: AOrbia provides 720 exploration-and-revisit cases across indoor and outdoor environments and six motion protocols to evaluate input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. By distinguishing observed content from newly generated regions, and combining appearance, geometry, and held-out reconstruction tests, the benchmark diagnoses complementary aspects of whether generated videos depict a persistent 3D world.
paragraphs.zh: Orbia 提供了横跨室内外环境的 720 个探索与重访案例以及六种运动协议，用于评估输入保持、生成内容持久性和 3D 自一致性。 通过区分已观测内容与新生成区域，并结合外观、几何以及留出重建测试，该基准诊断了生成视频是否描绘一个持久 3D 世界的多个互补方面。

sents.en: AOrbia provides 720 exploration-and-revisit cases across indoor and outdoor environments and six motion protocols to evaluate input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency.
sents.zh: Orbia 提供了横跨室内外环境的 720 个探索与重访案例以及六种运动协议，用于评估输入保持、生成内容持久性和 3D 自一致性。

sents.en: By distinguishing observed content from newly generated regions, and combining appearance, geometry, and held-out reconstruction tests, the benchmark diagnoses complementary aspects of whether generated videos depict a persistent 3D world.
sents.zh: 通过区分已观测内容与新生成区域，并结合外观、几何以及留出重建测试，该基准诊断了生成视频是否描绘一个持久 3D 世界的多个互补方面。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation of 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models shows that strong visual quality and accurate control do not ensure 3D consistency, while local cross-view agreement can coexist with poor scene reconstruction. Preserving the input scene also does not reliably predict whether newly generated content survives a revisit. Minute-long exploration further exposes declining control, content forgetting, and geometric deterioration that visually stable frames can conceal. These findings motivate evaluating world models through both sustained exploration and explicit revisits, with separate tests of content retention and spatial coherence. We hope \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia supports more reliable comparisons and guides the development of models that maintain persistent spatial memory, follow camera commands, and preserve coherent scenes throughout exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对27个文本条件、动作条件和相机条件模型的评估表明，强大的视觉质量和准确的控制并不能保证3D一致性，而局部跨视角的一致也可能与糟糕的场景重建并存。 保留输入场景也不能可靠地预测新生成的内容在重访时是否能够存续。 长达一分钟探索进一步暴露出控制能力下降、内容遗忘和几何退化，而这些可能被视觉上稳定的帧所掩盖。 这些发现促使我们通过持续探索和显式重访来评估世界模型，并对内容保留和空间一致性分别进行测试。 我们希望 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 能够支持更可靠的比较，并引导开发能在整个探索过程中保持持久空间记忆、遵循相机指令并维护连贯场景的模型。

sents.en: Our evaluation of 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models shows that strong visual quality and accurate control do not ensure 3D consistency, while local cross-view agreement can coexist with poor scene reconstruction.
sents.zh: 我们对27个文本条件、动作条件和相机条件模型的评估表明，强大的视觉质量和准确的控制并不能保证3D一致性，而局部跨视角的一致也可能与糟糕的场景重建并存。

sents.en: Preserving the input scene also does not reliably predict whether newly generated content survives a revisit.
sents.zh: 保留输入场景也不能可靠地预测新生成的内容在重访时是否能够存续。

sents.en: Minute-long exploration further exposes declining control, content forgetting, and geometric deterioration that visually stable frames can conceal.
sents.zh: 长达一分钟探索进一步暴露出控制能力下降、内容遗忘和几何退化，而这些可能被视觉上稳定的帧所掩盖。

sents.en: These findings motivate evaluating world models through both sustained exploration and explicit revisits, with separate tests of content retention and spatial coherence.
sents.zh: 这些发现促使我们通过持续探索和显式重访来评估世界模型，并对内容保留和空间一致性分别进行测试。

sents.en: We hope \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia supports more reliable comparisons and guides the development of models that maintain persistent spatial memory, follow camera commands, and preserve coherent scenes throughout exploration.
sents.zh: 我们希望 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 能够支持更可靠的比较，并引导开发能在整个探索过程中保持持久空间记忆、遵循相机指令并维护连贯场景的模型。

paragraphs.en: AOrbia contains 𝟕𝟐𝟎 \mathbf{720} evaluation cases and 𝟖𝟓𝟗 \mathbf{859} anchor evaluation targets . The dataset combines varied scenes with registered reference views and repeatable camera trajectories, enabling comparisons of how models preserve observed content and maintain newly generated regions during exploration.
paragraphs.zh: AOrbia 包含 𝟕𝟐𝟎 \mathbf{720} 个评测用例和 𝟖𝟓𝟗 \mathbf{859} 个锚点评测目标。 该数据集将多样场景与已配准的参考视图和可复现的相机轨迹相结合，使得能够比较各模型在探索过程中如何保留已观测内容并维持新生成区域。

paragraphs.en: Scene coverage. Public datasets cover indoor rooms, streets, and natural environments. Self-captured videos add outdoor landmarks, while UE provides virtual scenes with rendered depth and known camera poses. This combination supports evaluation across real and simulated environments. We scanned 110,406 110{,}406 public videos and scenes, reduced them to 10,944 10{,}944 machine-selected candidates and an 881 881 -case diversity pool, and retained 240 240 public-data cases. Table 7 lists the raw sample counts and final source composition.

paragraphs.en: Annotated references. Each case provides an input image and a registered query view, with depth and anchor masks. Anchors occupy a median of 5.2 % 5.2\% of the input image and 5.4 % 5.4\% of the query image, so changes to these objects can be overlooked in whole-image scores. Their masks and depth enable object-level appearance and geometry comparisons. At the query view, input preservation is evaluated on surfaces visible in the input; newly revealed regions are evaluated at later registered revisits to the corresponding scene surfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 带标注的参考。 每个案例提供一张输入图像和一个配准的查询视角，并附有深度和锚点掩码。 锚点占输入图像的中位数 5.2 % 5.2\%，占查询图像的 5.4 % 5.4\%，因此这些物体的变化在全图评分中可能被忽略。 它们的掩码和深度使得物体级的外观与几何比较成为可能。 在查询视角下，输入保留性评估在输入中可见的表面上进行；新显露的区域则在后续配准的、对应场景表面的重访视角下评估。

sents.en: Annotated references.
sents.zh: 带标注的参考。

sents.en: Each case provides an input image and a registered query view, with depth and anchor masks.
sents.zh: 每个案例提供一张输入图像和一个配准的查询视角，并附有深度和锚点掩码。

sents.en: Anchors occupy a median of 5.2 % 5.2\% of the input image and 5.4 % 5.4\% of the query image, so changes to these objects can be overlooked in whole-image scores.
sents.zh: 锚点占输入图像的中位数 5.2 % 5.2\%，占查询图像的 5.4 % 5.4\%，因此这些物体的变化在全图评分中可能被忽略。

sents.en: Their masks and depth enable object-level appearance and geometry comparisons.
sents.zh: 它们的掩码和深度使得物体级的外观与几何比较成为可能。

sents.en: At the query view, input preservation is evaluated on surfaces visible in the input; newly revealed regions are evaluated at later registered revisits to the corresponding scene surfaces.
sents.zh: 在查询视角下，输入保留性评估在输入中可见的表面上进行；新显露的区域则在后续配准的、对应场景表面的重访视角下评估。

paragraphs.en: Exploration protocols. Each template contributes 80 80 short and 40 40 long cases. Forward–backward and lateral trajectories primarily change camera position, while yaw and orbit introduce larger orientation changes (Table 7 ). Long extensions preserve the short case’s initial scene and references while adding more revisits and longer intervals between them (Table 7 ), allowing us to assess content preservation as exploration continues.
paragraphs.zh: 探索协议。 每个模板贡献 80 80 个短案例和 40 40 个长案例。 前后与横向轨迹主要改变相机位置，而偏航和环绕则引入更大的朝向变化（表 7 ）。 长案例扩展保留了短案例的初始场景和参考内容，同时增加了更多重访及其之间更长的时间间隔（表 7 ），使我们能够评估随着探索继续进行的内容保持能力。

sents.en: Exploration protocols.
sents.zh: 探索协议。

sents.en: Each template contributes 80 80 short and 40 40 long cases.
sents.zh: 每个模板贡献 80 80 个短案例和 40 40 个长案例。

sents.en: Forward–backward and lateral trajectories primarily change camera position, while yaw and orbit introduce larger orientation changes (Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 前后与横向轨迹主要改变相机位置，而偏航和环绕则引入更大的朝向变化（表 7 ）。

sents.en: Long extensions preserve the short case’s initial scene and references while adding more revisits and longer intervals between them (Table 7 ), allowing us to assess content preservation as exploration continues.
sents.zh: 长案例扩展保留了短案例的初始场景和参考内容，同时增加了更多重访及其之间更长的时间间隔（表 7 ），使我们能够评估随着探索继续进行的内容保持能力。

paragraphs.en: The six trajectory templates vary how the camera explores a scene and revisits previously observed regions (Figure 11 ). Each case starts at P 0 P_{0} and includes a registered query pose P q P_{q} and a return pose P r P_{r} . The paired poses ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) provide two observations of content revealed during exploration. Section A.3 shows the trajectories and reference views for annotated examples from each of the four scene source groups.
paragraphs.zh: 这六种轨迹模板的变化方式体现在相机如何探索场景并重访先前观测过的区域（图11）。 每个案例都从 P 0 P_{0} 出发，并包含一个已配准的查询位姿 P q P_{q} 和一个返回位姿 P r P_{r} 。 成对的位姿 ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) 为探索过程中揭示的内容提供了两次观测。 第A.3节展示了来自四个场景来源组中各标注示例的轨迹与参考视图。

sents.en: The six trajectory templates vary how the camera explores a scene and revisits previously observed regions (Figure 11 ).
sents.zh: 这六种轨迹模板的变化方式体现在相机如何探索场景并重访先前观测过的区域（图11）。

sents.en: Each case starts at P 0 P_{0} and includes a registered query pose P q P_{q} and a return pose P r P_{r} .
sents.zh: 每个案例都从 P 0 P_{0} 出发，并包含一个已配准的查询位姿 P q P_{q} 和一个返回位姿 P r P_{r} 。

sents.en: The paired poses ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) provide two observations of content revealed during exploration.
sents.zh: 成对的位姿 ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) 为探索过程中揭示的内容提供了两次观测。

sents.en: Section A.3 shows the trajectories and reference views for annotated examples from each of the four scene source groups.
sents.zh: 第A.3节展示了来自四个场景来源组中各标注示例的轨迹与参考视图。

paragraphs.en: Forward–backward. The camera advances into the scene and retraces its path while maintaining its viewing direction. Changes in object size and occlusion test whether scene depth and object placement remain consistent as the camera approaches and retreats.
paragraphs.zh: 前进–后退。 摄像机向前推进进入场景，并在保持观察方向不变的情况下沿原路径返回。 物体尺寸和遮挡的变化用于测试当摄像机接近和后退时，场景深度与物体位置是否保持一致。

sents.en: Forward–backward.
sents.zh: 前进–后退。

sents.en: The camera advances into the scene and retraces its path while maintaining its viewing direction.
sents.zh: 摄像机向前推进进入场景，并在保持观察方向不变的情况下沿原路径返回。

sents.en: Changes in object size and occlusion test whether scene depth and object placement remain consistent as the camera approaches and retreats.
sents.zh: 物体尺寸和遮挡的变化用于测试当摄像机接近和后退时，场景深度与物体位置是否保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Lateral return. The camera moves sideways and returns while keeping a similar viewing direction. Nearby and distant surfaces shift by different amounts, testing whether the model preserves their relative depth and recovers surfaces that become temporarily occluded.
paragraphs.zh: 横向往返。 摄像机在保持相似观察方向的同时向侧面移动并返回。 近处和远处的表面以不同的幅度移动，以此测试模型是否保持它们的相对深度，并恢复暂时被遮挡的表面。

sents.en: Lateral return.
sents.zh: 横向往返。

sents.en: The camera moves sideways and returns while keeping a similar viewing direction.
sents.zh: 摄像机在保持相似观察方向的同时向侧面移动并返回。

sents.en: Nearby and distant surfaces shift by different amounts, testing whether the model preserves their relative depth and recovers surfaces that become temporarily occluded.
sents.zh: 近处和远处的表面以不同的幅度移动，以此测试模型是否保持它们的相对深度，并恢复暂时被遮挡的表面。

paragraphs.en: Yaw return. The camera rotates to reveal another part of the scene and then turns back, with little translation. This tests whether content remains recognizable after leaving the field of view and appearing again.
paragraphs.zh: 偏航回扫。 摄像机旋转以展现场景的另一部分，然后再转回来，几乎平移。 这测试内容在离开视野后再次出现时是否保持可辨识。

sents.en: Yaw return.
sents.zh: 偏航回扫。

sents.en: The camera rotates to reveal another part of the scene and then turns back, with little translation.
sents.zh: 摄像机旋转以展现场景的另一部分，然后再转回来，几乎平移。

sents.en: This tests whether content remains recognizable after leaving the field of view and appearing again.
sents.zh: 这测试内容在离开视野后再次出现时是否保持可辨识。

paragraphs.en: Arc return. The camera follows a curved trajectory through the scene before returning. The changing position and viewing direction reveal different sides of objects, testing whether their appearance and geometry remain consistent across changing viewpoints along the curved trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 弧形返回。 摄像机沿弧形轨迹穿过场景后再返回。 不断变化的位置和观察方向揭示物体的不同侧面，测试其外观和几何结构在沿弧形轨迹变化的视角下是否保持一致。

sents.en: Arc return.
sents.zh: 弧形返回。

sents.en: The camera follows a curved trajectory through the scene before returning.
sents.zh: 摄像机沿弧形轨迹穿过场景后再返回。

sents.en: The changing position and viewing direction reveal different sides of objects, testing whether their appearance and geometry remain consistent across changing viewpoints along the curved trajectory.
sents.zh: 不断变化的位置和观察方向揭示物体的不同侧面，测试其外观和几何结构在沿弧形轨迹变化的视角下是否保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Orbit around an anchor. The camera moves around an anchor while looking toward it. Observing the same object from multiple directions tests whether its shape and position relative to surrounding objects remain consistent when viewed from different sides and at different points along the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕锚点进行环绕运动。 摄像机在围绕锚点移动的同时朝向该锚点观看。 从多个方向观察同一物体，可以检验其形状以及相对于周围物体的位置，在从不同侧面观看时以及在轨迹的不同时间点上是否保持一致。

sents.en: Orbit around an anchor.
sents.zh: 围绕锚点进行环绕运动。

sents.en: The camera moves around an anchor while looking toward it.
sents.zh: 摄像机在围绕锚点移动的同时朝向该锚点观看。

sents.en: Observing the same object from multiple directions tests whether its shape and position relative to surrounding objects remain consistent when viewed from different sides and at different points along the trajectory.
sents.zh: 从多个方向观察同一物体，可以检验其形状以及相对于周围物体的位置，在从不同侧面观看时以及在轨迹的不同时间点上是否保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Peek-and-return. The camera passes an anchor near the starting view, explores a previously unseen region, and returns. A second excursion revisits that region, providing the pair ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) to test whether newly generated content is retained between visits.
paragraphs.zh: 窥视并返回。 摄像机在起始视角附近经过一个锚点，探索一片此前未见过的区域，然后返回。 第二次探察会重访该区域，提供 ( P first , P revisit )（P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}）这一对数值，用以测试新生成的内容在两次到访之间是否被保留。

sents.en: Peek-and-return.
sents.zh: 窥视并返回。

sents.en: The camera passes an anchor near the starting view, explores a previously unseen region, and returns.
sents.zh: 摄像机在起始视角附近经过一个锚点，探索一片此前未见过的区域，然后返回。

sents.en: A second excursion revisits that region, providing the pair ( P first , P revisit ) (P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}) to test whether newly generated content is retained between visits.
sents.zh: 第二次探察会重访该区域，提供 ( P first , P revisit )（P_{\mathrm{first}},P_{\mathrm{revisit}}）这一对数值，用以测试新生成的内容在两次到访之间是否被保留。

paragraphs.en: Constructing an \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia case requires a pair of registered reference views, anchors that can be verified across those views, and a camera trajectory that supports exploration and revisits. We describe how these components are assembled from different sources, extended to one minute, and reviewed before release. Table 7 reports dataset statistics, and Appendix A.3 presents annotated examples.
paragraphs.zh: 构建一个 \texorpdfstring \pdfxform AOrbia 案例需要一对配准的参考视图、可在这些视图间验证的锚点，以及一条支持探索与重访的相机轨迹。 我们描述这些组件如何从不同来源组装、扩展到一分钟，并在发布前进行审核。 表 7 报告了数据集统计信息，附录 A.3 给出了带标注的示例。

sents.en: We describe how these components are assembled from different sources, extended to one minute, and reviewed before release.
sents.zh: 我们描述这些组件如何从不同来源组装、扩展到一分钟，并在发布前进行审核。

paragraphs.en: Following Section 3.2 , our pipeline connects observed scene references with designed camera motion in four stages. Two registered RGB-D views provide the input and query references at P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} . A synthesized trajectory passes through these poses and returns to P 0 P_{0} at P r P_{r} , enabling controlled exploration without recording every intermediate view.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循第3.2节，我们的流程分四个阶段将观测到的场景参考与设计的相机运动连接起来。 两个配准的RGB-D视图提供位于 P 0 P_{0} 和 P q P_{q} 处的输入参考与查询参考。 一条合成的轨迹经过这些位姿并在 P r P_{r} 处返回 P 0 P_{0} ，从而无需记录每个中间视图即可实现受控探索。

sents.en: Following Section 3.2 , our pipeline connects observed scene references with designed camera motion in four stages.
sents.zh: 遵循第3.2节，我们的流程分四个阶段将观测到的场景参考与设计的相机运动连接起来。

sents.en: Two registered RGB-D views provide the input and query references at P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} .
sents.zh: 两个配准的RGB-D视图提供位于 P 0 P_{0} 和 P q P_{q} 处的输入参考与查询参考。

sents.en: A synthesized trajectory passes through these poses and returns to P 0 P_{0} at P r P_{r} , enabling controlled exploration without recording every intermediate view.
sents.zh: 一条合成的轨迹经过这些位姿并在 P r P_{r} 处返回 P 0 P_{0} ，从而无需记录每个中间视图即可实现受控探索。

paragraphs.en: Select reference views. Prepare depth and camera annotations, then identify input–query pairs compatible with the translation and rotation of a trajectory template. Candidate pairs should provide a meaningful viewpoint change while keeping a recognizable landmark visible in both views.
paragraphs.zh: 选择参考视图。 准备深度与相机标注，然后确定与轨迹模板的平移和旋转相兼容的输入–查询对。 候选对应提供有意义的视角变化，同时确保可识别的地标在两个视图中均可见。

sents.en: Select reference views.
sents.zh: 选择参考视图。

sents.en: Prepare depth and camera annotations, then identify input–query pairs compatible with the translation and rotation of a trajectory template.
sents.zh: 准备深度与相机标注，然后确定与轨迹模板的平移和旋转相兼容的输入–查询对。

sents.en: Candidate pairs should provide a meaningful viewpoint change while keeping a recognizable landmark visible in both views.
sents.zh: 候选对应提供有意义的视角变化，同时确保可识别的地标在两个视图中均可见。

paragraphs.en: Verify anchors across views. Obtain an object mask at each endpoint and check that both masks identify the same static object or structure. Project the input anchor into the query view using depth and cameras to identify the surfaces that can be compared across views.
paragraphs.zh: 在多视角之间验证锚点。 在每个端点获取物体掩码，并检查两个掩码是否识别出同一个静态物体或结构。 使用深度和相机将输入锚点投影到查询视角，以识别可在多视角之间进行比较的表面。

sents.en: Verify anchors across views.
sents.zh: 在多视角之间验证锚点。

sents.en: Obtain an object mask at each endpoint and check that both masks identify the same static object or structure.
sents.zh: 在每个端点获取物体掩码，并检查两个掩码是否识别出同一个静态物体或结构。

sents.en: Project the input anchor into the query view using depth and cameras to identify the surfaces that can be compared across views.
sents.zh: 使用深度和相机将输入锚点投影到查询视角，以识别可在多视角之间进行比较的表面。

paragraphs.en: Construct exploration and revisits. Fit a smooth trajectory through the reference poses and check its motion against the available scene geometry. Select a first visit and a later revisit to a region outside the input view, recording the intervening exploration and the surfaces visible at both visits.
paragraphs.zh: 构建探索与重访。 拟合一条通过参考位姿的平滑轨迹，并对照可用的场景几何检查其运动。 选择对输入视野之外某一区域的首次访问和之后的重访，记录其间的探索过程以及两次访问时可见的表面。

sents.en: Construct exploration and revisits.
sents.zh: 构建探索与重访。

sents.en: Fit a smooth trajectory through the reference poses and check its motion against the available scene geometry.
sents.zh: 拟合一条通过参考位姿的平滑轨迹，并对照可用的场景几何检查其运动。

sents.en: Select a first visit and a later revisit to a region outside the input view, recording the intervening exploration and the surfaces visible at both visits.
sents.zh: 选择对输入视野之外某一区域的首次访问和之后的重访，记录其间的探索过程以及两次访问时可见的表面。

paragraphs.en: Rank, review, and annotate. Rank candidates by image, anchor, trajectory, and revisit quality. Human reviewers inspect the proposed annotations and trajectories, correct unsuitable choices, and select the final cases. A VLM produces a factual scene caption for model conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 排序、审查和标注。 根据图像、锚点、轨迹和重访质量对候选进行排序。 人工审查员检查提出的标注和轨迹，纠正不合适的选择，并选出最终案例。 视觉语言模型生成事实性场景描述用于模型条件化。

sents.en: Rank, review, and annotate.
sents.zh: 排序、审查和标注。

sents.en: Rank candidates by image, anchor, trajectory, and revisit quality.
sents.zh: 根据图像、锚点、轨迹和重访质量对候选进行排序。

sents.en: Human reviewers inspect the proposed annotations and trajectories, correct unsuitable choices, and select the final cases.
sents.zh: 人工审查员检查提出的标注和轨迹，纠正不合适的选择，并选出最终案例。

sents.en: A VLM produces a factual scene caption for model conditioning.
sents.zh: 视觉语言模型生成事实性场景描述用于模型条件化。

paragraphs.en: The sources differ in which components are available initially. Public videos require view selection from recorded camera motion. ScanNet++ additionally provides a semantic mesh for anchor and visibility annotation. For UE and self-capture, we choose landmarks and trajectory templates during acquisition. The procedures below adapt the common pipeline to these differences.
paragraphs.zh: 各数据源在初始可用组件方面有所不同。 公开视频需要从录制的相机运动中进行视角选择。 ScanNet++ 还额外提供了用于锚点和可见性标注的语义网格。 对于 UE 和自采数据，我们在采集过程中选择地标和轨迹模板。 下述流程针对这些差异对通用流水线进行了适配。

sents.en: The sources differ in which components are available initially.
sents.zh: 各数据源在初始可用组件方面有所不同。

sents.en: Public videos require view selection from recorded camera motion.
sents.zh: 公开视频需要从录制的相机运动中进行视角选择。

sents.en: ScanNet++ additionally provides a semantic mesh for anchor and visibility annotation.
sents.zh: ScanNet++ 还额外提供了用于锚点和可见性标注的语义网格。

sents.en: For UE and self-capture, we choose landmarks and trajectory templates during acquisition.
sents.zh: 对于 UE 和自采数据，我们在采集过程中选择地标和轨迹模板。

sents.en: The procedures below adapt the common pipeline to these differences.
sents.zh: 下述流程针对这些差异对通用流水线进行了适配。

paragraphs.en: SpatialVID [ Wang et al., 2026a ] , Sekai [ Li et al., 2025d ] , and MiraData [ Ju et al., 2024 ] broaden the range of real-world environments. Their recorded camera paths usually lack the revisits required by our protocols, so we extract suitable reference views and synthesize a new trajectory through them.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialVID [ Wang et al., 2026a ]、Sekai [ Li et al., 2025d ] 和 MiraData [ Ju et al., 2024 ] 拓宽了真实世界环境的范围。 它们记录的相机路径通常缺少我们的协议所要求的重访，因此我们提取合适的参考视角，并合成一条经过这些视角的新轨迹。

sents.en: SpatialVID [ Wang et al., 2026a ] , Sekai [ Li et al., 2025d ] , and MiraData [ Ju et al., 2024 ] broaden the range of real-world environments.
sents.zh: SpatialVID [ Wang et al., 2026a ]、Sekai [ Li et al., 2025d ] 和 MiraData [ Ju et al., 2024 ] 拓宽了真实世界环境的范围。

sents.en: Their recorded camera paths usually lack the revisits required by our protocols, so we extract suitable reference views and synthesize a new trajectory through them.
sents.zh: 它们记录的相机路径通常缺少我们的协议所要求的重访，因此我们提取合适的参考视角，并合成一条经过这些视角的新轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Prepare geometry and rank view pairs. We retain SpatialVID’s released depth and cameras and recover missing geometry for Sekai and MiraData with ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] . SpatialVID’s sparse geometry indices are mapped to the corresponding video frames, while the Sekai/MiraData adapter uses per-frame geometry. We filter registered pose pairs by each template’s translation and rotation requirements. Ranking favors motion compatible with the template and sufficient viewpoint change, while balancing template coverage and distributing candidates across different scenes and times within each video. Ranked alternatives allow another pair to be examined when the first fails annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 准备几何数据并对视角对进行排序。 我们保留 SpatialVID 已发布的深度和相机数据，并使用 ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] 恢复 Sekai 和 MiraData 中缺失的几何数据。 SpatialVID 的稀疏几何索引被映射到对应的视频帧，而 Sekai/MiraData 适配器则使用逐帧几何数据。 我们根据每个模板的平移和旋转要求对已配准的位姿对进行筛选。 排序时优先选择与模板兼容且视角变化充分的运动，同时兼顾模板覆盖率，并在每个视频内将候选分布到不同的场景和时间段。 当第一个配对标注失败时，排序后的备选项允许检验另一个配对。

sents.en: Prepare geometry and rank view pairs.
sents.zh: 准备几何数据并对视角对进行排序。

sents.en: We retain SpatialVID’s released depth and cameras and recover missing geometry for Sekai and MiraData with ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] .
sents.zh: 我们保留 SpatialVID 已发布的深度和相机数据，并使用 ViPE [ Huang et al., 2025a ] 恢复 Sekai 和 MiraData 中缺失的几何数据。

sents.en: SpatialVID’s sparse geometry indices are mapped to the corresponding video frames, while the Sekai/MiraData adapter uses per-frame geometry.
sents.zh: SpatialVID 的稀疏几何索引被映射到对应的视频帧，而 Sekai/MiraData 适配器则使用逐帧几何数据。

sents.en: We filter registered pose pairs by each template’s translation and rotation requirements.
sents.zh: 我们根据每个模板的平移和旋转要求对已配准的位姿对进行筛选。

sents.en: Ranking favors motion compatible with the template and sufficient viewpoint change, while balancing template coverage and distributing candidates across different scenes and times within each video.
sents.zh: 排序时优先选择与模板兼容且视角变化充分的运动，同时兼顾模板覆盖率，并在每个视频内将候选分布到不同的场景和时间段。

sents.en: Ranked alternatives allow another pair to be examined when the first fails annotation.
sents.zh: 当第一个配对标注失败时，排序后的备选项允许检验另一个配对。

paragraphs.en: Propose and segment landmarks. A VLM [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] examines five frames spanning the candidate pair, including both endpoints and three approximately evenly spaced intermediate frames. Figure 16 presents the anchor-selection instructions. It proposes static, bounded landmarks that are visually distinctive and recognizable at both endpoints. SAM3 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] segments each proposal independently in the two reference images. We check mask area, connectivity, and completeness, remove duplicate proposals, and track shortlisted objects between views to verify that the endpoint masks identify the same physical landmark.
paragraphs.zh: 提出并分割地标。 一个视觉语言模型（VLM）[ Qwen Team, 2026 ] 检查覆盖候选帧对的五个帧，包括两个端点帧和三个大致均匀间隔的中间帧。 图 16 展示了锚点选择的指令。 它提出静态的、有边界范围的地标，这些地标在视觉上具有区分度，并且在两个端点处均可识别。 SAM3 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] 在两张参考图像中独立分割每个提议。 我们检查掩码的面积、连通性和完整性，去除重复的提议，并在两个视角之间跟踪入围的目标物体，以验证端点掩码识别的是同一个物理地标。

sents.en: Propose and segment landmarks.
sents.zh: 提出并分割地标。

sents.en: A VLM [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] examines five frames spanning the candidate pair, including both endpoints and three approximately evenly spaced intermediate frames.
sents.zh: 一个视觉语言模型（VLM）[ Qwen Team, 2026 ] 检查覆盖候选帧对的五个帧，包括两个端点帧和三个大致均匀间隔的中间帧。

sents.en: Figure 16 presents the anchor-selection instructions.
sents.zh: 图 16 展示了锚点选择的指令。

sents.en: It proposes static, bounded landmarks that are visually distinctive and recognizable at both endpoints.
sents.zh: 它提出静态的、有边界范围的地标，这些地标在视觉上具有区分度，并且在两个端点处均可识别。

sents.en: SAM3 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] segments each proposal independently in the two reference images.
sents.zh: SAM3 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] 在两张参考图像中独立分割每个提议。

sents.en: We check mask area, connectivity, and completeness, remove duplicate proposals, and track shortlisted objects between views to verify that the endpoint masks identify the same physical landmark.
sents.zh: 我们检查掩码的面积、连通性和完整性，去除重复的提议，并在两个视角之间跟踪入围的目标物体，以验证端点掩码识别的是同一个物理地标。

paragraphs.en: Filter fragmented masks and identity mismatches. The SpatialVID strict anchor profile accepts endpoint masks covering 0.3 % 0.3\% – 50 % 50\% of the image and requires tracking agreement of at least 0.8 0.8 IoU at both endpoints. Mask integrity is assessed through connected components and internal gaps. The largest component must contain at least 85 % 85\% of the mask, with at most one significant component and an internal-gap ratio no greater than 20 % 20\% . A component is significant when it contains at least the larger of 16 16 pixels and 0.2 % 0.2\% of the mask area. These checks remove fragmented regions and accidental merges of neighboring objects. Tracking then checks that independently segmented endpoint masks follow the same object through the video.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤碎片化的掩码和身份不匹配。 SpatialVID 严格锚点配置接受覆盖图像面积 0.3%–50% 的端点掩码，并要求两个端点的跟踪一致性至少达到 0.8 IoU。 掩码完整性通过连通分量和内部间隙来评估。 最大连通分量必须包含至少 85% 的掩码，显著分量最多一个，且内部间隙比率不超过 20%。 当一个连通分量包含至少 16 像素或掩码面积的 0.2%（取较大者）时，即为显著分量。 这些检查可移除碎片化区域以及相邻物体的意外合并。 接着，跟踪环节会检查独立分割的端点掩码在整个视频中是否跟随同一物体。

sents.en: Filter fragmented masks and identity mismatches.
sents.zh: 过滤碎片化的掩码和身份不匹配。

sents.en: The SpatialVID strict anchor profile accepts endpoint masks covering 0.3 % 0.3\% – 50 % 50\% of the image and requires tracking agreement of at least 0.8 0.8 IoU at both endpoints.
sents.zh: SpatialVID 严格锚点配置接受覆盖图像面积 0.3%–50% 的端点掩码，并要求两个端点的跟踪一致性至少达到 0.8 IoU。

sents.zh: 掩码完整性通过连通分量和内部间隙来评估。

sents.en: The largest component must contain at least 85 % 85\% of the mask, with at most one significant component and an internal-gap ratio no greater than 20 % 20\% .
sents.zh: 最大连通分量必须包含至少 85% 的掩码，显著分量最多一个，且内部间隙比率不超过 20%。

sents.en: A component is significant when it contains at least the larger of 16 16 pixels and 0.2 % 0.2\% of the mask area.
sents.zh: 当一个连通分量包含至少 16 像素或掩码面积的 0.2%（取较大者）时，即为显著分量。

sents.en: These checks remove fragmented regions and accidental merges of neighboring objects.
sents.zh: 这些检查可移除碎片化区域以及相邻物体的意外合并。

sents.en: Tracking then checks that independently segmented endpoint masks follow the same object through the video.
sents.zh: 接着，跟踪环节会检查独立分割的端点掩码在整个视频中是否跟随同一物体。

paragraphs.en: Verify shared anchor surfaces. We back-project pixels inside the input mask into 3D and project them into the query view. Visibility and depth agreement determine which parts of the query anchor correspond to surfaces observed in the input. This selects anchors that support a meaningful cross-view comparison even when the query reveals substantial new scene content. The resulting masks and projection overlays are retained for human inspection. For each projected sample, we check positive camera depth, image bounds, and agreement with the query depth. When several samples project to the same pixel, the nearest surface determines visibility. The retained pixels identify the part of an anchor that the input actually reveals. This distinction matters when a viewpoint change exposes another side of the same object: its identity can remain clear while only some of its surfaces have an input reference.
paragraphs.zh: 验证共享的锚点表面。 我们将输入掩码内的像素反投影到 3D 中，并投影到查询视图中。 可见性与深度一致性决定了查询锚点的哪些部分对应于输入中观察到的表面。 这会选择那些即使查询视图揭示了大量新场景内容时，仍能支持有意义跨视图比较的锚点。 生成的掩码和投影叠加图会被保留以供人工检查。 对于每个投影样本，我们检查相机深度是否为正、是否在图像边界内，以及与查询深度是否一致。 当多个样本投影到同一像素时，最近的表面决定可见性。 保留的像素标识了输入实际揭示的锚点部分。 这种区分在视角变化暴露同一物体的另一侧时尤为重要：该物体的身份可以保持清晰，而只有其部分表面拥有输入参考。

sents.en: Verify shared anchor surfaces.
sents.zh: 验证共享的锚点表面。

sents.en: We back-project pixels inside the input mask into 3D and project them into the query view.
sents.zh: 我们将输入掩码内的像素反投影到 3D 中，并投影到查询视图中。

sents.en: Visibility and depth agreement determine which parts of the query anchor correspond to surfaces observed in the input.
sents.zh: 可见性与深度一致性决定了查询锚点的哪些部分对应于输入中观察到的表面。

sents.en: This selects anchors that support a meaningful cross-view comparison even when the query reveals substantial new scene content.
sents.zh: 这会选择那些即使查询视图揭示了大量新场景内容时，仍能支持有意义跨视图比较的锚点。

sents.en: The resulting masks and projection overlays are retained for human inspection.
sents.zh: 生成的掩码和投影叠加图会被保留以供人工检查。

sents.en: For each projected sample, we check positive camera depth, image bounds, and agreement with the query depth.
sents.zh: 对于每个投影样本，我们检查相机深度是否为正、是否在图像边界内，以及与查询深度是否一致。

sents.en: When several samples project to the same pixel, the nearest surface determines visibility.
sents.zh: 当多个样本投影到同一像素时，最近的表面决定可见性。

sents.en: The retained pixels identify the part of an anchor that the input actually reveals.
sents.zh: 保留的像素标识了输入实际揭示的锚点部分。

sents.en: This distinction matters when a viewpoint change exposes another side of the same object: its identity can remain clear while only some of its surfaces have an input reference.
sents.zh: 这种区分在视角变化暴露同一物体的另一侧时尤为重要：该物体的身份可以保持清晰，而只有其部分表面拥有输入参考。

paragraphs.en: Synthesize the trajectory and select revisits. We fit the chosen template through P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} , preserving both reference poses and the final return. Available depth supports checks of camera motion and proximity to observed surfaces. Revisit selection considers temporal separation, camera-pose proximity, and shared surfaces outside the input view. Curved trajectories permit different viewpoints of the same region, while peek trajectories use repeated visits near the outward waypoint. Reviewers inspect the paired views together with their geometric overlap before accepting them.
paragraphs.zh: 合成轨迹并选择重访。 我们将所选模板拟合经过 P 0 P_{0} 和 P q P_{q} ，同时保留参考位姿和最终返回位姿。 可用的深度信息可用于校验相机运动以及与已观测表面的接近程度。 重访选择考虑时间间隔、相机位姿的邻近性，以及输入视野之外的共享表面。 弯曲轨迹允许从不同视角观察同一区域，而窥视轨迹则在向外航点附近进行重复访问。 审阅者在接受成对视图之前，会同时检查这些视图及其几何重叠情况。

sents.en: Synthesize the trajectory and select revisits.
sents.zh: 合成轨迹并选择重访。

sents.en: We fit the chosen template through P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} , preserving both reference poses and the final return.
sents.zh: 我们将所选模板拟合经过 P 0 P_{0} 和 P q P_{q} ，同时保留参考位姿和最终返回位姿。

sents.en: Available depth supports checks of camera motion and proximity to observed surfaces.
sents.zh: 可用的深度信息可用于校验相机运动以及与已观测表面的接近程度。

sents.en: Revisit selection considers temporal separation, camera-pose proximity, and shared surfaces outside the input view.
sents.zh: 重访选择考虑时间间隔、相机位姿的邻近性，以及输入视野之外的共享表面。

sents.en: Curved trajectories permit different viewpoints of the same region, while peek trajectories use repeated visits near the outward waypoint.
sents.zh: 弯曲轨迹允许从不同视角观察同一区域，而窥视轨迹则在向外航点附近进行重复访问。

sents.en: Reviewers inspect the paired views together with their geometric overlap before accepting them.
sents.zh: 审阅者在接受成对视图之前，会同时检查这些视图及其几何重叠情况。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm B.2.1 summarizes the shared-surface checks and event-pair annotation. Tolerances and acceptance criteria follow the geometric checks configured separately for each data source.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 B.2.1 总结了共享面检查与事件对标注。 容差与验收标准遵循为每个数据源分别配置的几何检查。

sents.en: Algorithm B.2.1 summarizes the shared-surface checks and event-pair annotation.
sents.zh: 算法 B.2.1 总结了共享面检查与事件对标注。

sents.en: Tolerances and acceptance criteria follow the geometric checks configured separately for each data source.
sents.zh: 容差与验收标准遵循为每个数据源分别配置的几何检查。

For camera-axis depth, X = P 0 ​ [ D 0 ​ ( u ) ​ K 0 − 1 ​ u ~ ; 1 ] X=P_{0}[D_{0}(u)K_{0}^{-1}\tilde{u};1] ; calibrated source adapters handle other depth representations. 2. paragraphs.zh: [!t] 算法 \theconstructionalgorithm 共享表面与重访标注 输入：已配准的深度、内参 K i K_{i}、相机到世界的位姿 P i P_{i}、端点锚框掩码 A 0 , A q A_{0},A_{q}、场景几何 G G，以及一条贯穿输入、查询和重访位姿的指定相机轨迹。 输出：查询锚框支持 M q M_{q}、一个首次访问/重访对、共享的未见表面掩码，以及几何诊断信息。A. 输入–查询共享锚框表面 1. 将有效的输入锚框像素反投影到世界坐标。 对于相机轴深度，X = P 0 ​ [ D 0 ​ ( u ) ​ K 0 − 1 ​ u ~ ; 1 ] X=P_{0}[D_{0}(u)K_{0}^{-1}\tilde{u};1]；标定过的源适配器可处理其他深度表示。2. 将 X X 变换到查询相机坐标系，x q = P q − 1 ​ X x_{q}=P_{q}^{-1}X，并投影到 v = π ⁡ ( K q ​ x q ) v=\pi(K_{q}x_{q})。 丢弃位于相机后方或图像之外的样本。 通过最近深度解决投影样本之间的竞争。3. 保留位于 A q A_{q} 内、具有有效查询证据且深度在源特定容差范围内一致的样本。 它们对应的查询像素构成 M q M_{q}。 记录支持大小和深度残差以用于锚框验证。B. 输入视图之外的共享表面 4. 对于指定的外访 i i，选择一个平移和旋转误差均较小的后续返回分支位姿 j j，同时遵守模板的事件顺序和时间间隔要求。5. 在 P 0 , P i , P j P_{0},P_{i},P_{j} 处对 G G 进行光线投射。 将有效的首次命中表面点量化到一个公共世界格点上，分别得到输入、外访和重访相机位姿对应的可见表面集合 V 0 , V i , V j V_{0},V_{i},V_{j}。6. 去除与输入可见格胞距离在排除半径 r r 内的格胞，并对剩余集合求交集：U i = V i ∖ 𝒩 r ​ ( V 0 ) , U j = V j ∖ 𝒩 r ​ ( V 0 ) , S = U i ∩ U j 。 U_{i}=V_{i}\setminus\mathcal{N}_{r}(V_{0}),\hskip 18.49988ptU_{j}=V_{j}\setminus\mathcal{N}_{r}(V_{0}),\hskip 18.49988ptS=U_{i}\cap U_{j}。 这里 𝒩 r \mathcal{N}_{r} 使用的是体素格胞之间的距离，而不仅仅是其中心的距离。7. 将 S S 映射回两个事件视图中的首次命中像素。 记录有效几何命中中的共享像素比例、有效支持计数以及位姿误差。 在保留该访问对供审核之前，先应用源特定的有效性检查和覆盖率分级。 几何：G G 为场景网格或由深度导出的代理几何。
