paragraphs.en: Visibility and unseen-surface labels refer to this available geometry at the input, outward-visit, and revisit camera poses used in the annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 可见性与未见过表面标签指的是标注中使用的输入、外访和重访相机位姿处的这一可用几何信息。

paragraphs.en: ScanNet++ [ Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ] provides indoor RGB-D observations, calibrated cameras, and semantic instance meshes. These annotations allow anchors and cross-view visibility to be derived directly from the reconstructed scene. The visibility operations in Algorithm B.2.1 use this mesh, with sensor-depth validity checks for registered reference pixels.
paragraphs.zh: ScanNet++ [Yeshwanth et al., 2023] 提供室内 RGB-D 观测、标定相机以及语义实例网格。 这些标注使得可以直接从重建场景中导出锚点和跨视角可见性。 算法 B.2.1 中的可见性操作使用该网格，并对已配准的参考像素进行传感器深度有效性检查。

sents.en: ScanNet++ [ Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ] provides indoor RGB-D observations, calibrated cameras, and semantic instance meshes.
sents.zh: ScanNet++ [Yeshwanth et al., 2023] 提供室内 RGB-D 观测、标定相机以及语义实例网格。

sents.en: These annotations allow anchors and cross-view visibility to be derived directly from the reconstructed scene.
sents.zh: 这些标注使得可以直接从重建场景中导出锚点和跨视角可见性。

sents.en: The visibility operations in Algorithm B.2.1 use this mesh, with sensor-depth validity checks for registered reference pixels.
sents.zh: 算法 B.2.1 中的可见性操作使用该网格，并对已配准的参考像素进行传感器深度有效性检查。

paragraphs.en: Select registered RGB-D endpoints. We use the iPhone RGB-D stream and calibrated poses to find view pairs compatible with each template. Selection checks image sharpness, valid depth, and camera displacement. The input view must contain a clearly identifiable static instance that remains visible from the query pose. RGB frames are center-cropped and resized together with their camera calibration. We evaluate candidate pairs using the selected instance’s visible surface area, allowing the rest of the query image to reveal new parts of the room. When several anchors are present, each retains its own masks and geometric checks so that a well-observed object can be selected independently of less suitable instances.
paragraphs.zh: 选择已注册的 RGB-D 端点。 我们使用 iPhone 的 RGB-D 视频流和标定后的位姿来寻找与每个模板兼容的视图对。 选择时会检查图像清晰度、有效深度以及相机位移。 输入视图必须包含一个清晰可识别的静态实例，并且该实例在查询位姿下仍然可见。 RGB 帧与其相机标定参数一起进行中心裁剪和缩放。 我们使用所选实例的可见表面面积来评估候选视图对，从而允许查询图像的其余部分展现房间的新区域。 当存在多个锚点时，每个锚点都保留自己的掩码和几何检查，以便可以从不太合适的实例中独立选择一个被良好观测的物体。

sents.en: Select registered RGB-D endpoints.
sents.zh: 选择已注册的 RGB-D 端点。

sents.en: We use the iPhone RGB-D stream and calibrated poses to find view pairs compatible with each template.
sents.zh: 我们使用 iPhone 的 RGB-D 视频流和标定后的位姿来寻找与每个模板兼容的视图对。

sents.en: Selection checks image sharpness, valid depth, and camera displacement.
sents.zh: 选择时会检查图像清晰度、有效深度以及相机位移。

sents.en: The input view must contain a clearly identifiable static instance that remains visible from the query pose.
sents.zh: 输入视图必须包含一个清晰可识别的静态实例，并且该实例在查询位姿下仍然可见。

sents.en: RGB frames are center-cropped and resized together with their camera calibration.
sents.zh: RGB 帧与其相机标定参数一起进行中心裁剪和缩放。

sents.en: We evaluate candidate pairs using the selected instance’s visible surface area, allowing the rest of the query image to reveal new parts of the room.
sents.zh: 我们使用所选实例的可见表面面积来评估候选视图对，从而允许查询图像的其余部分展现房间的新区域。

sents.en: When several anchors are present, each retains its own masks and geometric checks so that a well-observed object can be selected independently of less suitable instances.
sents.zh: 当存在多个锚点时，每个锚点都保留自己的掩码和几何检查，以便可以从不太合适的实例中独立选择一个被良好观测的物体。

paragraphs.en: Render instance masks and visible surfaces. We render anchor masks from the semantic mesh, assigning each pixel to the first visible surface along its camera ray. Anchors must have a recognizable silhouette, reliable depth, and enough common surface area for cross-view comparison. We exclude unbounded walls, floors, and ceilings, as well as transparent objects and masks that ambiguously combine several instances. Projecting the input-visible anchor surface into P q P_{q} identifies the part of the query mask used for input-preservation evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染实例掩码与可见表面。 我们从语义网格渲染锚点掩码，将每个像素分配给沿其相机光线方向首个可见的表面。 锚点必须具有可识别的轮廓、可靠的深度，以及足够的公共表面积以供跨视角比较。 我们排除无界的墙壁、地板和天花板，以及透明物体和模糊地合并了多个实例的掩码。 将输入可见的锚点表面投影到 P q P_{q}，可以确定用于输入保留评估的查询掩码部分。

sents.en: Render instance masks and visible surfaces.
sents.zh: 渲染实例掩码与可见表面。

sents.en: We render anchor masks from the semantic mesh, assigning each pixel to the first visible surface along its camera ray.
sents.zh: 我们从语义网格渲染锚点掩码，将每个像素分配给沿其相机光线方向首个可见的表面。

sents.en: Anchors must have a recognizable silhouette, reliable depth, and enough common surface area for cross-view comparison.
sents.zh: 锚点必须具有可识别的轮廓、可靠的深度，以及足够的公共表面积以供跨视角比较。

sents.en: We exclude unbounded walls, floors, and ceilings, as well as transparent objects and masks that ambiguously combine several instances.
sents.zh: 我们排除无界的墙壁、地板和天花板，以及透明物体和模糊地合并了多个实例的掩码。

sents.en: Projecting the input-visible anchor surface into P q P_{q} identifies the part of the query mask used for input-preservation evaluation.
sents.zh: 将输入可见的锚点表面投影到 P q P_{q}，可以确定用于输入保留评估的查询掩码部分。

paragraphs.en: Plan and check the camera trajectory. Translation and rotation are interpolated through the registered endpoints. The mesh supports checks of camera clearance, near-plane intersections, floor and ceiling distance, and abrupt motion. Validation examines the designated evaluation poses, 32 32 additional uniformly spaced poses, and the segments between sampled positions. Failed trajectories are replanned with different intermediate waypoints. Mesh visibility also identifies regions outside the initial view, from which we select temporally separated visits sharing visible surfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 规划并检查相机轨迹。 平移与旋转通过注册的端点进行插值。 该网格支持检查相机间隙、近平面相交、与地面和天花板的距离，以及突变运动。 验证会检查指定的评估位姿、额外 32 个均匀分布的位姿，以及采样位置之间的区段。 失败的轨迹会使用不同的中间路径点重新规划。 网格可见性还能识别初始视野之外的区域，我们从中选取时间上相互分离、且共享可见表面的访问点。

sents.en: Plan and check the camera trajectory.
sents.zh: 规划并检查相机轨迹。

sents.en: Translation and rotation are interpolated through the registered endpoints.
sents.zh: 平移与旋转通过注册的端点进行插值。

sents.en: The mesh supports checks of camera clearance, near-plane intersections, floor and ceiling distance, and abrupt motion.
sents.zh: 该网格支持检查相机间隙、近平面相交、与地面和天花板的距离，以及突变运动。

sents.en: Validation examines the designated evaluation poses, 32 32 additional uniformly spaced poses, and the segments between sampled positions.
sents.zh: 验证会检查指定的评估位姿、额外 32 个均匀分布的位姿，以及采样位置之间的区段。

sents.en: Failed trajectories are replanned with different intermediate waypoints.
sents.zh: 失败的轨迹会使用不同的中间路径点重新规划。

sents.en: Mesh visibility also identifies regions outside the initial view, from which we select temporally separated visits sharing visible surfaces.
sents.zh: 网格可见性还能识别初始视野之外的区域，我们从中选取时间上相互分离、且共享可见表面的访问点。

paragraphs.en: Associate revisits with scene surfaces. We record the mesh surfaces visible from P 0 P_{0} and compare this set with the surfaces visible at candidate revisit poses. Surfaces shared by two visits but absent from the input provide locations for generated-content evaluation. Ray visibility handles occlusion as the camera moves through the room. Pixels with invalid depth or unreliable mesh boundaries are excluded from the comparison. This produces reference masks tied to particular scene surfaces and lets reviewers inspect where the camera leaves the input-visible region and later returns.
paragraphs.zh: 将重访与场景表面关联起来。 我们记录从 P 0 P_{0} 可见的网格表面，并将该集合与候选重访位姿处可见的表面进行比较。 两次访问共享但输入中缺失的表面，为生成内容评估提供了位置。 光线可见性可处理相机在房间内移动时的遮挡问题。 深度无效或网格边界不可靠的像素被排除在比较之外。 这样就生成了与特定场景表面绑定的参考掩码，并让审阅者能够检查相机在何处离开输入可见区域以及之后在何处返回。

sents.en: Associate revisits with scene surfaces.
sents.zh: 将重访与场景表面关联起来。

sents.en: We record the mesh surfaces visible from P 0 P_{0} and compare this set with the surfaces visible at candidate revisit poses.
sents.zh: 我们记录从 P 0 P_{0} 可见的网格表面，并将该集合与候选重访位姿处可见的表面进行比较。

sents.en: Surfaces shared by two visits but absent from the input provide locations for generated-content evaluation.
sents.zh: 两次访问共享但输入中缺失的表面，为生成内容评估提供了位置。

sents.en: Ray visibility handles occlusion as the camera moves through the room.
sents.zh: 光线可见性可处理相机在房间内移动时的遮挡问题。

sents.en: Pixels with invalid depth or unreliable mesh boundaries are excluded from the comparison.
sents.zh: 深度无效或网格边界不可靠的像素被排除在比较之外。

sents.en: This produces reference masks tied to particular scene surfaces and lets reviewers inspect where the camera leaves the input-visible region and later returns.
sents.zh: 这样就生成了与特定场景表面绑定的参考掩码，并让审阅者能够检查相机在何处离开输入可见区域以及之后在何处返回。

paragraphs.en: UE provides synchronized images and geometric annotations along prescribed trajectories. We collect 48 48 virtual environments and render 365 365 candidate videos, retaining 180 180 cases after curation. Acquisition starts with a static scene actor and a trajectory template selected for the scene layout and its landmark.
paragraphs.zh: UE 在预设轨迹上提供同步的图像与几何标注。 我们收集了 48 个虚拟环境并渲染了 365 个候选视频，经筛选后保留 180 个案例。 采集首先由一个静态场景演员开始，并根据场景布局及其地标选择一条轨迹模板。

sents.en: UE provides synchronized images and geometric annotations along prescribed trajectories.
sents.zh: UE 在预设轨迹上提供同步的图像与几何标注。

sents.en: We collect 48 48 virtual environments and render 365 365 candidate videos, retaining 180 180 cases after curation.
sents.zh: 我们收集了 48 个虚拟环境并渲染了 365 个候选视频，经筛选后保留 180 个案例。

sents.en: Acquisition starts with a static scene actor and a trajectory template selected for the scene layout and its landmark.
sents.zh: 采集首先由一个静态场景演员开始，并根据场景布局及其地标选择一条轨迹模板。

paragraphs.en: Anchor selection and controlled rendering. We design each capture around a selected landmark and an exploration template. Scene selection, camera placement, and motion are reviewed together so that the resulting video provides both a recognizable anchor and meaningful changes in the surrounding view.
paragraphs.zh: 锚点选择与受控渲染。 我们围绕选定的地标和探索模板来设计每次采集。 场景选择、相机摆放和运动会被一起审视，从而使生成的视频既提供可识别的锚点，又在周围视野中呈现有意义的变化。

sents.en: Anchor selection and controlled rendering.
sents.zh: 锚点选择与受控渲染。

sents.en: We design each capture around a selected landmark and an exploration template.
sents.zh: 我们围绕选定的地标和探索模板来设计每次采集。

sents.en: Scene selection, camera placement, and motion are reviewed together so that the resulting video provides both a recognizable anchor and meaningful changes in the surrounding view.
sents.zh: 场景选择、相机摆放和运动会被一起审视，从而使生成的视频既提供可识别的锚点，又在周围视野中呈现有意义的变化。

paragraphs.en: Choose the scene and anchor. Annotators inspect a virtual environment and select a static object or structure with clear boundaries and a distinctive appearance. Figure 17 illustrates this selection in the UE editor. We favor bounded landmarks that remain recognizable under viewpoint changes, while avoiding thin repetitive geometry, foliage, transparent surfaces, and large unbounded regions. The anchor is associated with its scene Actor, or a group of Actors forming one semantic object, so that its identity remains fixed throughout rendering. Its location and bounds guide camera placement. The initial view should show the anchor clearly together with enough surrounding scene content to support exploration around the selected landmark and into the surrounding scene.
paragraphs.zh: 选择场景与锚点。 标注人员检查虚拟环境，并选择一个边界清晰、外观独特的静态物体或结构。 图 17 展示了在 UE 编辑器中的这一选择过程。 我们倾向于选择在视角变化下仍可辨识的有界地标，同时避免细长的重复几何体、植被、透明表面以及大范围无界区域。 该锚点与其所属的场景 Actor 相关联，或与共同构成一个语义对象的一组 Actor 相关联，从而使其身份在整个渲染过程中保持固定。 锚点的位置和边界用于指导相机放置。 初始视图应清晰地呈现该锚点，并包含足够的周围场景内容，以支持围绕所选地标以及向周围场景的探索。

sents.en: Choose the scene and anchor.
sents.zh: 选择场景与锚点。

sents.en: Annotators inspect a virtual environment and select a static object or structure with clear boundaries and a distinctive appearance.
sents.zh: 标注人员检查虚拟环境，并选择一个边界清晰、外观独特的静态物体或结构。

sents.en: Figure 17 illustrates this selection in the UE editor.
sents.zh: 图 17 展示了在 UE 编辑器中的这一选择过程。

sents.en: We favor bounded landmarks that remain recognizable under viewpoint changes, while avoiding thin repetitive geometry, foliage, transparent surfaces, and large unbounded regions.
sents.zh: 我们倾向于选择在视角变化下仍可辨识的有界地标，同时避免细长的重复几何体、植被、透明表面以及大范围无界区域。

sents.en: The anchor is associated with its scene Actor, or a group of Actors forming one semantic object, so that its identity remains fixed throughout rendering.
sents.zh: 该锚点与其所属的场景 Actor 相关联，或与共同构成一个语义对象的一组 Actor 相关联，从而使其身份在整个渲染过程中保持固定。

sents.en: Its location and bounds guide camera placement.
sents.zh: 锚点的位置和边界用于指导相机放置。

sents.en: The initial view should show the anchor clearly together with enough surrounding scene content to support exploration around the selected landmark and into the surrounding scene.
sents.zh: 初始视图应清晰地呈现该锚点，并包含足够的周围场景内容，以支持围绕所选地标以及向周围场景的探索。

paragraphs.en: Assign a trajectory and set its scale. We choose a template suited to the scene layout while balancing coverage across the six motion types. The anchor’s size, camera field of view, and an authored starting view determine the initial framing and a suitable travel distance or rotation range. Forward and lateral paths require room to translate, yaw requires a useful angular sweep, and arc and orbit paths require clearance around the landmark. Peek paths place the anchor near the initial view and extend into a region revealed during exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 分配轨迹并设置其尺度。 我们选择适合场景布局的模板，同时兼顾六种运动类型的覆盖均衡。 锚点的尺寸、相机视场以及设计的起始视图决定了初始取景以及合适的移动距离或旋转范围。 前向和横向路径需要平移空间，偏航需要有效的角度扫掠范围，弧线和环绕路径则需要在地标周围留出净空。 探视路径将锚点放置在初始视图附近，并延伸到探索过程中才会展现的区域。

sents.en: Assign a trajectory and set its scale.
sents.zh: 分配轨迹并设置其尺度。

sents.en: We choose a template suited to the scene layout while balancing coverage across the six motion types.
sents.zh: 我们选择适合场景布局的模板，同时兼顾六种运动类型的覆盖均衡。

sents.en: The anchor’s size, camera field of view, and an authored starting view determine the initial framing and a suitable travel distance or rotation range.
sents.zh: 锚点的尺寸、相机视场以及设计的起始视图决定了初始取景以及合适的移动距离或旋转范围。

sents.en: Forward and lateral paths require room to translate, yaw requires a useful angular sweep, and arc and orbit paths require clearance around the landmark.
sents.zh: 前向和横向路径需要平移空间，偏航需要有效的角度扫掠范围，弧线和环绕路径则需要在地标周围留出净空。

sents.en: Peek paths place the anchor near the initial view and extend into a region revealed during exploration.
sents.zh: 探视路径将锚点放置在初始视图附近，并延伸到探索过程中才会展现的区域。

paragraphs.en: Preview and refine the motion. Candidate paths are checked in UE for camera collisions and inspected through sparse renders of the input, intermediate exploration, query region, and return. Reviewers assess anchor scale, foreground occlusion, background content, and whether the motion visibly follows the intended template. Collision checks alone are insufficient because some visible geometry has no collision enabled. We therefore inspect the rendered views and adjust the starting position, travel direction, radius, or viewing direction when a trajectory is obstructed or poorly framed.
paragraphs.zh: 预览并调整运动。 候选路径在 UE 中进行相机碰撞检查，并通过输入、中间探索、查询区域和返回的稀疏渲染进行目视检查。 评审者评估锚点尺度、前景遮挡、背景内容，以及运动是否明显遵循预期的模板。 仅靠碰撞检查是不够的，因为某些可见几何体并未启用碰撞。 因此，当轨迹受阻或取景不佳时，我们会检查渲染视图并调整起始位置、行进方向、半径或观察方向。

sents.en: Preview and refine the motion.
sents.zh: 预览并调整运动。

sents.en: Candidate paths are checked in UE for camera collisions and inspected through sparse renders of the input, intermediate exploration, query region, and return.
sents.zh: 候选路径在 UE 中进行相机碰撞检查，并通过输入、中间探索、查询区域和返回的稀疏渲染进行目视检查。

sents.en: Reviewers assess anchor scale, foreground occlusion, background content, and whether the motion visibly follows the intended template.
sents.zh: 评审者评估锚点尺度、前景遮挡、背景内容，以及运动是否明显遵循预期的模板。

sents.en: Collision checks alone are insufficient because some visible geometry has no collision enabled.
sents.zh: 仅靠碰撞检查是不够的，因为某些可见几何体并未启用碰撞。

sents.en: We therefore inspect the rendered views and adjust the starting position, travel direction, radius, or viewing direction when a trajectory is obstructed or poorly framed.
sents.zh: 因此，当轨迹受阻或取景不佳时，我们会检查渲染视图并调整起始位置、行进方向、半径或观察方向。

paragraphs.en: Render the accepted sequence. The camera path is placed in a Level Sequence and rendered with Movie Render Queue. RGB, depth, and object IDs share the same camera sequence, and evaluated camera poses and intrinsics are recorded for geometric annotation. Object IDs provide the selected anchor’s visible mask at each frame; depth is converted to metric camera-axis Z Z . We allow assets and lighting to settle before capture, control exposure, and disable motion blur and depth of field to preserve clear reference images. The rendered video is then reviewed for smooth motion, loading artifacts, and anchor visibility before reference selection.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染已接受的序列。 相机路径被放置在一个关卡序列（Level Sequence）中，并使用 Movie Render Queue 进行渲染。 RGB、深度和物体 ID 共享同一相机序列，并记录评估出的相机位姿和内参以用于几何标注。 物体 ID 提供所选锚点在每帧的可见掩码；深度被转换为度量相机轴 Z Z。 我们允许资产和光照在采集前稳定下来，控制曝光，并禁用运动模糊和景深以保持清晰的参考图像。 随后对渲染的视频进行审查，检查运动是否平滑、是否存在加载伪影以及锚点是否可见，然后再进行参考选择。

sents.en: Render the accepted sequence.
sents.zh: 渲染已接受的序列。

sents.en: The camera path is placed in a Level Sequence and rendered with Movie Render Queue.
sents.zh: 相机路径被放置在一个关卡序列（Level Sequence）中，并使用 Movie Render Queue 进行渲染。

sents.en: RGB, depth, and object IDs share the same camera sequence, and evaluated camera poses and intrinsics are recorded for geometric annotation.
sents.zh: RGB、深度和物体 ID 共享同一相机序列，并记录评估出的相机位姿和内参以用于几何标注。

sents.en: Object IDs provide the selected anchor’s visible mask at each frame; depth is converted to metric camera-axis Z Z .
sents.zh: 物体 ID 提供所选锚点在每帧的可见掩码；深度被转换为度量相机轴 Z Z。

sents.en: We allow assets and lighting to settle before capture, control exposure, and disable motion blur and depth of field to preserve clear reference images.
sents.zh: 我们允许资产和光照在采集前稳定下来，控制曝光，并禁用运动模糊和景深以保持清晰的参考图像。

sents.en: The rendered video is then reviewed for smooth motion, loading artifacts, and anchor visibility before reference selection.
sents.zh: 随后对渲染的视频进行审查，检查运动是否平滑、是否存在加载伪影以及锚点是否可见，然后再进行参考选择。

paragraphs.en: Post-processing captured videos. We process the captured RGB videos together with their rendered depth, object masks, and camera poses to construct benchmark cases. This stage selects the input and query references, identifies visits to newly revealed regions, and maps the accepted observations to the benchmark timeline.
paragraphs.zh: 对已采集的视频进行后处理。 我们将采集的 RGB 视频与其渲染的深度、物体掩码和相机位姿一起处理，以构建基准测试案例。 该阶段选择输入与查询参考，识别对新揭示区域的访问，并将被接受的观测映射到基准测试时间线上。

sents.en: Post-processing captured videos.
sents.zh: 对已采集的视频进行后处理。

sents.en: We process the captured RGB videos together with their rendered depth, object masks, and camera poses to construct benchmark cases.
sents.zh: 我们将采集的 RGB 视频与其渲染的深度、物体掩码和相机位姿一起处理，以构建基准测试案例。

sents.en: This stage selects the input and query references, identifies visits to newly revealed regions, and maps the accepted observations to the benchmark timeline.
sents.zh: 该阶段选择输入与查询参考，识别对新揭示区域的访问，并将被接受的观测映射到基准测试时间线上。

paragraphs.en: Check reference-view quality. For the query, candidates must contain a visible anchor covering at least 0.5 % 0.5\% of the image and valid anchor depth. Projected input surfaces must explain at least 40 % 40\% of the query anchor. Reviewers choose among valid candidates using the RGB images, masks, and projected-surface overlays. The default query search also requires the anchor’s image-area fraction to retain at least half its value in the input. This avoids choosing a distant or heavily occluded observation in which the landmark is too small to evaluate.
paragraphs.zh: 检查参考视图质量。 对于查询，候选视图必须包含一个可见的锚点，覆盖图像至少 0.5 % 0.5\% 的面积，并具有有效的锚点深度。 投影的输入表面必须能解释查询锚点至少 40 % 40\% 的面积。 审核者根据 RGB 图像、掩码和投影表面叠加图，在有效候选视图之间进行选择。 默认的查询搜索还要求锚点的图像面积占比在输入中保留至少一半的数值。 这可以避免选择距离过远或严重遮挡的观测，在这些观测中地标太小而无法评估。

sents.en: Check reference-view quality.
sents.zh: 检查参考视图质量。

sents.en: For the query, candidates must contain a visible anchor covering at least 0.5 % 0.5\% of the image and valid anchor depth.
sents.zh: 对于查询，候选视图必须包含一个可见的锚点，覆盖图像至少 0.5 % 0.5\% 的面积，并具有有效的锚点深度。

sents.en: Projected input surfaces must explain at least 40 % 40\% of the query anchor.
sents.zh: 投影的输入表面必须能解释查询锚点至少 40 % 40\% 的面积。

sents.en: Reviewers choose among valid candidates using the RGB images, masks, and projected-surface overlays.
sents.zh: 审核者根据 RGB 图像、掩码和投影表面叠加图，在有效候选视图之间进行选择。

sents.en: The default query search also requires the anchor’s image-area fraction to retain at least half its value in the input.
sents.zh: 默认的查询搜索还要求锚点的图像面积占比在输入中保留至少一半的数值。

sents.en: This avoids choosing a distant or heavily occluded observation in which the landmark is too small to evaluate.
sents.zh: 这可以避免选择距离过远或严重遮挡的观测，在这些观测中地标太小而无法评估。

paragraphs.en: Select visits to newly revealed regions. Rendered depth and cameras identify surfaces absent from the input and visible at both candidate visits. The general selector requires more than 8 8 seconds between visits, a camera-center distance within 1 1 meter, and an orientation difference within 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} . Arc trajectories allow a larger positional difference when both views observe the same region. Peek trajectories use repeated visits near the outward waypoint. Candidates are ranked by newly observed surface content, shared visible surfaces, and temporal separation.
paragraphs.zh: 选择访问新揭示区域的视角。 利用渲染深度和相机识别输入中缺失且在两个候选访问点均可见的表面。 通用选择器要求两次访问间隔超过 8 8 秒、相机中心距离在 1 1 米以内，且朝向差异在 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} 以内。 弧线轨迹在两个视角观察同一区域时允许更大的位置差异。 窥视轨迹使用靠近外侧路径点的重复访问。 候选视角根据新观测到的表面内容、共享的可见表面以及时间间隔进行排序。

sents.en: Select visits to newly revealed regions.
sents.zh: 选择访问新揭示区域的视角。

sents.en: Rendered depth and cameras identify surfaces absent from the input and visible at both candidate visits.
sents.zh: 利用渲染深度和相机识别输入中缺失且在两个候选访问点均可见的表面。

sents.en: The general selector requires more than 8 8 seconds between visits, a camera-center distance within 1 1 meter, and an orientation difference within 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} .
sents.zh: 通用选择器要求两次访问间隔超过 8 8 秒、相机中心距离在 1 1 米以内，且朝向差异在 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} 以内。

sents.en: Arc trajectories allow a larger positional difference when both views observe the same region.
sents.zh: 弧线轨迹在两个视角观察同一区域时允许更大的位置差异。

sents.en: Peek trajectories use repeated visits near the outward waypoint.
sents.zh: 窥视轨迹使用靠近外侧路径点的重复访问。

sents.en: Candidates are ranked by newly observed surface content, shared visible surfaces, and temporal separation.
sents.zh: 候选视角根据新观测到的表面内容、共享的可见表面以及时间间隔进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Align the selected observations. We map RGB, depth, masks, and camera poses to the 357 357 -frame, 16 16 -FPS short protocol using the same source-frame indices. The mapping preserves the input, return, and selected evaluation events.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐所选的观测。 我们使用相同的源帧索引，将 RGB、深度、掩码和相机位姿映射到 357 357 帧、16 16 FPS 的短协议上。 该映射保留了输入、返回和所选的评估事件。

sents.en: Align the selected observations.
sents.zh: 对齐所选的观测。

sents.en: We map RGB, depth, masks, and camera poses to the 357 357 -frame, 16 16 -FPS short protocol using the same source-frame indices.
sents.zh: 我们使用相同的源帧索引，将 RGB、深度、掩码和相机位姿映射到 357 357 帧、16 16 FPS 的短协议上。

sents.en: The mapping preserves the input, return, and selected evaluation events.
sents.zh: 该映射保留了输入、返回和所选的评估事件。

paragraphs.en: We record 85 85 outdoor videos around selected landmarks to broaden scene coverage beyond the public collections. The intended anchor and template are specified before recording, and 60 60 cases are retained after review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在选定地标周围录制了 85 85 段户外视频，以将场景覆盖范围拓展至公开数据集之外。 在录制之前会预先指定目标锚点与模板，经过审查后保留了 60 60 个案例。

sents.en: We record 85 85 outdoor videos around selected landmarks to broaden scene coverage beyond the public collections.
sents.zh: 我们在选定地标周围录制了 85 85 段户外视频，以将场景覆盖范围拓展至公开数据集之外。

sents.en: The intended anchor and template are specified before recording, and 60 60 cases are retained after review.
sents.zh: 在录制之前会预先指定目标锚点与模板，经过审查后保留了 60 60 个案例。

paragraphs.en: Record the scene and recover geometry. Acquisition follows the assigned exploration template around a distinctive static landmark. We estimate depth and cameras with DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] , preserving the correspondence between source timestamps, RGB frames, and geometric annotations. The input is selected near the beginning of the recording, with adjustments for blur or exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 记录场景并恢复几何结构。 采集过程围绕一个具有辨识度的静态地标，按照指定的探索模板进行。 我们使用 DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] 估计深度和相机，保留源时间戳、RGB 帧与几何标注之间的对应关系。 输入选取自录制开始附近的位置，并针对模糊或曝光问题进行了调整。

sents.en: Record the scene and recover geometry.
sents.zh: 记录场景并恢复几何结构。

sents.en: Acquisition follows the assigned exploration template around a distinctive static landmark.
sents.zh: 采集过程围绕一个具有辨识度的静态地标，按照指定的探索模板进行。

sents.en: We estimate depth and cameras with DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] , preserving the correspondence between source timestamps, RGB frames, and geometric annotations.
sents.zh: 我们使用 DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] 估计深度和相机，保留源时间戳、RGB 帧与几何标注之间的对应关系。

sents.en: The input is selected near the beginning of the recording, with adjustments for blur or exposure.
sents.zh: 输入选取自录制开始附近的位置，并针对模糊或曝光问题进行了调整。

paragraphs.en: Annotate the designated landmark. Query candidates are selected according to the known template. SAM3 segments the anchor independently at the input and query views, and reviewers verify identity and choose the reference pair. Checks consider mask area, completeness, valid depth, and the query surfaces recovered by projecting the input anchor. The nominal projected-surface threshold is 40 % 40\% of the query mask. Here, the acquisition record already supplies the intended landmark. Review therefore concentrates on choosing sharp reference frames and confirming that segmentation follows that landmark in both views. The reviewer checks both endpoint images against the source recording to confirm that the masks follow the same physical landmark in both reference views.
paragraphs.zh: 标注指定的解剖标志点。 根据已知模板选择候选查询。 SAM3 在输入视角和查询视角下独立分割锚点，审阅者验证其身份并选择参考配对。 检查内容包括掩膜面积、完整性、有效深度，以及通过投影输入锚点恢复的查询表面。 名义投影表面阈值为查询掩膜的 40% 40\%。 在这里，采集记录已经提供了预期的解剖标志点。 因此审阅重点在于选择清晰的参考帧，并确认分割在两个视角中都遵循该解剖标志点。 审阅者将两端图像与原始录像进行比对，以确认掩膜在两个参考视角中均跟随同一物理解剖标志点。

sents.en: Annotate the designated landmark.
sents.zh: 标注指定的解剖标志点。

sents.en: Query candidates are selected according to the known template.
sents.zh: 根据已知模板选择候选查询。

sents.en: SAM3 segments the anchor independently at the input and query views, and reviewers verify identity and choose the reference pair.
sents.zh: SAM3 在输入视角和查询视角下独立分割锚点，审阅者验证其身份并选择参考配对。

sents.en: Checks consider mask area, completeness, valid depth, and the query surfaces recovered by projecting the input anchor.
sents.zh: 检查内容包括掩膜面积、完整性、有效深度，以及通过投影输入锚点恢复的查询表面。

sents.en: The nominal projected-surface threshold is 40 % 40\% of the query mask.
sents.zh: 名义投影表面阈值为查询掩膜的 40% 40\%。

sents.en: Here, the acquisition record already supplies the intended landmark.
sents.zh: 在这里，采集记录已经提供了预期的解剖标志点。

sents.en: Review therefore concentrates on choosing sharp reference frames and confirming that segmentation follows that landmark in both views.
sents.zh: 因此审阅重点在于选择清晰的参考帧，并确认分割在两个视角中都遵循该解剖标志点。

sents.en: The reviewer checks both endpoint images against the source recording to confirm that the masks follow the same physical landmark in both reference views.
sents.zh: 审阅者将两端图像与原始录像进行比对，以确认掩膜在两个参考视角中均跟随同一物理解剖标志点。

paragraphs.en: Regularize motion and select revisits. We synthesize a smooth trajectory through the selected reference poses, preserving the final return while removing irregularities in handheld motion. Estimated scene geometry supports selection of visits to newly revealed regions. Reviewers inspect the trajectory and paired views, retaining the selected anchors, reference frames, and geometric diagnostics.

sents.en: Regularize motion and select revisits.
sents.zh: 规范化运动并选择重访。

sents.en: We synthesize a smooth trajectory through the selected reference poses, preserving the final return while removing irregularities in handheld motion.

paragraphs.en: Long cases retain the short case’s input image, anchors, and registered reference views, providing a paired setting for examining degradation during extended exploration. paragraphs.en: Preserve the registered references. The standard extension copies the short trajectory from P 0 P_{0} through P q P_{q} , including its pose sequence. This keeps the initial exploration and cross-view checkpoint fixed. Some peek cases place P q P_{q} at the intermediate retraction between two excursions. Their extension lengthens the first excursion and adjusts the query time while preserving the registered P 0 P_{0} and P q P_{q} poses.

paragraphs.en: Extend motion within the same template. We increase travel distance or angular coverage while preserving the template’s characteristic motion. Timing follows the short trajectory’s median nonzero translation or angular speed. Forward and lateral paths explore farther before returning; yaw expands its sweep to 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} – 300 ∘ 300^{\circ} ; and arc paths retain their curved shape. Orbit preserves its anchor-centered motion, while peek preserves the outward movement into an unseen region and the subsequent return to the starting view.

paragraphs.en: Register three separated revisits. paragraphs.en: Validate and revise the extension. We check reference-pose preservation, the final return, revisit alignment, and motion continuity. paragraphs.en: Rank annotation quality. The large candidate pool makes exhaustive manual inspection costly: each case requires checking reference images, anchor masks, depth, and camera motion. We therefore use automatic quality scores to prioritize promising candidates, followed by human inspection and final selection. The score considers four aspects: 1 image sharpness ; 2 anchor quality , including area, placement, mask integrity, and depth consistency; 3 trajectory quality , including motion extent and uprightness or vertical stability; and 4 revisit quality , including shared unseen surfaces and pose agreement. These criteria favor clear reference views, well-defined landmarks, and informative exploration with verifiable revisits. Table 8 gives the component weights in the 70 70 -point scheme. For cases with multiple reliable anchors, the highest-scoring anchor determines the anchor term. Scores guide review order, while reviewers make the final acceptance and anchor-selection decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 对标注质量进行排序。 庞大的候选池使得穷举式人工检查代价高昂：每个案例都需要检查参考图像、锚点掩码、深度和相机运动。 因此，我们使用自动质量评分来优先筛选有前景的候选，随后进行人工检查和最终选择。 该评分考虑四个方面：1 图像清晰度；2 锚点质量，包括面积、放置位置、掩码完整性和深度一致性；3 轨迹质量，包括运动幅度和直立性或垂直稳定性；4 重访质量，包括共享的未见表面和位姿一致性。 这些标准倾向于选择清晰的参考视角、轮廓明确的地标，以及带有可验证重访的富有信息量的探索。 表 8 给出了该 70 分制评分方案中各组成部分的权重。 对于有多个可靠锚点的案例，由得分最高的锚点决定锚点项的分数。 分数用于指导审查顺序，而最终接受与否以及锚点选择由审查者决定。

paragraphs.en: Review scene suitability. We apply a dedicated VLM review after anchor, segmentation, and geometric checks have reduced the candidate pool. Early anchor search processes thousands of candidate frames, so postponing detailed scene review avoids spending additional inference on candidates that fail those checks. The anchor-selection prompt already includes an initial scene gate; this later pass rechecks scene suitability independently of anchor proposals and numerical quality scores (Figure 19 ). Separating this pass allows detailed review to concentrate on candidates that survive annotation and geometry checks. The scene reviewer receives five ordered raw frames and checks for shot changes, prominent moving subjects, poor visibility, severe weather or lens contamination, and intrusive subtitles or watermarks. It also records indoor or outdoor scene type. Anchor overlays, trajectory plots, and numerical scores are excluded from this review to keep the judgment focused on scene content. The pass/reject decision is recorded separately from the numerical ranking. Passing cases are ordered by their automatic scores within the template and indoor/outdoor groups for manual inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 审查场景适用性。 我们在锚点、分割和几何检查缩小候选池之后，应用一次专门的 VLM 审查。 早期锚点搜索会处理数千个候选帧，因此将详细的场景审查延后，可以避免在未通过那些检查的候选上花费额外的推理。 锚点选择的提示词中已经包含了初步的场景门控；这一后续步骤独立于锚点提议和数值质量分数，对场景适用性进行复核（图 19）。 将这一步骤独立出来，可以让详细审查集中于通过标注和几何检查的候选。 场景审查器接收五帧有序的原始帧，检查镜头切换、显著的移动主体、可见性差、恶劣天气或镜头污染，以及干扰性的字幕或水印。 它还记录室内或室外场景类型。 该审查中排除锚点叠加图、轨迹图和数值分数，以保持判断专注于场景内容。 通过/拒绝的判定与数值排名分开记录。 对于通过的案例，在模板内以及室内/室外分组内按其自动分数排序，以便人工检查。

sents.zh: 对于通过的案例，在模板内以及室内/室外分组内按其自动分数排序，以便人工检查。

paragraphs.en: Inspect and correct annotations. Figure 18 shows the manual review interface for a MiraData case; the Sekai orbit example is shown in Figure 42 in Appendix E.2 . The review interface presents input and query images, anchor overlays, projected input surfaces, alternative query frames, trajectory plots, and revisit pairs. Reviewers check anchor identity and mask completeness , template fit and camera motion , and the region shared across revisits . They can replace an anchor, change the query selection, or reject a case. Accepted manual choices are preserved during export. Top and side trajectory views help identify paths that rise through a ceiling, approach an observed wall, or make an abrupt turn. Reference overlays show missing object parts, neighboring objects included in a mask, and surfaces that become occluded at the query. The review record stores the chosen frame, retained anchor IDs, acceptance decisions, and comments or failure tags. These choices determine the final reference frames, anchor masks, and annotations exported for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 检查并修正标注。 图 18 展示了 MiraData 案例的人工审核界面；Sekai 轨道示例如附录 E.2 中的图 42 所示。 审核界面呈现输入图像与查询图像、锚点叠加、投影输入表面、备选查询帧、轨迹图以及重访对。 审核人员检查锚点身份与掩码完整性、模板贴合度与相机运动，以及重访之间共享的区域。 他们可以替换锚点、更改查询选择，或拒绝某个案例。 已接受的人工选择在导出过程中会被保留。 顶部和侧面轨迹视图有助于识别穿过天花板上升、靠近被观测墙面或发生急转弯的路径。 参考叠加可显示缺失的物体部分、被包含进掩码的邻近物体，以及在查询时被遮挡的表面。 审核记录存储所选帧、保留的锚点 ID、接受决策，以及备注或失败标签。 这些选择决定了最终导出用于评估的参考帧、锚点掩码和标注。

paragraphs.en: Curate diversity and add captions. We remove rejected candidates, group duplicates by source provenance, and balance trajectory templates while avoiding repeated use of the same scene content. A VLM annotates factual scene captions from sampled source frames for model conditioning, using the dedicated instructions in Figure 20 . The final record stores the selected references, anchors, review decisions, and source bindings. Annotation and manual curation required over 300 300 hours across the collection.

paragraphs.en: Model inputs. The public package contains an initial RGB image, a scene caption, and a requested camera trajectory with intrinsics. Images are standardized to 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 , with matching geometric annotations, and camera poses are expressed relative to the initial view. Short and long cases contain 357 357 and 961 961 poses, respectively, at 16 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: 模型输入。 公开数据包包含一张初始 RGB 图像、一个场景描述，以及一段带内参的期望相机轨迹。 图像被统一标准化为 1280 × 720 1280\times 720，并配有对应的几何标注，相机位姿以相对于初始视角的方式表示。 短序列和长序列分别包含 357 357 和 961 961 个位姿，帧率为 16 16 FPS。

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the metrics used in each of the six evaluation tiers, including their definitions, implementation, and tier-level aggregation. We also explain score normalization and aggregation into tier scores and the overall score.

paragraphs.en: Move Accuracy. We measure camera-local displacement over two frames. An interval is active when its speed exceeds 1% of the sequence’s mean speed. Directions are selected by unit-displacement components with magnitude above 0.5, using their signs to distinguish opposite directions. Multiple directions may be active together.
paragraphs.zh: 移动准确率。 我们测量相机坐标系下两帧之间的位移。 当某个区间的速度超过序列平均速度的1%时，该区间被视为活跃。 方向通过单位位移分量中幅值大于0.5的分量来选取，并利用其符号区分相反方向。 多个方向可以同时处于活跃状态。

paragraphs.en: Tier score. Registered pairs are averaged equally within each case. For same-pose pairs, the direct score weights RGB fidelity, patch DINO similarity, and direct depth consistency equally, with PSNR and LPIPS sharing the RGB contribution. Different-pose pairs use global DINO. The two branches are pooled by their valid case counts to obtain the direct-comparison score S direct S_{\mathrm{direct}} across the registered revisit pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 层级评分。 已配准的配对在每个案例内等权平均。 对于同位姿配对，直接评分等权衡量 RGB 保真度、图像块 DINO 相似度和直接深度一致性，其中 PSNR 和 LPIPS 共享 RGB 部分。 异位姿配对使用全局 DINO。 两个分支按其有效案例数量进行池化，从而在已配准的重访配对上得到直接比较评分 S direct S_{\mathrm{direct}}。

sents.zh: 层级评分。

sents.zh: 已配准的配对在每个案例内等权平均。

sents.en: Different-pose pairs use global DINO.
sents.zh: 异位姿配对使用全局 DINO。

sents.en: The two branches are pooled by their valid case counts to obtain the direct-comparison score S direct S_{\mathrm{direct}} across the registered revisit pairs.
sents.zh: 两个分支按其有效案例数量进行池化，从而在已配准的重访配对上得到直接比较评分 S direct S_{\mathrm{direct}}。

sents.en: The geometric score averages normalized reprojected DINO, depth consistency, and surface F-score equally.
sents.zh: 几何分数对归一化的重投影 DINO、深度一致性和表面 F 分数进行等权平均。

paragraphs.en: This tier tests whether generated views agree with a common 3D scene. Short- and medium-range frame pairs are fixed on the video timeline. Recovered depth and cameras establish correspondences between their shared visible surfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 该层级测试生成的视图是否与同一个三维场景保持一致。 短程和中程帧对在视频时间轴上是固定的。 恢复的深度和相机在它们共享的可见表面之间建立对应关系。

sents.en: This tier tests whether generated views agree with a common 3D scene.
sents.zh: 该层级测试生成的视图是否与同一个三维场景保持一致。

sents.en: Short- and medium-range frame pairs are fixed on the video timeline.
sents.zh: 短程和中程帧对在视频时间轴上是固定的。

sents.en: Recovered depth and cameras establish correspondences between their shared visible surfaces.
sents.zh: 恢复的深度和相机在它们共享的可见表面之间建立对应关系。

paragraphs.en: We measure relative depth disagreement on surfaces visible in both views:
paragraphs.zh: 我们测量在两个视图中均可见的表面上的相对深度分歧：

paragraphs.en: Here D ^ t \hat{D}_{t} is the estimated depth at frame t t , D ^ s → t ​ ( u ) \hat{D}_{s\to t}(u) is the source point’s depth in the target camera, and v ⁡ ( u ) v(u) is its projected pixel. The set Ω s → t \Omega_{s\to t} contains valid correspondences after image-bound and occlusion checks; ϵ \epsilon is a small positive constant. Each frame pair receives the mean of the two directional errors. Lower error indicates stronger agreement about the depth of shared surfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 D^t 是第 t 帧的估计深度，D^_{s→t}(u) 是源点在目标相机中的深度，v(u) 是其投影像素。 集合 Ω_{s→t} 包含经过图像边界和遮挡检查后的有效对应点；ϵ 是一个小的正常数。 每个帧对取两个方向误差的均值。 误差越低，表示对共享表面深度的一致性越强。

sents.en: Here D ^ t \hat{D}_{t} is the estimated depth at frame t t , D ^ s → t ​ ( u ) \hat{D}_{s\to t}(u) is the source point’s depth in the target camera, and v ⁡ ( u ) v(u) is its projected pixel.
sents.zh: 其中 D^t 是第 t 帧的估计深度，D^_{s→t}(u) 是源点在目标相机中的深度，v(u) 是其投影像素。

sents.en: The set Ω s → t \Omega_{s\to t} contains valid correspondences after image-bound and occlusion checks; ϵ \epsilon is a small positive constant.
sents.zh: 集合 Ω_{s→t} 包含经过图像边界和遮挡检查后的有效对应点；ϵ 是一个小的正常数。

sents.en: Each frame pair receives the mean of the two directional errors.
sents.zh: 每个帧对取两个方向误差的均值。

sents.en: Lower error indicates stronger agreement about the depth of shared surfaces.
sents.zh: 误差越低，表示对共享表面深度的一致性越强。

paragraphs.en: We average the two directional errors for each frame pair, then average pairs within the short- and medium-range groups. These groups use offsets of 8 and 32 frames, with at most 48 and 16 pairs, respectively. Pixels are sampled at stride four, with a relative target-occlusion tolerance of 0.10 0.10 . Short-range pairs measure local depth stability; medium-range pairs cover larger viewpoint changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每对帧取两个方向误差的平均值，再对短程组和中等程组内的各帧对取平均。 这两组分别使用 8 帧和 32 帧的偏移量，帧对数量分别不超过 48 和 16 对。 像素以步长 4 进行采样，相对目标遮挡容差为 0.10 0.10 。 短程帧对用于衡量局部深度稳定性；中等程帧对则覆盖更大的视角变化。

sents.en: We average the two directional errors for each frame pair, then average pairs within the short- and medium-range groups.
sents.zh: 我们对每对帧取两个方向误差的平均值，再对短程组和中等程组内的各帧对取平均。

sents.en: These groups use offsets of 8 and 32 frames, with at most 48 and 16 pairs, respectively.
sents.zh: 这两组分别使用 8 帧和 32 帧的偏移量，帧对数量分别不超过 48 和 16 对。

sents.en: Pixels are sampled at stride four, with a relative target-occlusion tolerance of 0.10 0.10 .
sents.zh: 像素以步长 4 进行采样，相对目标遮挡容差为 0.10 0.10 。

sents.en: Short-range pairs measure local depth stability; medium-range pairs cover larger viewpoint changes.
sents.zh: 短程帧对用于衡量局部深度稳定性；中等程帧对则覆盖更大的视角变化。

paragraphs.en: We compare DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] descriptors at geometrically matched locations:
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较在几何对齐位置处的 DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] 描述符：

paragraphs.en: Here I ^ t \hat{I}_{t} is the generated RGB frame, ϕ ⁡ ( I , a ) \phi(I,a) is the unit-normalized DINO descriptor for patch a a in image I I , and 𝒞 s → t \mathcal{C}_{s\to t} contains unique patch pairs induced by geometric correspondences.
paragraphs.zh: 此处 I ^ t \hat{I}_{t} 为生成的 RGB 帧，ϕ ⁡ ( I , a ) \phi(I,a) 为图像 I I 中图块 a a 的单位归一化 DINO 描述符，𝒞 s → t \mathcal{C}_{s\to t} 包含由几何对应关系诱导的唯一图块对。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate at most 16 pairs in each temporal group and average both projection directions. Each matched patch pair contributes once, preventing dense pixel correspondences from overweighting the same feature pair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个时间组中最多评估16对，并对两个投影方向取平均。 每个匹配的图像块对只贡献一次，防止密集的像素对应关系对同一特征对权重过高。

sents.en: We evaluate at most 16 pairs in each temporal group and average both projection directions.
sents.zh: 我们在每个时间组中最多评估16对，并对两个投影方向取平均。

sents.en: Each matched patch pair contributes once, preventing dense pixel correspondences from overweighting the same feature pair.
sents.zh: 每个匹配的图像块对只贡献一次，防止密集的像素对应关系对同一特征对权重过高。

sents.zh: 该指标衡量不同的图像区域是否隐含一致的相对深度尺度。

sents.en: We divide the target image into a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid and compute the median ratio ρ j = \operatorname ​ m ​ e ​ d ​ i ​ a ​ n ​ ( D ^ t / D ^ s → t ) \rho_{j}=\operatorname{median}(\hat{D}_{t}/\hat{D}_{s\to t}) in each sufficiently supported cell j j . The score is

paragraphs.en: Subtracting the median log-ratio removes a common multiplicative offset between the two depth maps. The remaining spread measures disagreement among regions. For example, if foreground furniture and a background wall require different relative scales, their cell ratios separate and the score increases. The median statistics reduce the influence of a few extreme depth samples; cells without enough correspondences are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 减去中位对数比值可以去除两个深度图之间共同的乘性偏移。 剩余的离散程度衡量各区域之间的不一致性。 例如，如果前景家具和背景墙面需要不同的相对尺度，它们的单元比值就会分离开，从而使分数增大。 中位统计量可以减少少数极端深度样本的影响；对应关系不足的单元会被排除。

sents.en: Subtracting the median log-ratio removes a common multiplicative offset between the two depth maps.
sents.zh: 减去中位对数比值可以去除两个深度图之间共同的乘性偏移。

sents.en: The remaining spread measures disagreement among regions.
sents.zh: 剩余的离散程度衡量各区域之间的不一致性。

sents.en: For example, if foreground furniture and a background wall require different relative scales, their cell ratios separate and the score increases.
sents.zh: 例如，如果前景家具和背景墙面需要不同的相对尺度，它们的单元比值就会分离开，从而使分数增大。

sents.en: The median statistics reduce the influence of a few extreme depth samples; cells without enough correspondences are excluded.
sents.zh: 中位统计量可以减少少数极端深度样本的影响；对应关系不足的单元会被排除。

paragraphs.en: This metric evaluates whether a Gaussian scene reconstructed from generated views reproduces other views of the same video. DA3 predicts the scene from 64 context frames, which we render at 16 disjoint held-out cameras. We compare each rendered image with its corresponding generated frame using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: 该指标评估从生成视角重建的高斯场景能否再现同一视频的其他视角。 DA3 从 64 个上下文帧预测场景，我们在 16 个互不重叠的保留相机处进行渲染。 我们使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 将每张渲染图像与其对应的生成帧进行比较。

sents.en: This metric evaluates whether a Gaussian scene reconstructed from generated views reproduces other views of the same video.
sents.zh: 该指标评估从生成视角重建的高斯场景能否再现同一视频的其他视角。

sents.en: DA3 predicts the scene from 64 context frames, which we render at 16 disjoint held-out cameras.
sents.zh: DA3 从 64 个上下文帧预测场景，我们在 16 个互不重叠的保留相机处进行渲染。

sents.en: We compare each rendered image with its corresponding generated frame using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
sents.zh: 我们使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 将每张渲染图像与其对应的生成帧进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Context and held-out frames are uniformly sampled from the estimated sequence. DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ] predicts Gaussians in a feedforward pass using context RGB, recovered poses, and intrinsics. Each fidelity measure is averaged over the 16 held-out views on pixels with finite positive rendered depth.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文帧和留出帧从估计序列中均匀采样。 DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ] 使用上下文 RGB、恢复的位姿和内参，在前向传播中预测高斯。 每项保真度指标在 16 个留出视图上，对具有有限正值渲染深度的像素取平均。

sents.en: Context and held-out frames are uniformly sampled from the estimated sequence.
sents.zh: 上下文帧和留出帧从估计序列中均匀采样。

sents.en: DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ] predicts Gaussians in a feedforward pass using context RGB, recovered poses, and intrinsics.
sents.zh: DA3 [ Lin et al., 2026 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ] 使用上下文 RGB、恢复的位姿和内参，在前向传播中预测高斯。

sents.en: Each fidelity measure is averaged over the 16 held-out views on pixels with finite positive rendered depth.
sents.zh: 每项保真度指标在 16 个留出视图上，对具有有限正值渲染深度的像素取平均。

paragraphs.en: Tier score. Depth, feature, regional-scale, and reconstruction scores receive equal weight:
paragraphs.zh: 层级得分。 深度、特征、区域尺度和重建得分权重相等：

sents.en: Tier score.
sents.zh: 层级得分。

sents.en: Depth, feature, regional-scale, and reconstruction scores receive equal weight:
sents.zh: 深度、特征、区域尺度和重建得分权重相等：

paragraphs.en: Depth and feature scores each average their normalized short- and medium-range components equally. The reconstruction score averages normalized PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS equally.
paragraphs.zh: 深度分数与特征分数各自将归一化的短程和中程分量等权重平均。 重建分数将归一化的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 等权重平均。

sents.en: Depth and feature scores each average their normalized short- and medium-range components equally.
sents.zh: 深度分数与特征分数各自将归一化的短程和中程分量等权重平均。

sents.en: The reconstruction score averages normalized PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS equally.
sents.zh: 重建分数将归一化的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 等权重平均。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate both short and minute-long videos in five-second windows, measuring both the average performance and its retention relative to the initial window. Each window uses the score mappings and full-sequence camera alignment defined for the preceding tiers. We evaluate three dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们以五秒为单位评估短视频和分钟级视频，测量其平均性能以及相对于首个窗口的性能保持率。 每个窗口均使用前一层级所定义的分数映射和全序列相机对齐。 我们评估三个维度：

sents.en: We evaluate both short and minute-long videos in five-second windows, measuring both the average performance and its retention relative to the initial window.
sents.zh: 我们以五秒为单位评估短视频和分钟级视频，测量其平均性能以及相对于首个窗口的性能保持率。

sents.en: Each window uses the score mappings and full-sequence camera alignment defined for the preceding tiers.
sents.zh: 每个窗口均使用前一层级所定义的分数映射和全序列相机对齐。

sents.en: We evaluate three dimensions:
sents.zh: 我们评估三个维度：

paragraphs.en: Quality. HPS, MUSIQ, and aesthetic quality.
paragraphs.zh: 质量。 HPS、MUSIQ 和美学质量。

sents.zh: 质量。

sents.en: HPS, MUSIQ, and aesthetic quality.
sents.zh: HPS、MUSIQ 和美学质量。

paragraphs.en: Control. translation, rotation, Move Accuracy, and Look Accuracy over applicable components.
paragraphs.zh: 控制。对适用组件的移动、旋转、移动精度（Move Accuracy）和注视精度（Look Accuracy）进行控制。

paragraphs.en: Geometry. cross-view depth, feature, and regional-scale consistency. Depth and feature each combine their two temporal groups with equal weight for the short- and medium-range comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 几何。跨视角深度、特征与区域尺度一致性。 深度和特征各自将两组时间组以相等权重结合，用于短程与中程比较。

sents.zh: 几何。跨视角深度、特征与区域尺度一致性。

sents.zh: 深度和特征各自将两组时间组以相等权重结合，用于短程与中程比较。

sents.en: Combining level and retention captures both the average scores achieved during exploration and the amount of decline relative to the initial five-second window.
sents.zh: 结合水平与保留率，既能刻画探索过程中达到的平均分数，又能刻画相对于最初五秒窗口的下降幅度。

paragraphs.en: Tier 6 weights quality, control, and geometry equally within each video. We average videos separately by horizon, then combine the short- and long-video means with weights of 30% and 70%.
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 层级在每个视频内对质量、控制和几何赋予同等权重。 我们按时长分别对各视频取平均，然后以 30% 和 70% 的权重将短视频与长视频的均值合并。

sents.en: Tier 6 weights quality, control, and geometry equally within each video.
sents.zh: 第 6 层级在每个视频内对质量、控制和几何赋予同等权重。

sents.en: We average videos separately by horizon, then combine the short- and long-video means with weights of 30% and 70%.
sents.zh: 我们按时长分别对各视频取平均，然后以 30% 和 70% 的权重将短视频与长视频的均值合并。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator recovers geometry and constructs Gaussian and feature representations for metric comparison. Measurements are normalized and combined into tier scores and the overall score.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器恢复几何信息，并构建高斯表示与特征表示以进行度量比较。 各项测量值经过归一化后合并为各层级得分和总分。

sents.zh: 各项测量值经过归一化后合并为各层级得分和总分。

paragraphs.en: Recover cameras and depth. We decode each generated video on its requested timeline, sample frames at stride two, and include the registered query, return, and revisit frames. DA3 Giant 1.1 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] estimates poses, intrinsics, depth, and confidence at processing resolution 504. Sequences with at most 240 sampled frames are processed jointly. Longer sequences use 120-frame streaming chunks with 30-frame overlap and SALAD loop closure. Chunk alignment places the estimates in a common coordinate system. Each recovered observation is stored with its video-frame index for subsequent event and cross-view comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复相机与深度。 我们在各自请求的时间轴上解码每个生成的视频，以步长为二采样帧，并纳入已配准的查询帧、返回帧和重访帧。 DA3 Giant 1.1 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] 在 504 的处理分辨率下估计位姿、内参、深度和置信度。 最多 240 个采样帧的序列被联合处理。 更长的序列使用 120 帧的流式分块、30 帧的重叠以及 SALAD 回环闭合。 分块对齐将各估计结果放置到一个共同的坐标系中。 每个恢复的观测都与其视频帧索引一同存储，以便后续进行事件间和跨视角的比较。

sents.en: Recover cameras and depth.
sents.zh: 恢复相机与深度。

sents.en: We decode each generated video on its requested timeline, sample frames at stride two, and include the registered query, return, and revisit frames.
sents.zh: 我们在各自请求的时间轴上解码每个生成的视频，以步长为二采样帧，并纳入已配准的查询帧、返回帧和重访帧。

sents.en: DA3 Giant 1.1 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] estimates poses, intrinsics, depth, and confidence at processing resolution 504.
sents.zh: DA3 Giant 1.1 [ Lin et al., 2026 ] 在 504 的处理分辨率下估计位姿、内参、深度和置信度。

sents.en: Sequences with at most 240 sampled frames are processed jointly.
sents.zh: 最多 240 个采样帧的序列被联合处理。

sents.en: Longer sequences use 120-frame streaming chunks with 30-frame overlap and SALAD loop closure.
sents.zh: 更长的序列使用 120 帧的流式分块、30 帧的重叠以及 SALAD 回环闭合。

sents.en: Chunk alignment places the estimates in a common coordinate system.
sents.zh: 分块对齐将各估计结果放置到一个共同的坐标系中。

sents.en: Each recovered observation is stored with its video-frame index for subsequent event and cross-view comparisons.
sents.zh: 每个恢复的观测都与其视频帧索引一同存储，以便后续进行事件间和跨视角的比较。

paragraphs.en: Predict Gaussians and render held-out views. From the sampled sequence, we select 64 context frames and 16 disjoint held-out frames. The context RGB images and recovered cameras are passed to DA3’s feedforward Gaussian prediction. Images are resized to 504 × 504 504\times 504 with matching intrinsics, and held-out cameras are expressed in the reconstruction’s coordinates and scale. We render RGB and depth at the 16 held-out cameras with gsplat, using a black background. These renders and their corresponding generated frames supply the reconstruction measurements in Tier 5.
paragraphs.zh: 预测高斯分布并渲染留出视图。 从采样的序列中，我们选取 64 个上下文帧和 16 个互不重叠的留出帧。 上下文 RGB 图像和恢复的相机被输入 DA3 的前馈高斯预测。 图像被调整为 504 × 504 504\times 504 并相应调整内参，留出相机以重建结果的坐标系和尺度表示。 我们使用 gsplat 在 16 个留出相机处渲染 RGB 和深度，背景为黑色。 这些渲染结果及其对应的生成帧为第 5 层提供重建测量。

sents.en: Predict Gaussians and render held-out views.
sents.zh: 预测高斯分布并渲染留出视图。

sents.en: From the sampled sequence, we select 64 context frames and 16 disjoint held-out frames.
sents.zh: 从采样的序列中，我们选取 64 个上下文帧和 16 个互不重叠的留出帧。

sents.en: The context RGB images and recovered cameras are passed to DA3’s feedforward Gaussian prediction.
sents.zh: 上下文 RGB 图像和恢复的相机被输入 DA3 的前馈高斯预测。

sents.en: Images are resized to 504 × 504 504\times 504 with matching intrinsics, and held-out cameras are expressed in the reconstruction’s coordinates and scale.
sents.zh: 图像被调整为 504 × 504 504\times 504 并相应调整内参，留出相机以重建结果的坐标系和尺度表示。

sents.en: We render RGB and depth at the 16 held-out cameras with gsplat, using a black background.
sents.zh: 我们使用 gsplat 在 16 个留出相机处渲染 RGB 和深度，背景为黑色。

sents.en: These renders and their corresponding generated frames supply the reconstruction measurements in Tier 5.
sents.zh: 这些渲染结果及其对应的生成帧为第 5 层提供重建测量。

paragraphs.en: Extract appearance and identity features. We extract DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] global and patch descriptors from the selected images. Camera and depth correspondences identify patch pairs for cross-view and revisit comparisons. Registered reference masks define scene and anchor regions for input preservation; SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] tracks input anchors to the four identity-scoring times. PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS compare the image pairs specified by each metric. Visual-quality predictors operate on their own frame and triplet schedules, as described in Tier 2.
paragraphs.zh: 提取外观与身份特征。 我们从选定的图像中提取 DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] 的全局描述符与块描述符。 相机与深度对应关系用于识别图像块配对，以进行跨视角与重访比较。 已配准的参考掩码定义了场景区域与锚点区域以保留输入；SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] 将输入锚点跟踪至四个身份评分时刻。 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 对每个指标所指定的图像对进行比较。 视觉质量预测器按照其在 Tier 2 中描述的各自的帧与三元组时间表运行。

sents.en: Extract appearance and identity features.
sents.zh: 提取外观与身份特征。

sents.en: We extract DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] global and patch descriptors from the selected images.
sents.zh: 我们从选定的图像中提取 DINOv2 [ Oquab et al., 2024 ] 的全局描述符与块描述符。

sents.en: Camera and depth correspondences identify patch pairs for cross-view and revisit comparisons.
sents.zh: 相机与深度对应关系用于识别图像块配对，以进行跨视角与重访比较。

sents.en: Registered reference masks define scene and anchor regions for input preservation; SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] tracks input anchors to the four identity-scoring times.
sents.zh: 已配准的参考掩码定义了场景区域与锚点区域以保留输入；SAM3.1 [ Carion et al., 2026 ] 将输入锚点跟踪至四个身份评分时刻。

paragraphs.en: Compute event and temporal measurements. Recovered cameras are aligned to the requested trajectory for pose and action scoring. Depth, DINO correspondences, and point clouds provide the geometric measurements; query and return observations use registered references, while revisit measurements compare the selected generated observations. The same video estimates support five-second window measurements for Tier 6. We first reduce frame, anchor, and frame-pair observations to case-level components, then apply the score mappings and aggregation below.
paragraphs.zh: 计算事件与时间测量指标。 将恢复的相机与请求的轨迹对齐，用于姿态和动作评分。 深度、DINO 对应关系和点云提供几何测量；查询和返回观测使用配准的参考，而重访测量则比较选定的生成观测。 同样的视频估计支持用于第 6 级的 5 秒窗口测量。 我们首先将帧、锚点和帧对观测归约为案例级组件，然后应用下文的评分映射与聚合。

sents.en: Compute event and temporal measurements.
sents.zh: 计算事件与时间测量指标。

sents.en: Recovered cameras are aligned to the requested trajectory for pose and action scoring.
sents.zh: 将恢复的相机与请求的轨迹对齐，用于姿态和动作评分。

sents.en: Depth, DINO correspondences, and point clouds provide the geometric measurements; query and return observations use registered references, while revisit measurements compare the selected generated observations.
sents.zh: 深度、DINO 对应关系和点云提供几何测量；查询和返回观测使用配准的参考，而重访测量则比较选定的生成观测。

sents.en: The same video estimates support five-second window measurements for Tier 6.
sents.zh: 同样的视频估计支持用于第 6 级的 5 秒窗口测量。

sents.en: We first reduce frame, anchor, and frame-pair observations to case-level components, then apply the score mappings and aggregation below.
sents.zh: 我们首先将帧、锚点和帧对观测归约为案例级组件，然后应用下文的评分映射与聚合。

paragraphs.en: Normalization and aggregation. We convert metric components to a common 0–100 scale, with higher scores indicating better performance. Unit-range similarities are scaled directly; errors and PSNR use fixed linear mappings calibrated with equal weight per model. For Tiers 3–5, we normalize case-level measurements, average each component across valid cases, and apply the tier weights defined above. Tier 6 completes its temporal aggregation within each video before averaging across videos. The final six tier scores are combined as
paragraphs.zh: 归一化与聚合。 我们将指标分量转换为统一的 0–100 分制，分数越高表示性能越好。 单位区间的相似度直接缩放；误差和 PSNR 采用固定的线性映射，按每个模型等权重进行校准。 对于层级 3–5，我们对案例级测量值进行归一化，在各有效案例上对每个分量取平均，并应用上文定义的层级权重。 层级 6 先在每个视频内完成时间聚合，然后再跨视频取平均。 最终的六个层级分数按如下方式组合：

sents.en: Normalization and aggregation.
sents.zh: 归一化与聚合。

sents.en: We convert metric components to a common 0–100 scale, with higher scores indicating better performance.
sents.zh: 我们将指标分量转换为统一的 0–100 分制，分数越高表示性能越好。

sents.en: Unit-range similarities are scaled directly; errors and PSNR use fixed linear mappings calibrated with equal weight per model.
sents.zh: 单位区间的相似度直接缩放；误差和 PSNR 采用固定的线性映射，按每个模型等权重进行校准。

sents.en: For Tiers 3–5, we normalize case-level measurements, average each component across valid cases, and apply the tier weights defined above.
sents.zh: 对于层级 3–5，我们对案例级测量值进行归一化，在各有效案例上对每个分量取平均，并应用上文定义的层级权重。

sents.en: Tier 6 completes its temporal aggregation within each video before averaging across videos.
sents.zh: 层级 6 先在每个视频内完成时间聚合，然后再跨视频取平均。

sents.en: The final six tier scores are combined as
sents.zh: 最终的六个层级分数按如下方式组合：

paragraphs.en: We group the evaluated models by the control interface used in our experiments: camera-conditioned , action-conditioned , and text-conditioned . For each model, we describe below its generation setting. The benchmark provides an initial image I 0 I_{0} , a scene caption, and a camera trajectory { P t } \{P_{t}\} . Adapters convert the trajectory to the model’s coordinate convention and temporal sampling. Image resizing or cropping is accompanied by the corresponding intrinsic transformation when the model accepts calibration. For chunked generators, we extend the terminal camera pose to the required length and trim the extra output frames. Models with fixed generation windows continue from their own generated images or retained context. Evaluated videos use the benchmark’s 16-FPS timeline; when a model uses a different native frame rate, its controls or text timings follow that native clock before output conversion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照实验中使用的控制接口对被评估的模型进行分组：相机条件、动作条件和文本条件。 下面我们描述每个模型的生成设置。 该基准提供一个初始图像 I 0 I_{0}、一个场景描述和一个相机轨迹 { P t } \{P_{t}\}。 适配器将轨迹转换为模型的坐标约定和时间采样。 当模型接受标定信息时，图像缩放或裁剪会伴随相应的内参变换。 对于分块生成的模型，我们将末端的相机位姿扩展到所需长度，并裁剪多余的输出帧。 具有固定生成窗口的模型从其自身生成的图像或保留的上下文继续生成。 被评估的视频使用基准的 16-FPS 时间线；当模型使用不同的原生帧率时，其控制信号或文本时序在输出转换之前遵循该原生时钟。

sents.en: We group the evaluated models by the control interface used in our experiments: camera-conditioned , action-conditioned , and text-conditioned .
sents.zh: 我们按照实验中使用的控制接口对被评估的模型进行分组：相机条件、动作条件和文本条件。

sents.en: For each model, we describe below its generation setting.
sents.zh: 下面我们描述每个模型的生成设置。

sents.en: The benchmark provides an initial image I 0 I_{0} , a scene caption, and a camera trajectory { P t } \{P_{t}\} .
sents.zh: 该基准提供一个初始图像 I 0 I_{0}、一个场景描述和一个相机轨迹 { P t } \{P_{t}\}。

sents.en: Adapters convert the trajectory to the model’s coordinate convention and temporal sampling.
sents.zh: 适配器将轨迹转换为模型的坐标约定和时间采样。

sents.en: Image resizing or cropping is accompanied by the corresponding intrinsic transformation when the model accepts calibration.
sents.zh: 当模型接受标定信息时，图像缩放或裁剪会伴随相应的内参变换。

sents.en: For chunked generators, we extend the terminal camera pose to the required length and trim the extra output frames.
sents.zh: 对于分块生成的模型，我们将末端的相机位姿扩展到所需长度，并裁剪多余的输出帧。

sents.en: Models with fixed generation windows continue from their own generated images or retained context.
sents.zh: 具有固定生成窗口的模型从其自身生成的图像或保留的上下文继续生成。

sents.en: Evaluated videos use the benchmark’s 16-FPS timeline; when a model uses a different native frame rate, its controls or text timings follow that native clock before output conversion.
sents.zh: 被评估的视频使用基准的 16-FPS 时间线；当模型使用不同的原生帧率时，其控制信号或文本时序在输出转换之前遵循该原生时钟。

paragraphs.en: These models receive numerical camera conditions derived from { P t } \{P_{t}\} , expressed relative to the initial camera. We use the camera interface directly when an interactive model also offers an action-to-camera front end. This applies to Echo-WM and Matrix game 3.5; HY-WorldPlay also receives camera poses and derives its auxiliary action labels internally. Cosmos3-Nano’s continuous camera increments belong to this group, although the native implementation labels these continuous numerical camera conditions as actions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模型接收由 { P t } \{P_{t}\} 导出的数值相机条件，并以初始相机为参照来表示。 当交互式模型同时提供动作到相机的前端时，我们直接使用相机接口。 这适用于 Echo-WM 和 Matrix game 3.5；HY-WorldPlay 也接收相机位姿并在内部推导其辅助动作标签。 Cosmos3-Nano 的连续相机增量属于这一组，尽管其原生实现将这些连续的数值相机条件标注为动作。

sents.en: These models receive numerical camera conditions derived from { P t } \{P_{t}\} , expressed relative to the initial camera.
sents.zh: 这些模型接收由 { P t } \{P_{t}\} 导出的数值相机条件，并以初始相机为参照来表示。

paragraphs.en: SolarWM-H3 [ Huang et al., 2026 ] generates videos autoregressively with camera conditioning. We use 4 denoising steps, 5 latent frames per chunk, and a 6-chunk attention window. The requested trajectory enters its camera-conditioning path with the native logd4 translation encoding and fixed camera intrinsics. The input image and caption initialize generation, and the history cache is carried across rollout chunks.
paragraphs.zh: SolarWM-H3 [Huang 等人，2026] 以自回归方式生成视频，并带有相机条件控制。 我们使用 4 个去噪步骤、每个分块 5 个潜在帧，以及 6 个分块的注意力窗口。 请求的轨迹以原生的 logd4 平移编码和固定的相机内参进入其相机条件通路。 输入图像和字幕用于初始化生成，历史缓存则在 rollout 分块之间传递。

sents.en: SolarWM-H3 [ Huang et al., 2026 ] generates videos autoregressively with camera conditioning.
sents.zh: SolarWM-H3 [Huang 等人，2026] 以自回归方式生成视频，并带有相机条件控制。

sents.en: We use 4 denoising steps, 5 latent frames per chunk, and a 6-chunk attention window.
sents.zh: 我们使用 4 个去噪步骤、每个分块 5 个潜在帧，以及 6 个分块的注意力窗口。

sents.en: The requested trajectory enters its camera-conditioning path with the native logd4 translation encoding and fixed camera intrinsics.
sents.zh: 请求的轨迹以原生的 logd4 平移编码和固定的相机内参进入其相机条件通路。

sents.en: The input image and caption initialize generation, and the history cache is carried across rollout chunks.
sents.zh: 输入图像和字幕用于初始化生成，历史缓存则在 rollout 分块之间传递。

paragraphs.en: Lyra2 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] combines video generation with geometric conditioning. We use the DMD-distilled checkpoint with 4 steps at 832 × 480 832\times 480 . Requested poses are rebased to P 0 P_{0} , converted to world-to-camera matrices, and passed through the custom-trajectory interface with pose scale 1. Intrinsics follow the image resize, while the native geometry pipeline aligns estimated depth to MoGe scale. Short runs generate 401 frames and retain the first 357.
paragraphs.zh: Lyra2 [Shen et al., 2026] 将视频生成与几何条件相结合。 我们使用在 832 × 480 832\times 480 分辨率下蒸馏出的 DMD 4 步检查点。 请求的位姿被重新基准化到 P 0 P_{0}，转换为世界到相机的矩阵，并通过自定义轨迹接口以位姿缩放 1 传入。 内参随图像缩放而变化，而原生几何流程将估计的深度对齐到 MoGe 尺度。 短程运行生成 401 帧并保留前 357 帧。

sents.en: Lyra2 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] combines video generation with geometric conditioning.
sents.zh: Lyra2 [Shen et al., 2026] 将视频生成与几何条件相结合。

sents.zh: 我们使用在 832 × 480 832\times 480 分辨率下蒸馏出的 DMD 4 步检查点。

sents.en: Requested poses are rebased to P 0 P_{0} , converted to world-to-camera matrices, and passed through the custom-trajectory interface with pose scale 1.
