sents.zh: 内参随图像缩放而变化，而原生几何流程将估计的深度对齐到 MoGe 尺度。

sents.en: Short runs generate 401 frames and retain the first 357.
sents.zh: 短程运行生成 401 帧并保留前 357 帧。

paragraphs.en: EVOKE [ Yin et al., 2026 ] uses camera and geometric conditions for autoregressive scene exploration. We use the Stage3 post-distillation checkpoint in its image-conditioned mode, with 3 steps, guidance scale 1, and 640 × 384 640\times 384 output. The initial image, caption, and requested cameras enter the native camera and geometry branches. Short sequences use 10 rollout chunks; longer sequences extend the same rollout with the corresponding camera windows.
paragraphs.zh: EVOKE [Yin 等，2026] 利用相机与几何条件进行自回归的场景探索。 我们使用 Stage3 后蒸馏检查点的图像条件模式，采用 3 步、引导尺度 1 以及 640 × 384 640\times 384 的输出。 初始图像、描述文本以及请求的相机参数会进入原生的相机与几何分支。 短序列使用 10 个 rollout 块；较长的序列则在对应的相机窗口下扩展同一 rollout。

sents.en: EVOKE [ Yin et al., 2026 ] uses camera and geometric conditions for autoregressive scene exploration.
sents.zh: EVOKE [Yin 等，2026] 利用相机与几何条件进行自回归的场景探索。

sents.en: We use the Stage3 post-distillation checkpoint in its image-conditioned mode, with 3 steps, guidance scale 1, and 640 × 384 640\times 384 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Stage3 后蒸馏检查点的图像条件模式，采用 3 步、引导尺度 1 以及 640 × 384 640\times 384 的输出。

sents.en: The initial image, caption, and requested cameras enter the native camera and geometry branches.
sents.zh: 初始图像、描述文本以及请求的相机参数会进入原生的相机与几何分支。

sents.en: Short sequences use 10 rollout chunks; longer sequences extend the same rollout with the corresponding camera windows.
sents.zh: 短序列使用 10 个 rollout 块；较长的序列则在对应的相机窗口下扩展同一 rollout。

paragraphs.en: Echo-WM [ Zhang et al., 2026 ] is a causal video generator with unified camera conditioning. We use the Flash checkpoint with 4 steps, 3 latent frames per chunk, and 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 output. The adapter bypasses its Action DSL and supplies initial-camera-relative c2w poses directly to UCPE, applying the native translation factor 1 / 30 1/30 and 8-frame camera sampling. Short and long runs share the same causal history mechanism, with a 19-frame latent cache and 7 sink frames carried from one rollout chunk to the next during generation.
paragraphs.zh: Echo-WM [Zhang et al., 2026] 是一个具有统一相机条件控制的因果视频生成器。 我们使用 Flash 检查点，采用 4 步推理、每块 3 个潜在帧，以及 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 的输出分辨率。 该适配器绕过其 Action DSL，将相对于初始相机的 c2w 位姿直接提供给 UCPE，并应用原生的平移因子 1 / 30 1/30 和 8 帧相机采样。 短程和长程运行共享相同的因果历史机制，在生成过程中使用 19 帧潜在缓存和 7 个 sink 帧，并从一个 rollout 块传递到下一个 rollout 块。

sents.en: Echo-WM [ Zhang et al., 2026 ] is a causal video generator with unified camera conditioning.
sents.zh: Echo-WM [Zhang et al., 2026] 是一个具有统一相机条件控制的因果视频生成器。

sents.en: We use the Flash checkpoint with 4 steps, 3 latent frames per chunk, and 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Flash 检查点，采用 4 步推理、每块 3 个潜在帧，以及 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 的输出分辨率。

sents.en: The adapter bypasses its Action DSL and supplies initial-camera-relative c2w poses directly to UCPE, applying the native translation factor 1 / 30 1/30 and 8-frame camera sampling.
sents.zh: 该适配器绕过其 Action DSL，将相对于初始相机的 c2w 位姿直接提供给 UCPE，并应用原生的平移因子 1 / 30 1/30 和 8 帧相机采样。

sents.en: Short and long runs share the same causal history mechanism, with a 19-frame latent cache and 7 sink frames carried from one rollout chunk to the next during generation.
sents.zh: 短程和长程运行共享相同的因果历史机制，在生成过程中使用 19 帧潜在缓存和 7 个 sink 帧，并从一个 rollout 块传递到下一个 rollout 块。

paragraphs.en: Gen3C [ Ren et al., 2025 ] uses a persistent 3D cache to condition subsequent generated views. We use 35 denoising steps at 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 . The input image initializes the scene and the requested camera sequence drives the native autoregressive generation path. Inference proceeds in 121-frame windows with 1 shared boundary frame, retaining the 3D cache across windows.
paragraphs.zh: Gen3C [ Ren et al., 2025 ] 使用一个持久的 3D 缓存来对后续生成的视角进行条件约束。 我们在 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 分辨率下使用 35 个去噪步骤。 输入图像用于初始化场景，而请求的相机序列驱动原生的自回归生成路径。 推理以 121 帧为窗口进行，窗口之间共享 1 个边界帧，并在各窗口间保留 3D 缓存。

sents.en: Gen3C [ Ren et al., 2025 ] uses a persistent 3D cache to condition subsequent generated views.
sents.zh: Gen3C [ Ren et al., 2025 ] 使用一个持久的 3D 缓存来对后续生成的视角进行条件约束。

sents.en: We use 35 denoising steps at 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 .
sents.zh: 我们在 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 分辨率下使用 35 个去噪步骤。

sents.en: The input image initializes the scene and the requested camera sequence drives the native autoregressive generation path.
sents.zh: 输入图像用于初始化场景，而请求的相机序列驱动原生的自回归生成路径。

sents.en: Inference proceeds in 121-frame windows with 1 shared boundary frame, retaining the 3D cache across windows.
sents.zh: 推理以 121 帧为窗口进行，窗口之间共享 1 个边界帧，并在各窗口间保留 3D 缓存。

paragraphs.en: Matrix game 3.5 [ Qian et al., 2026b ] combines autoregressive generation with geometric patch memory. We use the distilled first-person model with 3 denoising steps and 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 output. The camera adapter supplies c2w extrinsics and image-aligned pixel intrinsics directly. The rollout consumes consecutive camera windows and retains its native memory of generated views.
paragraphs.zh: Matrix game 3.5 [Qian et al., 2026b] 将自回归生成与几何块记忆相结合。 我们使用蒸馏后的第一人称模型，去噪步数为 3，输出分辨率为 1280 × 704 1280\times 704。 相机适配器直接提供 c2w 外参以及与图像对齐的像素内参。 该 rollout 消费连续的相机窗口，并保留其对已生成视角的原生记忆。

sents.en: Matrix game 3.5 [ Qian et al., 2026b ] combines autoregressive generation with geometric patch memory.
sents.zh: Matrix game 3.5 [Qian et al., 2026b] 将自回归生成与几何块记忆相结合。

sents.en: We use the distilled first-person model with 3 denoising steps and 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用蒸馏后的第一人称模型，去噪步数为 3，输出分辨率为 1280 × 704 1280\times 704。

sents.en: The camera adapter supplies c2w extrinsics and image-aligned pixel intrinsics directly.
sents.zh: 相机适配器直接提供 c2w 外参以及与图像对齐的像素内参。

sents.en: The rollout consumes consecutive camera windows and retains its native memory of generated views.
sents.zh: 该 rollout 消费连续的相机窗口，并保留其对已生成视角的原生记忆。

paragraphs.en: AlayaWorld [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ] uses ViGeo to condition generation on scene geometry and camera motion. We use v1.1 Stage3, combining the Stage2b base with the Stage3 LoRA, at 960 × 544 960\times 544 with 4 steps and guidance scale 1. The adapter supplies poses relative to P 0 P_{0} with scale 1 and intrinsics adjusted to the resized input. Short videos use 12 rollout rounds; the same interface processes the extended trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: AlayaWorld [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ] 使用 ViGeo 使生成过程以场景几何和相机运动为条件。 我们使用 v1.1 Stage3，即 Stage2b 基础模型与 Stage3 LoRA 的组合，分辨率为 960 × 544 960\times 544，采用 4 步采样，引导尺度为 1。 该适配器提供相对于 P 0 P_{0}、尺度为 1 的位姿，以及针对缩放后输入调整的内参。 短视频使用 12 轮 rollout；同一接口可处理扩展后的轨迹。

sents.en: AlayaWorld [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ] uses ViGeo to condition generation on scene geometry and camera motion.
sents.zh: AlayaWorld [ AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ] 使用 ViGeo 使生成过程以场景几何和相机运动为条件。

sents.en: We use v1.1 Stage3, combining the Stage2b base with the Stage3 LoRA, at 960 × 544 960\times 544 with 4 steps and guidance scale 1.
sents.zh: 我们使用 v1.1 Stage3，即 Stage2b 基础模型与 Stage3 LoRA 的组合，分辨率为 960 × 544 960\times 544，采用 4 步采样，引导尺度为 1。

sents.en: The adapter supplies poses relative to P 0 P_{0} with scale 1 and intrinsics adjusted to the resized input.
sents.zh: 该适配器提供相对于 P 0 P_{0}、尺度为 1 的位姿，以及针对缩放后输入调整的内参。

sents.en: Short videos use 12 rollout rounds; the same interface processes the extended trajectories.
sents.zh: 短视频使用 12 轮 rollout；同一接口可处理扩展后的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: LingBot-World v2 [ Gao et al., 2026 ] generates camera-conditioned video with causal attention and cached history. We use the causal-fast checkpoint with 4 denoising steps, 4 latent frames per chunk, and the 480p configuration. Requested poses and intrinsics enter its native camera preprocessing, including its relative-motion normalization. For short cases, terminal padding produces 365 frames, of which the first 357 are retained.
paragraphs.zh: LingBot-World v2 [Gao et al., 2026] 使用因果注意力与缓存的历史信息生成以相机为条件的视频。 我们使用 causal-fast 检查点，采用 4 个去噪步骤、每个分块 4 个潜在帧以及 480p 配置。 请求的位姿和内参进入其原生的相机预处理流程，包括其相对运动归一化。 对于短序列场景，末尾填充会产生 365 帧，其中前 357 帧被保留。

sents.en: LingBot-World v2 [ Gao et al., 2026 ] generates camera-conditioned video with causal attention and cached history.
sents.zh: LingBot-World v2 [Gao et al., 2026] 使用因果注意力与缓存的历史信息生成以相机为条件的视频。

sents.en: We use the causal-fast checkpoint with 4 denoising steps, 4 latent frames per chunk, and the 480p configuration.
sents.zh: 我们使用 causal-fast 检查点，采用 4 个去噪步骤、每个分块 4 个潜在帧以及 480p 配置。

sents.en: Requested poses and intrinsics enter its native camera preprocessing, including its relative-motion normalization.
sents.zh: 请求的位姿和内参进入其原生的相机预处理流程，包括其相对运动归一化。

sents.en: For short cases, terminal padding produces 365 frames, of which the first 357 are retained.
sents.zh: 对于短序列场景，末尾填充会产生 365 帧，其中前 357 帧被保留。

paragraphs.en: HY-WorldPlay [ Sun et al., 2025 ] supports autoregressive generation from camera and action conditions. We use its AR-distilled checkpoint with 4 steps, chunk size 4, and 848 × 480 848\times 480 output. The adapter supplies sampled c2w poses from the requested trajectory; the native pipeline converts them to its camera representation and derives the associated action labels. Thus, our input uses the numerical camera interface. Short generation produces 365 frames before trimming to 357; native 24-FPS output is played at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: HY-WorldPlay [ Sun et al., 2025 ] 支持从相机与动作条件进行自回归生成。 我们使用其 AR 蒸馏的检查点，步数为 4，块大小为 4，输出为 848 × 480 848\times 480。 适配器提供从请求轨迹中采样的 c2w 位姿；原生流程将其转换为自身的相机表示，并推导出相应的动作标签。 因此，我们的输入使用数值相机接口。 短生成先产生 365 帧，再裁剪至 357 帧；原生 24-FPS 输出以 16 FPS 播放。

sents.en: HY-WorldPlay [ Sun et al., 2025 ] supports autoregressive generation from camera and action conditions.
sents.zh: HY-WorldPlay [ Sun et al., 2025 ] 支持从相机与动作条件进行自回归生成。

sents.en: We use its AR-distilled checkpoint with 4 steps, chunk size 4, and 848 × 480 848\times 480 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用其 AR 蒸馏的检查点，步数为 4，块大小为 4，输出为 848 × 480 848\times 480。

sents.en: The adapter supplies sampled c2w poses from the requested trajectory; the native pipeline converts them to its camera representation and derives the associated action labels.
sents.zh: 适配器提供从请求轨迹中采样的 c2w 位姿；原生流程将其转换为自身的相机表示，并推导出相应的动作标签。

sents.en: Thus, our input uses the numerical camera interface.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的输入使用数值相机接口。

sents.en: Short generation produces 365 frames before trimming to 357; native 24-FPS output is played at 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 短生成先产生 365 帧，再裁剪至 357 帧；原生 24-FPS 输出以 16 FPS 播放。

paragraphs.en: SANA-WM [ Zhu et al., 2026a ] provides streaming video generation with camera conditioning. We use the streaming checkpoint, 4 generator steps followed by 3 refiner steps, guidance scale 1, and flow shift 8. The requested poses are rebased to P 0 P_{0} and converted into the native ray and Plücker conditions. The 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 input is cropped to 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 to satisfy spatial divisibility, with intrinsics updated accordingly. Streaming generation retains the model’s causal decoding and refinement stages.
paragraphs.zh: SANA-WM [ Zhu et al., 2026a ] 提供带相机条件控制的流式视频生成。 我们使用流式检查点，4 步生成器之后接 3 步细化器，引导尺度为 1，流移为 8。 所请求的位姿被重定基到 P 0 P_{0}，并转换为原生的光线与 Plücker 条件。 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 的输入被裁剪为 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 以满足空间可整除性，同时相应更新内参。 流式生成保留了模型的因果解码与细化阶段。

sents.en: SANA-WM [ Zhu et al., 2026a ] provides streaming video generation with camera conditioning.
sents.zh: SANA-WM [ Zhu et al., 2026a ] 提供带相机条件控制的流式视频生成。

sents.en: We use the streaming checkpoint, 4 generator steps followed by 3 refiner steps, guidance scale 1, and flow shift 8.
sents.zh: 我们使用流式检查点，4 步生成器之后接 3 步细化器，引导尺度为 1，流移为 8。

sents.en: The requested poses are rebased to P 0 P_{0} and converted into the native ray and Plücker conditions.
sents.zh: 所请求的位姿被重定基到 P 0 P_{0}，并转换为原生的光线与 Plücker 条件。

sents.en: The 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 input is cropped to 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 to satisfy spatial divisibility, with intrinsics updated accordingly.
sents.zh: 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 的输入被裁剪为 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 以满足空间可整除性，同时相应更新内参。

sents.en: Streaming generation retains the model’s causal decoding and refinement stages.
sents.zh: 流式生成保留了模型的因果解码与细化阶段。

paragraphs.en: Voyager [ Huang et al., 2025b ] generates new views conditioned on an image and camera motion. We use 50 steps, and 768 × 512 768\times 512 output. The requested trajectory is divided into 49-frame generation windows with a 1-frame overlap. Each window receives the corresponding camera segment and starts from the preceding generated last frame, extending the model to the benchmark’s short and long durations.
paragraphs.zh: Voyager [Huang et al., 2025b] 基于一张图像和相机运动条件生成新视角。 我们使用 50 步和 768 × 512 768\times 512 的输出分辨率。 所请求的轨迹被划分为以 1 帧重叠的 49 帧生成窗口。 每个窗口接收对应的相机片段，并从前一个生成的最后一帧开始，从而将模型扩展到该基准测试的短时长和长时长场景。

sents.en: Voyager [ Huang et al., 2025b ] generates new views conditioned on an image and camera motion.
sents.zh: Voyager [Huang et al., 2025b] 基于一张图像和相机运动条件生成新视角。

sents.en: We use 50 steps, and 768 × 512 768\times 512 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用 50 步和 768 × 512 768\times 512 的输出分辨率。

sents.en: The requested trajectory is divided into 49-frame generation windows with a 1-frame overlap.
sents.zh: 所请求的轨迹被划分为以 1 帧重叠的 49 帧生成窗口。

sents.en: Each window receives the corresponding camera segment and starts from the preceding generated last frame, extending the model to the benchmark’s short and long durations.
sents.zh: 每个窗口接收对应的相机片段，并从前一个生成的最后一帧开始，从而将模型扩展到该基准测试的短时长和长时长场景。

paragraphs.en: LingBot-World v1 [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ] is evaluated with its Fast camera-control checkpoint and 4-step causal sampling. The adapter provides the initial image, scene caption, requested poses, and intrinsics to the native camera pipeline. Short runs retain the full available history; long runs use a 21-frame local attention window and 1 sink frame. The evaluated batches use the recorded 720p and 480p configurations, with the same pose-conditioning interface.
paragraphs.zh: LingBot-World v1 [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ] 使用其 Fast 相机控制检查点和 4 步因果采样进行评估。 适配器向原生相机流水线提供初始图像、场景描述、请求的位姿和内参。 短程运行保留全部可用历史；长程运行使用 21 帧局部注意力窗口和 1 个 sink 帧。 评估批次使用已记录的 720p 和 480p 配置，以及相同的位姿条件接口。

sents.en: LingBot-World v1 [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ] is evaluated with its Fast camera-control checkpoint and 4-step causal sampling.
sents.zh: LingBot-World v1 [ Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ] 使用其 Fast 相机控制检查点和 4 步因果采样进行评估。

sents.en: The adapter provides the initial image, scene caption, requested poses, and intrinsics to the native camera pipeline.
sents.zh: 适配器向原生相机流水线提供初始图像、场景描述、请求的位姿和内参。

sents.en: Short runs retain the full available history; long runs use a 21-frame local attention window and 1 sink frame.
sents.zh: 短程运行保留全部可用历史；长程运行使用 21 帧局部注意力窗口和 1 个 sink 帧。

sents.en: The evaluated batches use the recorded 720p and 480p configurations, with the same pose-conditioning interface.
sents.zh: 评估批次使用已记录的 720p 和 480p 配置，以及相同的位姿条件接口。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos3-Nano [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] accepts continuous camera-motion conditions. We use 30 denoising steps. Consecutive requested poses are converted to local SE(3) increments, encoded as 3 translation components scaled by 10 and a 6-dimensional rotation representation. These 9-dimensional vectors are supplied directly to the camera-action input. Generation adds 60 frames per chunk, conditioned on the preceding generated last frame, at an inference frame rate of 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: Cosmos3-Nano [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] 接受连续的相机运动条件。 我们使用 30 个去噪步数。 连续请求的位姿被转换为局部 SE(3) 增量，编码为按 10 缩放的 3 个平移分量和一个 6 维旋转表示。 这些 9 维向量直接提供给相机动作输入。 生成时每个片段增加 60 帧，以上一生成的最后一帧为条件，推理帧率为 16 FPS。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Nano [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] accepts continuous camera-motion conditions.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Nano [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] 接受连续的相机运动条件。

sents.en: We use 30 denoising steps.
sents.zh: 我们使用 30 个去噪步数。

sents.en: Consecutive requested poses are converted to local SE(3) increments, encoded as 3 translation components scaled by 10 and a 6-dimensional rotation representation.
sents.zh: 连续请求的位姿被转换为局部 SE(3) 增量，编码为按 10 缩放的 3 个平移分量和一个 6 维旋转表示。

sents.en: These 9-dimensional vectors are supplied directly to the camera-action input.
sents.zh: 这些 9 维向量直接提供给相机动作输入。

sents.en: Generation adds 60 frames per chunk, conditioned on the preceding generated last frame, at an inference frame rate of 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 生成时每个片段增加 60 帧，以上一生成的最后一帧为条件，推理帧率为 16 FPS。

paragraphs.en: DreamX-World [ DreamX Team et al., 2026 ] is evaluated with the 5B autoregressive checkpoint and 4 denoising steps at 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 . We use 3 latent frames per block, and the native 4-step schedule. Requested poses and normalized intrinsics pass through the official chunk-relative camera helper. Each chunk’s cameras are expressed relative to the preceding chunk endpoint, while calibration follows the benchmark input image.
paragraphs.zh: DreamX-World [ DreamX Team et al., 2026 ] 使用 5B 自回归检查点和 4 步去噪，在 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 分辨率下进行评估。 我们在每个块中使用 3 个潜空间帧，并采用原生的 4 步调度。 请求的位姿和归一化的内参通过官方的块相对相机辅助工具进行处理。 每个块的相机以前一个块的终点为参考进行表示，而标定则遵循基准测试的输入图像。

sents.en: DreamX-World [ DreamX Team et al., 2026 ] is evaluated with the 5B autoregressive checkpoint and 4 denoising steps at 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 .
sents.zh: DreamX-World [ DreamX Team et al., 2026 ] 使用 5B 自回归检查点和 4 步去噪，在 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 分辨率下进行评估。

sents.en: We use 3 latent frames per block, and the native 4-step schedule.
sents.zh: 我们在每个块中使用 3 个潜空间帧，并采用原生的 4 步调度。

sents.en: Requested poses and normalized intrinsics pass through the official chunk-relative camera helper.
sents.zh: 请求的位姿和归一化的内参通过官方的块相对相机辅助工具进行处理。

sents.en: Each chunk’s cameras are expressed relative to the preceding chunk endpoint, while calibration follows the benchmark input image.
sents.zh: 每个块的相机以前一个块的终点为参考进行表示，而标定则遵循基准测试的输入图像。

paragraphs.en: FantasyWorld [ Dai et al., 2026 ] generates camera-conditioned video from an initial image. We use 50 denoising steps, and 592 × 336 592\times 336 output. The requested trajectory is partitioned into 81-frame windows with a 1-frame overlap. Each window receives camera conditions for its trajectory segment and starts from the preceding window’s final generated frame, continuing generation from the model’s own output.
paragraphs.zh: FantasyWorld [Dai et al., 2026] 从一张初始图像生成以相机条件为控制的视频。 我们使用 50 个去噪步数，输出分辨率为 592 × 336 592\times 336。 所请求的轨迹被划分为若干 81 帧的窗口，窗口之间有 1 帧的重叠。 每个窗口接收其轨迹片段的相机条件，并从上一个窗口最后生成的帧开始，从模型自身的输出继续生成。

sents.en: FantasyWorld [ Dai et al., 2026 ] generates camera-conditioned video from an initial image.
sents.zh: FantasyWorld [Dai et al., 2026] 从一张初始图像生成以相机条件为控制的视频。

sents.en: We use 50 denoising steps, and 592 × 336 592\times 336 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用 50 个去噪步数，输出分辨率为 592 × 336 592\times 336。

sents.en: The requested trajectory is partitioned into 81-frame windows with a 1-frame overlap.
sents.zh: 所请求的轨迹被划分为若干 81 帧的窗口，窗口之间有 1 帧的重叠。

sents.en: Each window receives camera conditions for its trajectory segment and starts from the preceding window’s final generated frame, continuing generation from the model’s own output.
sents.zh: 每个窗口接收其轨迹片段的相机条件，并从上一个窗口最后生成的帧开始，从模型自身的输出继续生成。

paragraphs.en: Astra [ Zhu et al., 2026b ] uses relative camera motion for blockwise video generation. We use 50 steps, and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output. The adapter converts the requested trajectory to consecutive world-to-camera increments at the native 4-frame sampling interval; this interface has no intrinsic conditioning. Camera windows advance with the history origin, and long runs extend the temporal indexing while retaining the native recent-history context. Short runs retain 357 frames from a 385-frame generation.
paragraphs.zh: Astra [Zhu et al., 2026b] 使用相对相机运动进行分块视频生成。 我们使用 50 步，以及 832 × 480 832\times 480 的输出分辨率。 适配器将请求的轨迹转换为在原生 4 帧采样间隔下的连续世界到相机增量；该接口本身不含任何内在条件。 相机窗口随历史原点推进，长时程运行会扩展时间索引，同时保留原生的近期历史上下文。 短时程运行保留 385 帧生成中的 357 帧。

sents.en: Astra [ Zhu et al., 2026b ] uses relative camera motion for blockwise video generation.
sents.zh: Astra [Zhu et al., 2026b] 使用相对相机运动进行分块视频生成。

sents.en: We use 50 steps, and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output.
sents.zh: 我们使用 50 步，以及 832 × 480 832\times 480 的输出分辨率。

sents.en: The adapter converts the requested trajectory to consecutive world-to-camera increments at the native 4-frame sampling interval; this interface has no intrinsic conditioning.

sents.en: Camera windows advance with the history origin, and long runs extend the temporal indexing while retaining the native recent-history context.
sents.zh: 相机窗口随历史原点推进，长时程运行会扩展时间索引，同时保留原生的近期历史上下文。

sents.en: Short runs retain 357 frames from a 385-frame generation.
sents.zh: 短时程运行保留 385 帧生成中的 357 帧。

paragraphs.en: ABot-World, Genie3, and HappyOyster receive discrete movement and look commands. We compile these commands from the requested camera trajectory and execute them through the model’s streaming or browser interface.
paragraphs.zh: ABot-World、Genie3 和 HappyOyster 接收离散的移动和视角控制指令。 我们根据所需的相机轨迹编译这些指令，并通过模型的流式或浏览器接口执行它们。

sents.en: ABot-World, Genie3, and HappyOyster receive discrete movement and look commands.
sents.zh: ABot-World、Genie3 和 HappyOyster 接收离散的移动和视角控制指令。

sents.en: We compile these commands from the requested camera trajectory and execute them through the model’s streaming or browser interface.
sents.zh: 我们根据所需的相机轨迹编译这些指令，并通过模型的流式或浏览器接口执行它们。

paragraphs.en: Pose-to-action conversion. We smooth reconstructed camera paths while retaining the initial, query, return, and revisit waypoints. The adapter regularizes positions and continuous-sign quaternions with a nominal 0.2-Hz smoothing setting. For camera-to-world poses P t P_{t} , the local increment Δ ​ P t = P t − 1 ​ P t + 1 \Delta P_{t}=P_{t}^{-1}P_{t+1} supplies translation directions and yaw/pitch increments. After removing near-stationary motion, we normalize translation directions and use signed horizontal and forward components above 0.5 to identify movement keys. A direction is selected when its net vote exceeds half the action window. Movement and turning can be active together; yaw-return cases disable translation. We use model-specific turning responses to convert requested yaw and pitch into discrete action blocks or timed key presses.
paragraphs.zh: 姿态到动作的转换。 我们对重建的相机路径进行平滑，同时保留初始、查询、返回和重访的路径点。 该适配器以标称的 0.2 Hz 平滑设置对位置和连续符号四元数进行正则化。 对于相机到世界的姿态 P t P_{t}，局部增量 Δ ​ P t = P t − 1 ​ P t + 1 \Delta P_{t}=P_{t}^{-1}P_{t+1} 提供平移方向以及偏航/俯仰增量。 在去除近平稳运动后，我们对平移方向进行归一化，并使用超过 0.5 的带符号水平分量和前向分量来识别移动按键。 当某个方向的净投票超过动作窗口的一半时，即选中该方向。 移动和转向可以同时激活；偏航返回情形会禁用平移。 我们使用模型特定的转向响应，将请求的偏航和俯仰转换为离散的动作块或定时按键。

sents.en: Pose-to-action conversion.
sents.zh: 姿态到动作的转换。

sents.en: We smooth reconstructed camera paths while retaining the initial, query, return, and revisit waypoints.
sents.zh: 我们对重建的相机路径进行平滑，同时保留初始、查询、返回和重访的路径点。

sents.en: The adapter regularizes positions and continuous-sign quaternions with a nominal 0.2-Hz smoothing setting.
sents.zh: 该适配器以标称的 0.2 Hz 平滑设置对位置和连续符号四元数进行正则化。

sents.en: For camera-to-world poses P t P_{t} , the local increment Δ ​ P t = P t − 1 ​ P t + 1 \Delta P_{t}=P_{t}^{-1}P_{t+1} supplies translation directions and yaw/pitch increments.
sents.zh: 对于相机到世界的姿态 P t P_{t}，局部增量 Δ ​ P t = P t − 1 ​ P t + 1 \Delta P_{t}=P_{t}^{-1}P_{t+1} 提供平移方向以及偏航/俯仰增量。

sents.en: After removing near-stationary motion, we normalize translation directions and use signed horizontal and forward components above 0.5 to identify movement keys.
sents.zh: 在去除近平稳运动后，我们对平移方向进行归一化，并使用超过 0.5 的带符号水平分量和前向分量来识别移动按键。

sents.en: A direction is selected when its net vote exceeds half the action window.
sents.zh: 当某个方向的净投票超过动作窗口的一半时，即选中该方向。

sents.en: Movement and turning can be active together; yaw-return cases disable translation.
sents.zh: 移动和转向可以同时激活；偏航返回情形会禁用平移。

sents.en: We use model-specific turning responses to convert requested yaw and pitch into discrete action blocks or timed key presses.

paragraphs.en: Control evaluation. For ABot-World, Genie3, and HappyOyster, converting camera trajectories into discrete actions introduces differences in motion scale, timing, and turning response. Their results therefore serve primarily as diagnostic evaluations under the adapted action interface.
paragraphs.zh: 控制评估。 对于 ABot-World、Genie3 和 HappyOyster，将相机轨迹转换为离散动作会引入运动幅度、时机和转向响应方面的差异。 因此，它们的结果主要作为在适配后的动作接口下的诊断性评估。

sents.en: Control evaluation.
sents.zh: 控制评估。

sents.en: For ABot-World, Genie3, and HappyOyster, converting camera trajectories into discrete actions introduces differences in motion scale, timing, and turning response.
sents.zh: 对于 ABot-World、Genie3 和 HappyOyster，将相机轨迹转换为离散动作会引入运动幅度、时机和转向响应方面的差异。

sents.en: Their results therefore serve primarily as diagnostic evaluations under the adapted action interface.
sents.zh: 因此，它们的结果主要作为在适配后的动作接口下的诊断性评估。

paragraphs.en: These interfaces cannot accept camera poses or directly specify the requested displacement and rotation at each frame. Comparing DA3-recovered poses with the reference trajectory would therefore mix directional control with differences in action quantization and motion scale. For these 3 models, we use only Move Accuracy and Look Accuracy in the reported control score. DA3 recovers motion from the generated video, and we compare its movement and look direction sets with those derived from the original requested trajectory, following Appendix C.1 . Accuracy is computed over request-active intervals within each video and then averaged across videos. Tier 1 averages the 2 action scores; the control dimension of Tier 6 uses the same components within each temporal window.
paragraphs.zh: 这些接口无法接受相机位姿，也无法直接指定每一帧所需的位移和旋转。 因此，将 DA3 恢复的位姿与参考轨迹进行比较，会把方向控制与动作量化及运动尺度上的差异混在一起。 对于这 3 个模型，我们在报告的控制得分中只使用移动准确率（Move Accuracy）和观察准确率（Look Accuracy）。 DA3 从生成的视频中恢复运动，我们按照附录 C.1，将其移动和观察方向集合与从原始请求轨迹导出的集合进行比较。 准确率在每个视频内的请求活跃区间上计算，然后再跨视频取平均。 第 1 层（Tier 1）对这 2 个动作得分取平均；第 6 层（Tier 6）的控制维度在每个时间窗口内使用相同的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: ABot-World [ Jiang et al., 2026 ] uses the 0-5B-LF streaming checkpoint with 4 steps and 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 output. Its input consists of I 0 I_{0} , the scene caption, and a sequence of 8-dimensional WASD/IJKL action vectors. Before the benchmark run, we generated 64 controlled clips covering static, translation, and yaw actions, followed by 8 pitch clips. DA3 recovered cameras from these generated clips to estimate turning responses. We adopted symmetric nominal increments of 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} for yaw and 17 ∘ 17^{\circ} for pitch per action block. A turn is issued only if the accumulated requested angle and the nominal emitted angle differ by at least half a block’s increment, and the resulting turn points in the same direction as the requested camera rotation for that action block.
paragraphs.zh: ABot-World [ Jiang et al., 2026 ] 使用 0-5B-LF 流式检查点，采用 4 步和 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 的输出。 其输入包括 I 0 I_{0}、场景描述以及一系列 8 维的 WASD/IJKL 动作向量。 在基准测试运行之前，我们生成了 64 个覆盖静止、平移和偏航动作的受控片段，随后又生成了 8 个俯仰动作片段。 DA3 从这些生成的片段中恢复相机，以估计转向响应。 我们采用了对称的标称增量，每个动作块的偏航为 20 ∘ 20^{\circ}，俯仰为 17 ∘ 17^{\circ}。 仅当累积的请求角度与标称发出角度之差至少为半个动作块的增量，且由此产生的转向与该动作块请求的相机旋转方向一致时，才会发出转向指令。

sents.zh: DA3 从这些生成的片段中恢复相机，以估计转向响应。

sents.en: We adopted symmetric nominal increments of 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} for yaw and 17 ∘ 17^{\circ} for pitch per action block.
sents.zh: 我们采用了对称的标称增量，每个动作块的偏航为 20 ∘ 20^{\circ}，俯仰为 17 ∘ 17^{\circ}。

sents.en: A turn is issued only if the accumulated requested angle and the nominal emitted angle differ by at least half a block’s increment, and the resulting turn points in the same direction as the requested camera rotation for that action block.
sents.zh: 仅当累积的请求角度与标称发出角度之差至少为半个动作块的增量，且由此产生的转向与该动作块请求的相机旋转方向一致时，才会发出转向指令。

paragraphs.en: The native decoder produces 9 frames in the initial block and 12 thereafter. We therefore use 30 blocks for a 357-frame short video and 81 blocks for a 969-frame long rollout, retaining the first 961 frames. Each case initializes a fresh stream from I 0 I_{0} ; actions are updated before generating each block, while the model retains its history within the case. The native 12-FPS frame sequence is published at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: 原生解码器在初始块中生成 9 帧，此后每个块生成 12 帧。 因此，我们对 357 帧的短视频使用 30 个块，对 969 帧的长序列生成使用 81 个块，并保留前 961 帧。 每个案例都从 I 0 I_{0} 初始化一个全新的流；动作在生成每个块之前更新，而模型在案例内部保留其历史记录。 原生的 12-FPS 帧序列以 16 FPS 的帧率发布。

paragraphs.en: Genie3 [ Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ] is run through the Project Genie webpage in first-person mode. We upload I 0 I_{0} and the scene description, create the world, and begin the action schedule once the interactive view is ready. The trajectory is summarized in 12-frame analysis windows. Movement directions become WASD states, while yaw and pitch become timed look commands. A separate turning pilot checked response directions and approximate angular motion; the final scheduler uses nominal yaw and pitch rates of 70 ∘ 70^{\circ} /s and 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} /s. These rates determine hold durations, with translation and look commands dispatched independently.
paragraphs.zh: Genie3 [Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025] 通过 Project Genie 网页以第一人称模式运行。 我们上传 I 0 I_{0} 和场景描述，创建世界，并在交互视图就绪后开始动作调度。 轨迹以 12 帧的分析窗口进行汇总。 移动方向转换为 WASD 状态，而偏航和俯仰转换为定时的视角查看命令。 一个独立的转向先导测试检查了响应方向和近似角运动；最终调度器采用 70 ∘ 70^{\circ} /s 和 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} /s 的标称偏航与俯仰速率。 这些速率决定了按住时长，平移与视角查看命令独立分发。

sents.en: Genie3 [ Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ] is run through the Project Genie webpage in first-person mode.
sents.zh: Genie3 [Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025] 通过 Project Genie 网页以第一人称模式运行。

sents.en: The trajectory is summarized in 12-frame analysis windows.
sents.zh: 轨迹以 12 帧的分析窗口进行汇总。

sents.en: Movement directions become WASD states, while yaw and pitch become timed look commands.
sents.zh: 移动方向转换为 WASD 状态，而偏航和俯仰转换为定时的视角查看命令。

sents.en: A separate turning pilot checked response directions and approximate angular motion; the final scheduler uses nominal yaw and pitch rates of 70 ∘ 70^{\circ} /s and 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} /s.
sents.zh: 一个独立的转向先导测试检查了响应方向和近似角运动；最终调度器采用 70 ∘ 70^{\circ} /s 和 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} /s 的标称偏航与俯仰速率。

sents.en: These rates determine hold durations, with translation and look commands dispatched independently.
sents.zh: 这些速率决定了按住时长，平移与视角查看命令独立分发。

paragraphs.en: Browser-side scheduling uses an absolute clock to issue key-down and key-up events while the page remains in the foreground. Short and long cases use 20- and 54-second action schedules, followed by a 2-second key-release interval. The runner exits the world and saves the webpage’s downloadable video, together with the planned and dispatched actions. For evaluation, we normally remove the final 2 seconds and uniformly select 357 or 961 frames, then encode them at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览器端的调度使用绝对时钟，在页面保持在前台期间发出按键按下与按键释放事件。 短任务与长任务分别使用 20 秒和 54 秒的动作调度，其后是一个 2 秒的按键释放间隔。 运行器退出该世界，并保存网页的可下载视频，连同已规划与已分发的动作。 在评估时，我们通常会移除最后 2 秒，并均匀选取 357 或 961 帧，然后以 16 FPS 对其进行编码。

paragraphs.en: HappyOyster is run through its browser SDK in first-person Adventure mode at 720p. We initialize the world with I 0 I_{0} and the scene description, wait for the video stream, and execute a local action plan. A turning pilot was analyzed with DA3 to estimate visible angular response. We use nominal yaw and pitch rates of approximately 18.23 ∘ 18.23^{\circ} /s and 20.97 ∘ 20.97^{\circ} /s to allocate turn durations. Local motion is grouped into 12-frame analysis windows and mapped to a 15-second short or 40-second long interaction schedule.
paragraphs.zh: HappyOyster 通过其浏览器 SDK 以第一人称冒险（Adventure）模式在 720p 下运行。 我们用 I 0 I_{0} 和场景描述初始化世界，等待视频流，并执行本地动作计划。 使用 DA3 分析了一次转向试飞，以估计可见的角响应。 我们使用约 18.23 ∘ 18.23^{\circ} /s 和 20.97 ∘ 20.97^{\circ} /s 的标称偏航率和俯仰率来分配转向时长。 局部运动被划分为 12 帧的分析窗口，并映射到 15 秒的短交互或 40 秒的长交互日程。

paragraphs.en: The SDK maintains separate held states for translation and rotation. Our scheduler updates a state only when it changes, so releasing a turn does not interrupt ongoing translation. We record the incoming video track with MediaRecorder, retain the action and session timestamps, and release all controls before closing the session. Evaluated outputs retain the first 357 or 961 captured frames and play them at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: 该 SDK 为平移和旋转分别维护独立的保持状态。 我们的调度器仅在状态发生变化时才更新状态，因此释放回合不会中断正在进行的平移。 我们使用 MediaRecorder 录制传入的视频轨道，保留动作和时间戳，并在关闭会话前释放所有控制。 评估后的输出保留前 357 或 961 帧捕获画面，并以 16 FPS 播放。

paragraphs.en: From poses to motion descriptions. We analyze translation and rotation separately, smooth their trends over approximately 0.6 seconds, and group them into motion phases: travel, turning, pauses, reversal, and return. The script states the direction and duration of each phase, with turn angles derived from the corresponding poses. For curved trajectories, the script describes both the path and the viewing direction; orbit prompts name the public anchor when available. Brief fluctuations are merged into longer phases, while meaningful pauses and direction changes are retained. This simplification changes the text description, leaving the requested trajectory used for evaluation unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 从姿态到运动描述。 我们分别分析平移与旋转，在约 0.6 秒的范围内平滑其趋势，并将其归入运动阶段：行进、转向、停顿、折返与返回。 脚本说明每个阶段的方向与时长，转角由相应姿态推导得出。 对于弯曲轨迹，脚本同时描述路径与观看方向；轨道提示在可用时会指明公共锚点。 短暂的波动被合并到较长的阶段中，而有意义的停顿和方向变化则予以保留。 这种简化会改变文本描述，但用于评估的所请求轨迹保持不变。

sents.en: From poses to motion descriptions.
sents.zh: 从姿态到运动描述。

sents.en: We analyze translation and rotation separately, smooth their trends over approximately 0.6 seconds, and group them into motion phases: travel, turning, pauses, reversal, and return.
sents.zh: 我们分别分析平移与旋转，在约 0.6 秒的范围内平滑其趋势，并将其归入运动阶段：行进、转向、停顿、折返与返回。

sents.en: The script states the direction and duration of each phase, with turn angles derived from the corresponding poses.
sents.zh: 脚本说明每个阶段的方向与时长，转角由相应姿态推导得出。

sents.en: For curved trajectories, the script describes both the path and the viewing direction; orbit prompts name the public anchor when available.
sents.zh: 对于弯曲轨迹，脚本同时描述路径与观看方向；轨道提示在可用时会指明公共锚点。

sents.en: Brief fluctuations are merged into longer phases, while meaningful pauses and direction changes are retained.
sents.zh: 短暂的波动被合并到较长的阶段中，而有意义的停顿和方向变化则予以保留。

sents.en: This simplification changes the text description, leaving the requested trajectory used for evaluation unchanged.
sents.zh: 这种简化会改变文本描述，但用于评估的所请求轨迹保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Window-specific prompts. Each generation window receives only the motion phases that overlap its frame range. We recompute its local times and turning angles at the model’s native frame rate, then append the resulting motion text to the scene caption. A continuation prompt starts from its supplied generated image or video context and describes the next part of the trajectory. Return instructions appear when the corresponding return phase falls within that window. Figures 21 and 22 show the short- and long-horizon scripts for the same lateral-return case in Kling3.0.
paragraphs.zh: 针对生成窗口的专用提示词。 每个生成窗口仅接收与其帧范围重叠的运动阶段。 我们以模型的原生帧率重新计算其局部时间和转向角，然后将生成的运动文本附加到场景描述中。 续接提示词从所提供的已生成图像或视频上下文出发，描述轨迹的下一部分。 当相应的返回阶段落在该窗口内时，会出现返回指令。 图21和图22展示了Kling3.0中同一侧向返回案例的短时程与长时程脚本。

sents.en: Window-specific prompts.
sents.zh: 针对生成窗口的专用提示词。

sents.en: Each generation window receives only the motion phases that overlap its frame range.
sents.zh: 每个生成窗口仅接收与其帧范围重叠的运动阶段。

sents.en: We recompute its local times and turning angles at the model’s native frame rate, then append the resulting motion text to the scene caption.
sents.zh: 我们以模型的原生帧率重新计算其局部时间和转向角，然后将生成的运动文本附加到场景描述中。

sents.en: A continuation prompt starts from its supplied generated image or video context and describes the next part of the trajectory.
sents.zh: 续接提示词从所提供的已生成图像或视频上下文出发，描述轨迹的下一部分。

sents.en: Return instructions appear when the corresponding return phase falls within that window.
sents.zh: 当相应的返回阶段落在该窗口内时，会出现返回指令。

sents.en: Figures 21 and 22 show the short- and long-horizon scripts for the same lateral-return case in Kling3.0.
sents.zh: 图21和图22展示了Kling3.0中同一侧向返回案例的短时程与长时程脚本。

paragraphs.en: Segmented generation. The first request is conditioned on I 0 I_{0} . Subsequent requests use the preceding generated last frame, except for LongCat, which retains 13 context frames. We remove repeated conditioning frames at segment boundaries and trim terminal padding to obtain 357 or 961 frames at 16 FPS. API models are run as dependent requests: the current segment must finish before its generated endpoint can initialize the next. We retain each segment’s prompt and output alongside the assembled video.
paragraphs.zh: 分段生成。 第一个请求以 I 0 I_{0} 为条件。 后续请求使用前一段生成的最后一帧，但 LongCat 除外，它保留 13 个上下文帧。 我们去除分段边界处重复的条件帧，并裁剪末尾的填充，从而在 16 FPS 下获得 357 或 961 帧。 API 模型以依赖请求的方式运行：当前分段必须先完成，其生成的端点才能初始化下一个分段。 我们在保留拼接视频的同时，保留每个分段的提示词和输出。

sents.en: Segmented generation.
sents.zh: 分段生成。

sents.en: The first request is conditioned on I 0 I_{0} .
sents.zh: 第一个请求以 I 0 I_{0} 为条件。

sents.en: Subsequent requests use the preceding generated last frame, except for LongCat, which retains 13 context frames.
sents.zh: 后续请求使用前一段生成的最后一帧，但 LongCat 除外，它保留 13 个上下文帧。

sents.en: We remove repeated conditioning frames at segment boundaries and trim terminal padding to obtain 357 or 961 frames at 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 我们去除分段边界处重复的条件帧，并裁剪末尾的填充，从而在 16 FPS 下获得 357 或 961 帧。

sents.en: API models are run as dependent requests: the current segment must finish before its generated endpoint can initialize the next.
sents.zh: API 模型以依赖请求的方式运行：当前分段必须先完成，其生成的端点才能初始化下一个分段。

sents.en: We retain each segment’s prompt and output alongside the assembled video.
sents.zh: 我们在保留拼接视频的同时，保留每个分段的提示词和输出。

paragraphs.en: Seedance2.5 [ ByteDance Seed, 2026 ] is evaluated through its first-frame image-to-video API at 720p with audio disabled. Short cases use a 15-second request; long cases use 2 consecutive 20-second requests at the native 24-FPS rate. The long prompts cover requested frames 0–480 and 480–960, respectively, each expressed as a local 0–20-second script. The second request uses the first segment’s generated last frame. Short output is trimmed to 357 frames; long segments are joined after removing the repeated boundary frame to obtain 961 frames.
paragraphs.zh: Seedance2.5 [ ByteDance Seed, 2026 ] 通过其首帧图生视频 API 进行评估，分辨率 720p，音频关闭。 短案例使用 15 秒的请求；长案例以原生 24 FPS 帧率使用连续 2 个 20 秒请求。 长提示词分别覆盖所请求的第 0–480 帧和 480–960 帧，每段均以局部 0–20 秒脚本的形式表达。 第二个请求使用第一段生成的最后一帧。 短视频输出裁剪至 357 帧；长视频在去除重复的边界帧后将各段拼接，得到 961 帧。

sents.en: Seedance2.5 [ ByteDance Seed, 2026 ] is evaluated through its first-frame image-to-video API at 720p with audio disabled.
sents.zh: Seedance2.5 [ ByteDance Seed, 2026 ] 通过其首帧图生视频 API 进行评估，分辨率 720p，音频关闭。

sents.en: Short cases use a 15-second request; long cases use 2 consecutive 20-second requests at the native 24-FPS rate.
sents.zh: 短案例使用 15 秒的请求；长案例以原生 24 FPS 帧率使用连续 2 个 20 秒请求。

sents.zh: 长提示词分别覆盖所请求的第 0–480 帧和 480–960 帧，每段均以局部 0–20 秒脚本的形式表达。

sents.zh: 第二个请求使用第一段生成的最后一帧。

paragraphs.en: Kling3.0 [ Kling AI, 2026 ] uses the image-to-video API at 720p and native 24 FPS, with audio and multi-shot generation disabled. Short cases request 15 seconds. Long cases request 15, 15, and 10 seconds, with a separate prompt for each successive camera window. The first request uses I 0 I_{0} , and each continuation uses the preceding generated last frame. We assemble the outputs by removing shared boundary frames and trimming the tail.
paragraphs.zh: Kling3.0 [ Kling AI, 2026 ] 以 720p 和原生 24 FPS 使用图生视频 API，并禁用音频与多镜头生成。 短案例请求 15 秒。 长案例分别请求 15、15 和 10 秒，每个连续的镜头窗口使用单独的提示词。 第一个请求使用 I 0 I_{0}，每个续接请求使用前一段生成的最后一帧。 我们通过去除共享的边界帧并裁剪末尾来组装输出。

sents.en: Kling3.0 [ Kling AI, 2026 ] uses the image-to-video API at 720p and native 24 FPS, with audio and multi-shot generation disabled.
sents.zh: Kling3.0 [ Kling AI, 2026 ] 以 720p 和原生 24 FPS 使用图生视频 API，并禁用音频与多镜头生成。

sents.en: Short cases request 15 seconds.
sents.zh: 短案例请求 15 秒。

sents.en: Long cases request 15, 15, and 10 seconds, with a separate prompt for each successive camera window.
sents.zh: 长案例分别请求 15、15 和 10 秒，每个连续的镜头窗口使用单独的提示词。

sents.en: The first request uses I 0 I_{0} , and each continuation uses the preceding generated last frame.
sents.zh: 第一个请求使用 I 0 I_{0}，每个续接请求使用前一段生成的最后一帧。

sents.en: We assemble the outputs by removing shared boundary frames and trimming the tail.
sents.zh: 我们通过去除共享的边界帧并裁剪末尾来组装输出。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos3-Super [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] uses the 4-Step Image2Video checkpoint with guidance scale 1 and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output. The scene caption is combined with the motion text for each generation window. Short cases generate 357 frames in one call. Long cases use windows of 357, 357, and 249 frames, covering requested indices 0–356, 356–712, and 712–960. The 2 repeated boundary frames are removed to obtain 961 frames. Prompt times follow the native 24-FPS clock, and the assembled frames are published at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: Cosmos3-Super [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] 使用 4 步 Image2Video 检查点，引导系数为 1，输出分辨率为 832 × 480 832\times 480。 场景描述与运动文本会针对每个生成窗口进行组合。 短案例在一次调用中生成 357 帧。 长案例使用 357、357 和 249 帧的窗口，分别覆盖所请求的索引 0–356、356–712 和 712–960。 移除 2 帧重复的边界帧后，得到 961 帧。 提示时间遵循原生 24 FPS 时钟，而拼接后的帧以 16 FPS 发布。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Super [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] uses the 4-Step Image2Video checkpoint with guidance scale 1 and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Super [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] 使用 4 步 Image2Video 检查点，引导系数为 1，输出分辨率为 832 × 480 832\times 480。

sents.en: The scene caption is combined with the motion text for each generation window.
sents.zh: 场景描述与运动文本会针对每个生成窗口进行组合。

sents.en: Short cases generate 357 frames in one call.
sents.zh: 短案例在一次调用中生成 357 帧。

sents.en: Long cases use windows of 357, 357, and 249 frames, covering requested indices 0–356, 356–712, and 712–960.
The 2 repeated boundary frames are removed to obtain 961 frames.
sents.zh: 移除 2 帧重复的边界帧后，得到 961 帧。

sents.en: Prompt times follow the native 24-FPS clock, and the assembled frames are published at 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 提示时间遵循原生 24 FPS 时钟，而拼接后的帧以 16 FPS 发布。

paragraphs.en: HunyuanVideo1.5 [ Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025 ] uses the 480p image-to-video step-distilled checkpoint, 12 steps, and 848 × 480 848\times 480 output. Each window generates 121 frames at native 24 FPS, with the preceding generated last frame conditioning the next window. Thus, 3 windows produce 361 frames for short cases, cropped to 357; 8 windows produce exactly 961 frames for long cases. Each window receives a scene description based on its actual conditioning image, followed by the window-specific camera script. The camera script preserves the timing, turning angles, and motion reversals specified by the requested trajectory within each generation window.
paragraphs.zh: HunyuanVideo1.5 [腾讯混元基础模型团队，2025] 使用 480p 图生视频（image-to-video）步数蒸馏的检查点，12 步，以及 848 × 480 848\times 480 的输出分辨率。 每个窗口以原生 24 FPS 生成 121 帧，并由前一窗口生成的最后一帧作为下一窗口的条件。 因此，短情况使用 3 个窗口生成 361 帧，裁剪为 357 帧；长情况使用 8 个窗口恰好生成 961 帧。 每个窗口都接收基于其实际条件图像的场景描述，随后是该窗口专属的镜头脚本。 镜头脚本在每个生成窗口内保留所请求轨迹规定的时间节奏、转向角度和运动反转。

sents.en: HunyuanVideo1.5 [ Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025 ] uses the 480p image-to-video step-distilled checkpoint, 12 steps, and 848 × 480 848\times 480 output.
sents.zh: HunyuanVideo1.5 [腾讯混元基础模型团队，2025] 使用 480p 图生视频（image-to-video）步数蒸馏的检查点，12 步，以及 848 × 480 848\times 480 的输出分辨率。

sents.en: Each window generates 121 frames at native 24 FPS, with the preceding generated last frame conditioning the next window.
sents.zh: 每个窗口以原生 24 FPS 生成 121 帧，并由前一窗口生成的最后一帧作为下一窗口的条件。

sents.en: Thus, 3 windows produce 361 frames for short cases, cropped to 357; 8 windows produce exactly 961 frames for long cases.
sents.zh: 因此，短情况使用 3 个窗口生成 361 帧，裁剪为 357 帧；长情况使用 8 个窗口恰好生成 961 帧。

sents.zh: 每个窗口都接收基于其实际条件图像的场景描述，随后是该窗口专属的镜头脚本。

sents.zh: 镜头脚本在每个生成窗口内保留所请求轨迹规定的时间节奏、转向角度和运动反转。

paragraphs.en: MiniMax-H3 [ MiniMax, 2026 ] uses the Base FL2VA variant with 50 sampling time points, corresponding to 49 denoising iterations, at 768p. It receives the conditioning image and the scene caption combined with its window-specific motion script. Short requests produce 362 frames, cropped to 357. Long generation uses 362, 362, and 243 frames, with each later segment initialized from the preceding generated last frame. Removing the 2 repeated boundary frames leaves 965 frames, from which the first 961 are retained. The motion prompts are constructed for these specific windows at native 24 FPS before output conversion to 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: MiniMax-H3 [ MiniMax, 2026 ] 使用 Base FL2VA 变体，在 768p 下采用 50 个采样时间点，对应 49 次去噪迭代。 它接收条件图像，以及与其窗口特定动作脚本相结合的场景描述。 短请求生成 362 帧，裁剪后为 357 帧。 长生成使用 362、362 和 243 帧，每个后续片段都以前一个生成片段的最后一帧进行初始化。 去除 2 个重复的边界帧后剩下 965 帧，其中保留前 961 帧。 动作提示是在原生 24 FPS 下针对这些特定窗口构建的，之后再转换为 16 FPS 输出。

sents.en: MiniMax-H3 [ MiniMax, 2026 ] uses the Base FL2VA variant with 50 sampling time points, corresponding to 49 denoising iterations, at 768p.
sents.zh: MiniMax-H3 [ MiniMax, 2026 ] 使用 Base FL2VA 变体，在 768p 下采用 50 个采样时间点，对应 49 次去噪迭代。

sents.en: It receives the conditioning image and the scene caption combined with its window-specific motion script.
sents.zh: 它接收条件图像，以及与其窗口特定动作脚本相结合的场景描述。

sents.zh: 短请求生成 362 帧，裁剪后为 357 帧。

sents.zh: 长生成使用 362、362 和 243 帧，每个后续片段都以前一个生成片段的最后一帧进行初始化。

sents.en: Removing the 2 repeated boundary frames leaves 965 frames, from which the first 961 are retained.
sents.zh: 去除 2 个重复的边界帧后剩下 965 帧，其中保留前 961 帧。

sents.en: The motion prompts are constructed for these specific windows at native 24 FPS before output conversion to 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 动作提示是在原生 24 FPS 下针对这些特定窗口构建的，之后再转换为 16 FPS 输出。

paragraphs.en: LTX2.5 [ Lightricks, 2026 ] uses the 22B distilled checkpoint and its 2-stage 8 + 3 8+3 -step schedule. The prompt describes the scene and the complete requested trajectory. Both short and long sequences are generated in a single call from I 0 I_{0} : the short request is padded to 361 frames and trimmed to 357, while the long request produces 961 frames. Images are padded from 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 to 1280 × 768 1280\times 768 for inference and cropped back afterward. Prompt timings use the native 24-FPS clock, and output frames are published at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: LTX2.5 [ Lightricks, 2026 ] 使用 22B 蒸馏检查点及其两阶段 8 + 3 (8+3) 步调度。 提示词描述了场景以及所要求的完整轨迹。 短序列和长序列都通过一次调用从 I 0 (I_{0}) 生成：短请求被填充到 361 帧并裁剪至 357 帧，而长请求则生成 961 帧。 图像在推理时从 1280 × 720 (1280\times 720) 填充到 1280 × 768 (1280\times 768)，之后再裁剪回原尺寸。 提示词时间使用原生 24-FPS 时钟，输出帧以 16 FPS 发布。

sents.en: LTX2.5 [ Lightricks, 2026 ] uses the 22B distilled checkpoint and its 2-stage 8 + 3 8+3 -step schedule.
sents.zh: LTX2.5 [ Lightricks, 2026 ] 使用 22B 蒸馏检查点及其两阶段 8 + 3 (8+3) 步调度。

sents.en: The prompt describes the scene and the complete requested trajectory.
sents.zh: 提示词描述了场景以及所要求的完整轨迹。

sents.en: Both short and long sequences are generated in a single call from I 0 I_{0} : the short request is padded to 361 frames and trimmed to 357, while the long request produces 961 frames.
sents.zh: 短序列和长序列都通过一次调用从 I 0 (I_{0}) 生成：短请求被填充到 361 帧并裁剪至 357 帧，而长请求则生成 961 帧。

sents.en: Images are padded from 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 to 1280 × 768 1280\times 768 for inference and cropped back afterward.
sents.zh: 图像在推理时从 1280 × 720 (1280\times 720) 填充到 1280 × 768 (1280\times 768)，之后再裁剪回原尺寸。

sents.en: Prompt timings use the native 24-FPS clock, and output frames are published at 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 提示词时间使用原生 24-FPS 时钟，输出帧以 16 FPS 发布。

paragraphs.en: Wan2.7 [ Wan Team et al., 2025 ] uses the image-to-video API at 720p and native 30 FPS. Short cases request 12 seconds; long cases request 15, 15, and 3 seconds. Each request receives the relevant portion of the motion script with local times expressed at 30 FPS. Continuation requests use the generated last frame, and the assembled sequence removes repeated boundary frames before terminal trimming to 357 or 961 frames. The retained frame sequence is played at 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: Wan2.7 [ Wan 团队等，2025 ] 使用 720p、原生 30 FPS 的图生视频 API。 短案例请求 12 秒；长案例分别请求 15、15 和 3 秒。 每个请求都会收到运动脚本的相关部分，其中本地时间以 30 FPS 表示。 续接请求使用生成的最后一帧，并且在终端裁剪至 357 或 961 帧之前，拼接序列会先移除重复的边界帧。 保留的帧序列以 16 FPS 播放。

sents.en: Wan2.7 [ Wan Team et al., 2025 ] uses the image-to-video API at 720p and native 30 FPS.
sents.zh: Wan2.7 [ Wan 团队等，2025 ] 使用 720p、原生 30 FPS 的图生视频 API。

sents.en: Short cases request 12 seconds; long cases request 15, 15, and 3 seconds.
sents.zh: 短案例请求 12 秒；长案例分别请求 15、15 和 3 秒。

sents.en: Each request receives the relevant portion of the motion script with local times expressed at 30 FPS.
sents.zh: 每个请求都会收到运动脚本的相关部分，其中本地时间以 30 FPS 表示。

sents.en: Continuation requests use the generated last frame, and the assembled sequence removes repeated boundary frames before terminal trimming to 357 or 961 frames.
sents.zh: 续接请求使用生成的最后一帧，并且在终端裁剪至 357 或 961 帧之前，拼接序列会先移除重复的边界帧。

sents.en: The retained frame sequence is played at 16 FPS.
sents.zh: 保留的帧序列以 16 FPS 播放。

paragraphs.en: LongCat [ Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2025 ] uses the base model with its step-distillation LoRA, 16 steps, guidance scale 1, and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output. Each segment contains 93 frames. The first is initialized from I 0 I_{0} ; subsequent segments use 13 generated context frames and add 80 new frames through the native video-continuation interface. Consequently, 5 segments yield 413 frames for short cases and 12 yield 973 for long cases, followed by terminal trimming to 357 and 961. The scene caption is preserved and combined with window-specific English motion text. Window starts advance by 80 frames, and local times use the native 15-FPS clock. The motion script continues from the retained context and describes only the new portion of the trajectory. The model carries its native continuation cache from one segment to the next throughout the same evaluation case, for short and long videos.

paragraphs.en: Lyra2 leads translation and Move Accuracy, while SolarWM-H3 leads rotation and Look Accuracy among world models (Table 9 ). LingBot-World v2 illustrates the gap between the two types of measurement: its Move Accuracy is 79.45 79.45 , but its translation score is 50.94 50.94 . Moving in the right direction does not ensure the correct distance, timing, or camera trajectory . The strongest TI2V model, Seedance2.5, also remains well below the leading world models across control components.
paragraphs.zh: 在世界模型中，Lyra2 在平移（translation）和移动准确率（Move Accuracy）上领先，而 SolarWM-H3 在旋转和视角准确率（Look Accuracy）上领先（表 9）。 LingBot-World v2 说明了这两类衡量指标之间的差距：其移动准确率（Move Accuracy）为 79.45 79.45 ，但平移得分为 50.94 50.94 。 朝正确方向移动并不能保证正确的距离、时机或相机轨迹。 最强的 TI2V 模型 Seedance2.5 在各个控制维度上仍然远低于领先的世界模型。

sents.en: Lyra2 leads translation and Move Accuracy, while SolarWM-H3 leads rotation and Look Accuracy among world models (Table 9 ).
sents.zh: 在世界模型中，Lyra2 在平移（translation）和移动准确率（Move Accuracy）上领先，而 SolarWM-H3 在旋转和视角准确率（Look Accuracy）上领先（表 9）。

sents.en: LingBot-World v2 illustrates the gap between the two types of measurement: its Move Accuracy is 79.45 79.45 , but its translation score is 50.94 50.94 .
sents.zh: LingBot-World v2 说明了这两类衡量指标之间的差距：其移动准确率（Move Accuracy）为 79.45 79.45 ，但平移得分为 50.94 50.94 。

sents.en: Moving in the right direction does not ensure the correct distance, timing, or camera trajectory .
sents.zh: 朝正确方向移动并不能保证正确的距离、时机或相机轨迹。

sents.en: The strongest TI2V model, Seedance2.5, also remains well below the leading world models across control components.
sents.zh: 最强的 TI2V 模型 Seedance2.5 在各个控制维度上仍然远低于领先的世界模型。

paragraphs.en: Look Accuracy scores vary the most across camera-conditioned models, and all three action-conditioned models score lower on Look than Move. HunyuanVideo1.5 leads TI2V Move Accuracy but ranks last on Look, showing how differently the two commands can be executed. This distinction matters for yaw sweeps, curved paths, and orbits, which repeatedly change the viewing direction. In several inspected Genie3 cases, lateral requests produce turns instead of translation. Separately, its lower Look Accuracy indicates difficulty executing requested turns; the lateral-motion errors instead reflect confusion between requested translation and turning.
paragraphs.zh: Look（看）准确率在以相机为条件的各模型间差异最大，且三个以动作为条件的模型在 Look 上的得分都低于 Move。 HunyuanVideo1.5 在 TI2V Move 准确率上领先，但在 Look 上排名最后，这说明两个指令的执行方式可能截然不同。 这种区分对偏航扫掠、曲线路径和环绕运动很重要，因为这些运动需要不断改变观察方向。 在检查的若干 Genie3 案例中，横向移动请求产生了转向而非平移。 另外，其较低的 Look 准确率表明它难以执行请求的转向；而横向运动的错误则反映了对请求的平移与转向之间的混淆。

sents.en: Look Accuracy scores vary the most across camera-conditioned models, and all three action-conditioned models score lower on Look than Move.
sents.zh: Look（看）准确率在以相机为条件的各模型间差异最大，且三个以动作为条件的模型在 Look 上的得分都低于 Move。

sents.en: HunyuanVideo1.5 leads TI2V Move Accuracy but ranks last on Look, showing how differently the two commands can be executed.
sents.zh: HunyuanVideo1.5 在 TI2V Move 准确率上领先，但在 Look 上排名最后，这说明两个指令的执行方式可能截然不同。

sents.en: This distinction matters for yaw sweeps, curved paths, and orbits, which repeatedly change the viewing direction.
sents.zh: 这种区分对偏航扫掠、曲线路径和环绕运动很重要，因为这些运动需要不断改变观察方向。

sents.en: In several inspected Genie3 cases, lateral requests produce turns instead of translation.
sents.zh: 在检查的若干 Genie3 案例中，横向移动请求产生了转向而非平移。

sents.en: Separately, its lower Look Accuracy indicates difficulty executing requested turns; the lateral-motion errors instead reflect confusion between requested translation and turning.
sents.zh: 另外，其较低的 Look 准确率表明它难以执行请求的转向；而横向运动的错误则反映了对请求的平移与转向之间的混淆。

paragraphs.en: Seven of the eight TI2V models exceed the best world-model quality aggregate (Table 10 ). Their advantage spans aesthetic, imaging, and human-preference scores, with a smaller spread than among world models. Cosmos3-Super leads the TI2V group, while EVOKE leads world models. Figures 25 – 27 show the corresponding differences in detail, clarity, and scene appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 八个TI2V模型中有七个超过了最佳的世界模型质量综合得分（表10）。 它们的优势涵盖美学、成像和人类偏好评分，且波动幅度小于世界模型之间的差异。 Cosmos3-Super在TI2V组中领先，而EVOKE在世界模型中领先。 图25–27详细展示了在细节、清晰度和场景外观上相应的差异。

sents.en: Seven of the eight TI2V models exceed the best world-model quality aggregate (Table 10 ).
sents.zh: 八个TI2V模型中有七个超过了最佳的世界模型质量综合得分（表10）。

sents.en: Their advantage spans aesthetic, imaging, and human-preference scores, with a smaller spread than among world models.
sents.zh: 它们的优势涵盖美学、成像和人类偏好评分，且波动幅度小于世界模型之间的差异。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Super leads the TI2V group, while EVOKE leads world models.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Super在TI2V组中领先，而EVOKE在世界模型中领先。

sents.en: Figures 25 – 27 show the corresponding differences in detail, clarity, and scene appearance.
sents.zh: 图25–27详细展示了在细节、清晰度和场景外观上相应的差异。

paragraphs.en: HPS scores vary the most across models in both groups, and world models also differ in imaging quality. Motion-smoothness scores range only from 97.05 97.05 to 99.40 99.40 , while flicker scores are also high and similar across models. These temporal measures reveal broadly smooth outputs; perceptual quality and preference account for more of the remaining differences between models. Cosmos3-Nano leads world models in flicker and smoothness, whereas EVOKE’s overall quality advantage comes from its perceptual scores.
paragraphs.zh: HPS 分数在两组模型中差异最大，各世界模型的成像质量也有所不同。 运动平滑度分数仅在 97.05 97.05 到 99.40 99.40 之间，而闪烁分数在各模型中也都很高且相近。 这些时间维度指标表明各模型的输出总体平滑；感知质量与偏好分数才是模型间剩余差异的主要来源。 Cosmos3-Nano 在闪烁和平滑度方面领先于各世界模型，而 EVOKE 的整体质量优势则来自其感知分数。

sents.en: HPS scores vary the most across models in both groups, and world models also differ in imaging quality.
sents.zh: HPS 分数在两组模型中差异最大，各世界模型的成像质量也有所不同。

sents.en: Motion-smoothness scores range only from 97.05 97.05 to 99.40 99.40 , while flicker scores are also high and similar across models.
sents.zh: 运动平滑度分数仅在 97.05 97.05 到 99.40 99.40 之间，而闪烁分数在各模型中也都很高且相近。

sents.en: These temporal measures reveal broadly smooth outputs; perceptual quality and preference account for more of the remaining differences between models.
sents.zh: 这些时间维度指标表明各模型的输出总体平滑；感知质量与偏好分数才是模型间剩余差异的主要来源。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Nano leads world models in flicker and smoothness, whereas EVOKE’s overall quality advantage comes from its perceptual scores.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Nano 在闪烁和平滑度方面领先于各世界模型，而 EVOKE 的整体质量优势则来自其感知分数。

paragraphs.en: Return scores vary the most across models in both groups, while Identity scores are generally high and more similar across models (Table 3 ). Identity is evaluated during the input-to-query interval, when the initial observation is more recent. Return requires recovery of the starting scene after the full exploration. The contrast points to a longer-term memory challenge: recognizable objects can survive early exploration even when the original view is not faithfully recovered after completing the full exploration trajectory and returning to the initial viewpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 在两组中，回报分数在不同模型间差异最大，而身份分数总体较高且在不同模型间更为接近（表 3）。 身份是在输入到查询的时间间隔内评估的，此时初始观察更为新鲜。 回报则要求在完成全部探索之后恢复起始场景。 这一对比指向一个更长期的记忆挑战：即使原始视图在完成完整探索轨迹并返回初始视点后未能被忠实还原，可辨识的物体仍能在早期探索中被保留下来。

sents.en: Return scores vary the most across models in both groups, while Identity scores are generally high and more similar across models (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 在两组中，回报分数在不同模型间差异最大，而身份分数总体较高且在不同模型间更为接近（表 3）。

sents.en: Identity is evaluated during the input-to-query interval, when the initial observation is more recent.
sents.zh: 身份是在输入到查询的时间间隔内评估的，此时初始观察更为新鲜。

sents.en: Return requires recovery of the starting scene after the full exploration.
sents.zh: 回报则要求在完成全部探索之后恢复起始场景。

sents.en: The contrast points to a longer-term memory challenge: recognizable objects can survive early exploration even when the original view is not faithfully recovered after completing the full exploration trajectory and returning to the initial viewpoint.
sents.zh: 这一对比指向一个更长期的记忆挑战：即使原始视图在完成完整探索轨迹并返回初始视点后未能被忠实还原，可辨识的物体仍能在早期探索中被保留下来。

paragraphs.en: Gen3C leads world-model Return and overall input preservation despite ranking 17th in visual quality. Its persistent 3D cache supplies target-view renderings during generation [ Ren et al., 2025 ] , keeping earlier scene evidence accessible when the camera returns. This cache may help it recover the original view after exploration. SolarWM-H3 instead leads Query, and Cosmos3-Nano leads Identity, showing that different models lead recovery of the starting view, fidelity at the requested query viewpoint, and recognition of the original anchors.
paragraphs.zh: Gen3C 在世界模型回归和整体输入保持方面领先，尽管其视觉质量仅排名第 17。 其持久化 3D 缓存在生成过程中提供目标视角的渲染结果 [ Ren et al., 2025 ]，使得相机返回时仍能访问早期场景证据。 这一缓存可能有助于它在探索后恢复原始视角。 SolarWM-H3 则在 Query 上领先，Cosmos3-Nano 在 Identity 上领先，这表明不同模型分别在恢复起始视角、在请求的查询视点上的保真度以及对原始锚点的识别方面各有所长。

sents.en: Gen3C leads world-model Return and overall input preservation despite ranking 17th in visual quality.
sents.zh: Gen3C 在世界模型回归和整体输入保持方面领先，尽管其视觉质量仅排名第 17。

sents.en: Its persistent 3D cache supplies target-view renderings during generation [ Ren et al., 2025 ] , keeping earlier scene evidence accessible when the camera returns.
sents.zh: 其持久化 3D 缓存在生成过程中提供目标视角的渲染结果 [ Ren et al., 2025 ]，使得相机返回时仍能访问早期场景证据。

sents.en: This cache may help it recover the original view after exploration.
sents.zh: 这一缓存可能有助于它在探索后恢复原始视角。

sents.en: SolarWM-H3 instead leads Query, and Cosmos3-Nano leads Identity, showing that different models lead recovery of the starting view, fidelity at the requested query viewpoint, and recognition of the original anchors.
sents.zh: SolarWM-H3 则在 Query 上领先，Cosmos3-Nano 在 Identity 上领先，这表明不同模型分别在恢复起始视角、在请求的查询视点上的保真度以及对原始锚点的识别方面各有所长。

paragraphs.en: TI2V models have higher mean Identity and Return scores but lower mean Query fidelity than world models. Seedance2.5 leads both checkpoints within its group; other models retain recognizable content with weaker viewpoint-specific fidelity. Figures 29 and 30 compare these checkpoints with their registered references.
paragraphs.zh: 与世界模型相比，TI2V 模型的平均 Identity 和 Return 分数更高，但平均 Query 保真度更低。 Seedance2.5 在其所在组内的两个检查点中均领先；其他模型能保留可识别的内容，但视角特定保真度较弱。 图 29 和图 30 将这些检查点与其注册的参考视频进行了比较。

sents.en: TI2V models have higher mean Identity and Return scores but lower mean Query fidelity than world models.
sents.zh: 与世界模型相比，TI2V 模型的平均 Identity 和 Return 分数更高，但平均 Query 保真度更低。

sents.en: Seedance2.5 leads both checkpoints within its group; other models retain recognizable content with weaker viewpoint-specific fidelity.
sents.zh: Seedance2.5 在其所在组内的两个检查点中均领先；其他模型能保留可识别的内容，但视角特定保真度较弱。

sents.en: Figures 29 and 30 compare these checkpoints with their registered references.
sents.zh: 图 29 和图 30 将这些检查点与其注册的参考视频进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Different-view global DINO similarity remains relatively high for many models, while same-view perceptual fidelity exposes larger failures (Table 4 ). MiniMax-H3, for example, scores 77.27 77.27 on global DINO but 17.32 17.32 on normalized same-view LPIPS. A scene can retain its semantic character while its textures, objects, or layout change . The matched views in Figures 2 and 28 make these failures visible.
paragraphs.zh: 对于许多模型来说，不同视图的全局 DINO 相似度仍然相对较高，而同视图的感知保真度则暴露出更大的失败（表 4）。 例如，MiniMax-H3 在全局 DINO 上的得分为 77.27 77.27，但在归一化同视图 LPIPS 上的得分仅为 17.32 17.32。 一个场景可以在其纹理、物体或布局发生变化的同时保留其语义特征。 图 2 和图 28 中匹配的视图使这些失败清晰可见。

sents.en: Different-view global DINO similarity remains relatively high for many models, while same-view perceptual fidelity exposes larger failures (Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 对于许多模型来说，不同视图的全局 DINO 相似度仍然相对较高，而同视图的感知保真度则暴露出更大的失败（表 4）。

sents.en: MiniMax-H3, for example, scores 77.27 77.27 on global DINO but 17.32 17.32 on normalized same-view LPIPS.
sents.zh: 例如，MiniMax-H3 在全局 DINO 上的得分为 77.27 77.27，但在归一化同视图 LPIPS 上的得分仅为 17.32 17.32。

sents.en: A scene can retain its semantic character while its textures, objects, or layout change .
sents.zh: 一个场景可以在其纹理、物体或布局发生变化的同时保留其语义特征。

sents.en: The matched views in Figures 2 and 28 make these failures visible.
sents.zh: 图 2 和图 28 中匹配的视图使这些失败清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Lyra2 leads world-model same-view LPIPS, patch DINO, and reprojected DINO. Its stored geometry and dense correspondences retrieve historical frames [ Shen et al., 2026 ] , which may help preserve appearance across revisits. HY-WorldPlay leads reprojected depth consistency, while SolarWM-H3 leads surface F-score. Depth compares distances on overlapping surfaces; F-score measures agreement between recovered point sets. These distinct strengths bring SolarWM-H3 and Lyra2 to nearly identical tier scores .
paragraphs.zh: Lyra2 在世界模型同视角 LPIPS、patch DINO 以及重投影 DINO 上领先。 其存储的几何信息与稠密对应关系可检索历史帧 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] ，这可能有助于在重访时保持外观一致。 HY-WorldPlay 在重投影深度一致性上领先，而 SolarWM-H3 在表面 F-score 上领先。 深度指标比较重叠表面上的距离；F-score 衡量恢复出的点集之间的一致性。 这些各自的优势使 SolarWM-H3 与 Lyra2 获得几乎相同的层级得分。

sents.en: Lyra2 leads world-model same-view LPIPS, patch DINO, and reprojected DINO.
sents.zh: Lyra2 在世界模型同视角 LPIPS、patch DINO 以及重投影 DINO 上领先。

sents.en: Its stored geometry and dense correspondences retrieve historical frames [ Shen et al., 2026 ] , which may help preserve appearance across revisits.
sents.zh: 其存储的几何信息与稠密对应关系可检索历史帧 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] ，这可能有助于在重访时保持外观一致。

sents.en: HY-WorldPlay leads reprojected depth consistency, while SolarWM-H3 leads surface F-score.
sents.zh: HY-WorldPlay 在重投影深度一致性上领先，而 SolarWM-H3 在表面 F-score 上领先。

sents.en: Depth compares distances on overlapping surfaces; F-score measures agreement between recovered point sets.
sents.zh: 深度指标比较重叠表面上的距离；F-score 衡量恢复出的点集之间的一致性。

sents.en: These distinct strengths bring SolarWM-H3 and Lyra2 to nearly identical tier scores .
sents.zh: 这些各自的优势使 SolarWM-H3 与 Lyra2 获得几乎相同的层级得分。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos3-Super leads TI2V persistence through strong appearance and surface agreement, while Seedance2.5 leads reprojected depth. The best models in the two groups are close, but their within-group orderings differ from visual quality: MiniMax-H3 is second in TI2V quality and sixth in persistence.
paragraphs.zh: Cosmos3-Super 凭借强大的外观与表面一致性在 TI2V 持久性上领先，而 Seedance2.5 在重投影深度上领先。 两组中的最佳模型较为接近，但它们组内的排序与视觉质量不同：MiniMax-H3 在 TI2V 质量上排第二，而在持久性上排第六。

sents.en: Cosmos3-Super leads TI2V persistence through strong appearance and surface agreement, while Seedance2.5 leads reprojected depth.
sents.zh: Cosmos3-Super 凭借强大的外观与表面一致性在 TI2V 持久性上领先，而 Seedance2.5 在重投影深度上领先。

sents.en: The best models in the two groups are close, but their within-group orderings differ from visual quality: MiniMax-H3 is second in TI2V quality and sixth in persistence.
sents.zh: 两组中的最佳模型较为接近，但它们组内的排序与视觉质量不同：MiniMax-H3 在 TI2V 质量上排第二，而在持久性上排第六。

paragraphs.en: Every model has lower feature consistency at medium than at short temporal offsets, with greater between-model variation at the medium interval (Table 11 ). Depth and regional scale also separate world models more strongly than short-range features. Together, these results locate the harder part of 3D consistency: maintaining corresponding content and spatial relationships as the camera moves farther through the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型在中距时间偏移下的特征一致性都低于短距时间偏移，且在中距区间上模型之间的差异更大（表 11）。 深度与区域尺度对世界模型的区分也强于短程特征。 综合来看，这些结果定位了 3D 一致性中更困难的部分：随着相机在场景中移动得更远，保持对应的内容与空间关系。

sents.en: Every model has lower feature consistency at medium than at short temporal offsets, with greater between-model variation at the medium interval (Table 11 ).
sents.zh: 每个模型在中距时间偏移下的特征一致性都低于短距时间偏移，且在中距区间上模型之间的差异更大（表 11）。

sents.en: Depth and regional scale also separate world models more strongly than short-range features.
sents.zh: 深度与区域尺度对世界模型的区分也强于短程特征。

sents.en: Together, these results locate the harder part of 3D consistency: maintaining corresponding content and spatial relationships as the camera moves farther through the scene.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果定位了 3D 一致性中更困难的部分：随着相机在场景中移动得更远，保持对应的内容与空间关系。

paragraphs.en: HY-WorldPlay leads depth and regional scale. Its Reconstituted Context Memory retrieves geometrically relevant historical frames, and Context Forcing preserves memory use during distillation [ Sun et al., 2025 ] , consistent with its local geometric strength. Astra achieves strong reconstruction scores but weaker depth and regional-scale agreement. Reconstruction measures how well a shared 3D representation reproduces the generated views; low-detail outputs may make this task easier without yielding equally strong geometric agreement. ABot-World also combines high reconstruction PSNR with low depth and scale consistency.
paragraphs.zh: HY-WorldPlay 在深度和区域尺度上领先。 其重构上下文记忆（Reconstituted Context Memory）可检索几何相关的历史帧，而上下文强制（Context Forcing）则在蒸馏过程中保持记忆的使用 [ Sun et al., 2025 ] ，这与其在局部几何上的优势相一致。 Astra 取得了较高的重建分数，但在深度和区域尺度一致性上较弱。 重建衡量的是共享三维表征复现生成视图的程度；低细节的输出可能使这一任务更容易，却不一定能带来同样强的几何一致性。 ABot-World 也同样表现出高重建 PSNR 与低深度和尺度一致性的组合。

sents.en: HY-WorldPlay leads depth and regional scale.
sents.zh: HY-WorldPlay 在深度和区域尺度上领先。

sents.en: Its Reconstituted Context Memory retrieves geometrically relevant historical frames, and Context Forcing preserves memory use during distillation [ Sun et al., 2025 ] , consistent with its local geometric strength.
sents.zh: 其重构上下文记忆（Reconstituted Context Memory）可检索几何相关的历史帧，而上下文强制（Context Forcing）则在蒸馏过程中保持记忆的使用 [ Sun et al., 2025 ] ，这与其在局部几何上的优势相一致。

sents.en: Astra achieves strong reconstruction scores but weaker depth and regional-scale agreement.
sents.zh: Astra 取得了较高的重建分数，但在深度和区域尺度一致性上较弱。

sents.en: Reconstruction measures how well a shared 3D representation reproduces the generated views; low-detail outputs may make this task easier without yielding equally strong geometric agreement.
sents.zh: 重建衡量的是共享三维表征复现生成视图的程度；低细节的输出可能使这一任务更容易，却不一定能带来同样强的几何一致性。

sents.en: ABot-World also combines high reconstruction PSNR with low depth and scale consistency.
sents.zh: ABot-World 也同样表现出高重建 PSNR 与低深度和尺度一致性的组合。

paragraphs.en: Five TI2V models exceed the best world-model self-consistency aggregate, with their largest group advantages in depth and regional scale. Their weaker control results indicate that internally compatible generated views can still follow a different path from the requested cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 五个 TI2V 模型超过了最佳世界模型的自洽性综合得分，其最大的群体优势体现在深度和区域尺度上。 它们较弱的控制结果表明，内部兼容的生成视图仍可能沿与所请求相机不同的路径运行。

sents.en: Five TI2V models exceed the best world-model self-consistency aggregate, with their largest group advantages in depth and regional scale.
sents.zh: 五个 TI2V 模型超过了最佳世界模型的自洽性综合得分，其最大的群体优势体现在深度和区域尺度上。

sents.en: Their weaker control results indicate that internally compatible generated views can still follow a different path from the requested cameras.
sents.zh: 它们较弱的控制结果表明，内部兼容的生成视图仍可能沿与所请求相机不同的路径运行。

paragraphs.en: Temporal control scores vary more across models than quality or geometry scores, in both average performance and stability (Table 12 ). TI2V models have higher group means in quality and local geometry but weaker control, bringing their aggregate Tier 6 performance close to that of world models. Seedance2.5 leads its group overall through stronger control, while Cosmos3-Super leads quality and geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 在平均表现和稳定性上，时间控制得分的跨模型差异都大于质量或几何得分（表 12）。 TI2V 模型在质量和局部几何上的组均值更高，但控制较弱，使其总体 Tier 6 表现接近世界模型。 Seedance2.5 凭借更强的控制在整体上领先其所在组，而 Cosmos3-Super 则在质量和几何上领先。

sents.en: Temporal control scores vary more across models than quality or geometry scores, in both average performance and stability (Table 12 ).
sents.zh: 在平均表现和稳定性上，时间控制得分的跨模型差异都大于质量或几何得分（表 12）。

sents.en: TI2V models have higher group means in quality and local geometry but weaker control, bringing their aggregate Tier 6 performance close to that of world models.
sents.zh: TI2V 模型在质量和局部几何上的组均值更高，但控制较弱，使其总体 Tier 6 表现接近世界模型。

sents.en: Seedance2.5 leads its group overall through stronger control, while Cosmos3-Super leads quality and geometry.
sents.zh: Seedance2.5 凭借更强的控制在整体上领先其所在组，而 Cosmos3-Super 则在质量和几何上领先。

paragraphs.en: Genie3 leads the temporal control score , while Lyra2 has the highest mean control level . EVOKE leads world-model temporal quality; SolarWM-H3 leads geometric stability and the overall tier, while HY-WorldPlay has the highest mean geometry level. SolarWM’s camera-conditioned autoregressive training, distribution-matching distillation [ Huang et al., 2026 ] , and retained rollout history offer a possible explanation for its sustained performance. Figures 31 – 33 show how the generated views evolve; Section 5.5 examines the corresponding temporal performance.
paragraphs.zh: Genie3 在时序控制得分上领先，而 Lyra2 拥有最高的平均控制水平。 EVOKE 在世界模型时序质量上领先；SolarWM-H3 在几何稳定性和总体层级上领先，而 HY-WorldPlay 拥有最高的平均几何水平。 SolarWM 的基于相机条件的自回归训练、分布匹配蒸馏 [ Huang et al., 2026 ] 以及保留的 rollout 历史为其持续的表现提供了一种可能的解释。 图 31–33 展示了生成视角的演化过程；第 5.5 节考察了相应的时序性能。

sents.en: Genie3 leads the temporal control score , while Lyra2 has the highest mean control level .
sents.zh: Genie3 在时序控制得分上领先，而 Lyra2 拥有最高的平均控制水平。

sents.en: EVOKE leads world-model temporal quality; SolarWM-H3 leads geometric stability and the overall tier, while HY-WorldPlay has the highest mean geometry level.
sents.zh: EVOKE 在世界模型时序质量上领先；SolarWM-H3 在几何稳定性和总体层级上领先，而 HY-WorldPlay 拥有最高的平均几何水平。

sents.en: SolarWM’s camera-conditioned autoregressive training, distribution-matching distillation [ Huang et al., 2026 ] , and retained rollout history offer a possible explanation for its sustained performance.
sents.zh: SolarWM 的基于相机条件的自回归训练、分布匹配蒸馏 [ Huang et al., 2026 ] 以及保留的 rollout 历史为其持续的表现提供了一种可能的解释。

sents.en: Figures 31 – 33 show how the generated views evolve; Section 5.5 examines the corresponding temporal performance.
sents.zh: 图 31–33 展示了生成视角的演化过程；第 5.5 节考察了相应的时序性能。
